tei:div.tei:p: dpe skrun gsal bshad/ ༄༅/ /spyi lo 2007 zla ba 6 tshes 5 nas 14 bar nyin bcu'i ring༸skyabs rje bde bar gshegs pa mkhan chen dam pa a pad rin po che'i zhal snga nas kyis rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis sa chen kun dga' snying por bstsal ba'i blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral 'di nyid ris med mkhan po bla sprul dge 'dun 'dus tshogs brgya phrag brgal bar/ bal yul rgyal yongs gsung rab slob gnyer khang du bka' khrid mdzad pa da lam yig thog tu phab ste (blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral gyi 'grel pa )zhes bya ba mgon po gang nyid dgongs pa zhi dbyings su gtad nas/ mi lo hril po gcig 'khor ba'i dgongs rdzogs dus cheen dang stabs bstun rab 'byams chos kyi mchod sbyin zab mor dmigs te phul ba lags na/ bgyi ba bzang po 'di las byung ba'i rnam dkar gyi legs byas zad mi shes pa des mgon po gang nyid kyi zag med thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs shing 'brel yod skye 'gro kun zab gsang thugs brtse'i gur khyim las nam yang mi 'dor ba'i smon lam zab mo zhu ba lags so/ / ༄༅/ /bal yul rgyal yongs gsung rab slob gnyer khang du mkhan chen dam pa a pad rin po che mchog gis nyin bcu'i ring theg pa chen po zhen pa bzhi bral gyi sgom khrid gnang ba de nyid yig thog tu phab 'bri zhus pa kun phan bdud rtsi'i char rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so// // ༄༅/ / thog ma'i sems bskyed/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du chos gsan snyam pa'i thugs bskyed dang bcas pa'i sgo nas chos gsan gnang rogs/ /lhan rgyas rnams thag ring po nas chos la do 'khur chen po byas te phebs pa la dga' po byung*/ /da lan ngas chos bshad bya ni gtso bo zhen pa bzhi bral yin/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi chos la gsum yod/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i bka' mdo sde/

rgya gar la sogs pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos/ bka' dang bstan bcos de rnams kyi nang la mtho ris dang thar pa thob pa'i lam mang po gsungs pa rnams gtso bo las dang po pa rnams kyi don du go rim bsgrigs nas nyams su len stangs bshad pa'i man ngag dang gsum yod/ man ngag la yang mang po yod/ bod la'ang nyan thos kyi theg pa dang gsang sngags ma yin pa'i theg pa chen po'i man ngag mang po yod/ de'i nang nas bod la grags che shos ni rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis sa chen kun dga' snying po la gnang ba'i zhen pa bzhi bral dang*/ gser gling pas jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha la gnang ba'i blo sbyong gnyis yin/ zhen pa bzhi bral ni rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis gsungs pa red/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi che ba brjod pa'i skabs mdo'i nang 'di 'dra gsungs yod/ sangs rgyas gcig gi mtshan smos na bsod nams chen po yod gsungs pa red/ de las kyang sangs rgyas mang po'i mtshan smos pa yin na bsod nams che ba yod pa bshad ma dgos pa red/ chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram gyi bye ma snyed kyi tshad kyi sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bskal par brjod pa las kyang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mtshan lan gcig brjod na bsod nams che ba yod gsungs pa red/ grangs de snyed kyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mdzad pa phrin las 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis gnang gi yod pas de 'dra gsungs pa red/ bdag cag gi ston pa la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas mang po dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed bcug de nas lam nyams len byed bcug de 'dra byas pa yin pas 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yab gsungs pa red/ rgyu mtshan gzhan dag gcig la/ nges don gyi 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes pa ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs sam shes rab la gsung gi yod red/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis kyang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yab ces zhu gi yod red/

rje btsun byams pa mgon pos nga 'dra ba'i sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mang pos gzab gzab byas nas bltas na'ang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis zhabs 'dor stangs tsam yang rtogs thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ de la sogs pa'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ngo mtshar che ba'i rnam thar mang po mdo'i nang na gsungs yod red/ slob sbyong dang nyams len ji ltar mdzad dgos pa'i skor bshad pa/ zhen pa bzhi bral gyi skor la yig cha kha shas 'dug de tsho'i nang nas da lan nga tshos 'chad nyan gyi gzhi de kun mkhyen go rams pa'i gsung de la byed kyi yin/ khyed rnam pas 'dzin grwa tshogs dus de'i steng nas gzigs rogs gnang*/ 'grel pa gzhan dag yang gzigs rogs gnang/ nga la bsgoms zin pa'i nyams myong bshad rgyu med la/ sngon med pa'i legs bshad de 'dra yang bshad rgyu med/ 'on kyang gtso bo slob sbyong byed mkhan phyi rgyal nas yong mkhan tsho yin stabs/ sangs rgyas kyi chos la dad pa yod pa gang zhig la gzhung chen po slob sbyong byed ma myong mkhan tsho la dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan dang*/ theg pa chen po'i chos skor mang tsam bshad na/ sems kyi thog la theg pa chen po'i chos kyi bag chags 'jog gi red bsam pa'i re ba byed kyi yod/ da lan nyin bcu yi ring la slob sbyong dang nyams len gnyis cha mnyam du byas nas thos bsam sgom gsum mnyam po byed rgyu'i 'char gzhi byas nas rang sbyong tshugs stangs gcig bzos yod red/ nyi ma re la rang sbyong dang chos thun bsdoms tshar bzhi re tshugs kyi red/ dper na rang sbyong byed rgyu'i dus yun chu tshod gcig dang phyed ka tsam yod pa yin na/ dang po skar ma bzhi bcu zhe lnga'i ring slob sbyong byed/ dpe cha de tsho klog/ thos bsam byed/ dus tshod phyed ka la bsgom byed/ yang na rang sbyong tshogs thun gcig la slob sbyong byed/ gzhan rnams kyi skabs su sgom byas na 'grig gi red/

sangs rgyas kyi gsung tshigs su bcad pa gcig la yang thos bsam bsgom gsum byed dgos kyi yod red/ de gsum byas pa las shes rab gsum skye yi yod red/ thos pa'i shes rab zer ba de slob dpon las shes pa dang*/ yang na gzhan dag gis brtsams bzhag pa'i dpe cha bltas nas shes pa la zer gyi yod red/ de nas thos pa'i shes rab byung tshar ba'i rjes so sos dpyad pa gtong dgos kyi yod red/ so sos rigs rtsal bton te dpyad pa btang na thos pa byas pa las kyang don dag nges pa yong gi yod red/ de la bsam byung gi rig pa'am shes rab zer gyi yod red/ chos gzhan la bshad pa'i skabs su don tshan gcig la gzhung don ngo ma 'di yin zhes thag gcod ma thub kyang mkhas pa mang po'i bshad srol mi 'dra ba mang po 'di 'dra yod red zer nas bshad bzhag na 'grigs 'gro gi red/ mkhas nyams dod po yong gi yod red/ yin na yang nyams len byed pa'i skabs su de 'dras 'grig gi ma red/ gcig gi steng du thag bcad dgos kyi yod red/ dper na sa cha rgyus med pa gcig la 'gro ba'i skabs lam ka gnyis thug yong na gcig gi steng du 'gro rgyu thag gcad dgos kyi red ma gtogs gnyis ka'i thog la 'gro shes kyi ma red/ des na de 'dra byas nas thag gcod nges po zhig byed dgos kyi yod red/ de nas gang nges tshar ba de la sems bzhag nas yang yang dran te goms cha len pa la bsgom mam nyams su len pa zer gyi red/ bsgom gyi gnas skabs su zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gnyis kyi skor/ bsgom la zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gnyis yod/ bsam gtan bsgoms nas sems la gnas cha thob pa'am/ khyad par zhi gnas thob na de rten du byas nas byams snying rje sogs gang bsgom yang mgyogs po sems 'byongs pa dang grub 'bras 'thon pa yong gi yod red/ theg pa gsum char gyi lam gong ma rnams kyi rten du zhi gnas med du mi rung ba red/

'on kyang zhi gnas med mkhan gyis 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang byams snying rje sogs rtse gcig tu bsgom/ yang nas yang du bsgom na 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i mngon rtogs dang byamasasnying rje sogs skye thub kyi yod red/ bsgom byed stangs la dpyad bsgom dang 'jog bsgom gnyis yod red/ dper na zhi gnas bsgom pa yin na/ sems dmigs pa gcig gi steng nas gzhan du mi 'phro ba byas nas yang yang bsgom dgos rgyu yin pa red/ de la dpyad pa gtong mi dgos pa red/ de min lhag mthong ngam bdag med pa bsgom na sgom stangs la dpyad sgom dang*/ 'jog sgom gnyis yod red/ dper na bdag med pa lta bu yin na bdag med pa'i rgyu mtshan gcig gam mang po bsams nas des sgro 'dogs chod pa'i don la rtse gcig tu 'jog pa la dpyad sgom zer gyi yod red/ rgyu mtshan sngon la nges tshar ba goms cha yod mkhan zhig yin na bdag med pa yin pa'i yin stangs kyi rgyu mtshan gyi thog la bsam blo ma btang bar/ bdag med pa de'i thog tu dmigs pa gtad pa de la 'jog sgom zer gyi yod red/ dper na snying rje bsgom na/ sems can thams cad la snying rje dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ sems can thams cad ma yin pa dang*/ sdug bsngal mang po yod par bsam pa sogs sngon du btang nas rnying rje bsgom pa de dpyad sgom red/ rgyu mtshan de 'dra gang yang ma bsams pa'i thog nas sems can thams cad snying re rje/ snying re rje zhes bsam pa'i bsam blo de'i thog tu sems rgyun du 'jog pa la 'jog sgom zer/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig ces sogs kyi tshig brjod/ phreng ba bgrangs/ tshar brgya tsam 'don/ sems kyis kyang de bzhin tshar brgya dran na tshig des phan thogs kyi yod red/ de rnams spyir btang red/ / dge ba ji ltar byed dgos pa'i skor bshad pa/ da lan nyin bcu'i 'dzin grwa'i dus yun ring la dge ba byed stangs mang po de ring nas bzung 'go 'dzugs dgos red/

dper na/ gsang sngags kyi nang la kha zas kyi rnal 'byor/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor sogs mang po bshad kyi red/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa chen po la yang de 'dra yod red/ dper na gnyid log pa'i gnas skabs na sems can thams cad sangs rgyas chos kyi sku thob par shog cig bsam/ gnyid de chos sku red zer gyi yod ma red de/ de dang phyogs mthun de dran pa'i rkyen byas te de'i skabs na sems can thams cad kyis chos sku thob par shog bsam pa yin na gnyid de dge ba la 'gyur 'gro yi yod red/ gnyid sad dus sems can thams cad ma rig pa'i gnyid sad par shog bsam/ yar langs dus gzugs sku thob par shog bsam/ gos gyon dus ngo tsha khrel yod kyi gos dang ldan par shog bsam/ khrus byed dus nyon mongs pa'i dri ma 'khrud par shog bsam/ de la sogs pa mang po yod red/ mdo dang bstan bcos nang yod pa'i tshig don rnams blo la zin/ dus thog tu dran thub pa byung na lung ma bstan gyi las rnams dge ba'i las su 'gyur 'gro yi yod red/ za ma za dus sems can thams cad kyis bsam gtan gyi zas thob par shog bsam/ de bzhin du za ma za dus dang / btung ba 'thung dus rang gi lus la 'bu mang po yod pa de rnams da ltar zas kyis gso/ rjes su dam pa'i chos kyis gso yi yin bsams te kun slong brjes na za ma za ba'i las de dge bar 'gyur 'gro gi yod red/ bsgom byed pa'i skabs su tshul khrims dang ldan zhing thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs chod pa zhig yin na dngos gnas byas na dben pa gcig la bzhugs nas bsgom byed dgos kyi yod red/ /dben pa de la gnyis yod/ lus dben pa dang*/ sems dben pa'o/ /lus dben pa zer na mi gzhan med pa/ sems dben pa zer na sems can dang*longs spyod sogs la chags pa dang 'dod pa'i rnam rtog spangs pa/ de 'dra byas nas rtse gcig tu bsgoms na mgyogs po nyams 'og tu tshud pa yong gi red/

de min mi dang 'brel ba ma bcad/ las ka mang po byed kyin bsgom na yun ring po bsgoms na'ang go chod pa zhig yong thub pa dka' las khag po yin pa thos song/ da lan nyin bcu'i bsgom gyi ring la so so la khe tsang gi nyal khang re yod pa yin stabs so so'i nyal khang sgo brgyab/ rang gi rnam rtog kyang sgo brgyab bzhag pa yin na lus dben pa dang sems dben par 'gyur yong gi yod red/ de nas bsgom byed dus lus sems la dka' las med pa dgos kyi yod pas ngal gso mang po brgyab dgos yin pa red/ lus po dal po byed/ skad cha yang mang po mi bshad/ kha 'don mang po mi byed/ sems pa la las ka mi bkol/ lhod po byas te sdod dgos kyi yod red/ nyin mo gnyid khug na phan thogs kyi med pa 'dra/ skyon byed kyi yod red/ mtshan mo gnyid khug dgos red/ gnyid khug pa de ngal gso ba'i mthun rkyen yag shos red/ des na dgong dro thun grol tshar dus skad cha mang po bshad rgyu med pa red/ phan thogs mkhan gyi skad cha yin na ma gtogs skad cha gzhan dag mi bshad pa de theg pa chen po'i chos gcig red/ de yang nyams len byed dgos red/ / skyabs 'gro'i ngo bo bshad pa/ da skyabs 'gro'i skor zhu rgyu yin/ skyabs 'gro ni nyams len thams cad kyi rten dang chos thams cad kyi sgo red/ skyabs 'gro zer rgyu'i don ni 'jigs skrag chen po gcig byung nas 'jigs skrag de rang gis med pa byed ma thub nas med pa byed thub mkhan gcig la skyabs 'tshol/ rogs pa 'tshol ba la zer gyi yod red/ dper na char gyi 'jigs pas brag skyibs tu 'gro ba lta bu red/ nga tsho la 'jigs skrag gang yod red zer na/ tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa'i dus nas da lta'i bar 'jigs skrag dang gnod 'tshe dang sdug bsngal mang po bar mtshams med par myong bsdad yod red/ da dung nga tshos thar pa'i lam la zhugs nas 'gyur ba ma btang ba yin na mtha' med pa'i bar du 'jigs skrag rgyun chad rgyu yod ma red/

dmyal ba la slebs tshar dus 'jigs skrag sel thub mkhan gyi rogs pa zhig ga nas thob yong bsams nas phyogs bzhi la rogs pa 'tshol gyi yod red/ yin na'ang de'i skabs la skyabs dang rogs pa thob rgyu yod ma red/ der brten rang dbang yod pa'i gnas dus su de ring nas skyabs 'gro byed dgos kyi yod red ces rgyal sras zhi ba lhas gsungs pa red/ / skyabs 'gro'i rgyu bshad pa/ de ring shi song ba yin na ngan song la skye ba'i rgyu mang po gcig tshang bsdad yod red/ rgyu yod na'ang 'gal rkyen yod na 'bras bu bkag thub kyi red de 'gal rkyen chos rnam dag de 'dra rang gi sems rgyud la yod ma red/ des na de ring shi song ba yin na phal che brgya cha dgu bcu go dgu ngan song dang/ de yi nang nas dmyal ba la skye rgyu'i nyen kha yod red/ de ltar 'jigs skrag mang po dang chen po yod red/ rgyu gnyis pa ni dad pa red/ dad pa la'ang gsum yod red/ dang ba'i dad pa/ 'dod pa'i dad pa dang/ yid ches kyi dad pa ste gsum red/ dang ba'i dad pa zer na dper na chu rnyog pa med pa zhig la chu dwangs ba zer gyi red/ de ga nang bzhin sems dang ba zer dus the tshom dang ma dad pa'i rnyogs pa med pa'i sgo nas dkon mchog gsum ni yon tan chen po yin bsam pa de la dang ba'i dad pa zer gyi yod red/ 'dod pa'i dad pa zer na de dag thob 'dod byed pa la zer gyi yod red/ yid ches kyi dad pa zer na/ dkon mchog la skyabs 'gro byas/ blo gtad na 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob pa la bslu ba med bsam pa de la zer gyi yod red/ rgyu gzhan gcig de snying rje red/ theg pa chen po'i lam dang 'bras bu tshang ma snying rjes byed kyi yod red/ snying rje med na theg pa chen po'i lam rnam par dag pa rtsa ba nas ma red/ dper na skyabs 'gro yin na'ang theg dman gyi skyabs 'gro ni rang nyid kyi ched du yin pas de'i rgyu 'jigs pa dang dad pa gnyis yin/

theg chen gyi skyabs 'gro ni gzhan gyi don du yin pas de'i rgyur sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las bsgral 'dod kyi snying rje dgos pa yin/ / skyabs su 'gro yul ngos bzung ba/ gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul zhu rgyu yin/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul de theg dman yin na/ sangs rgyas zer na sangs rgyas gzugs kyi sku la zhu yi yod red/ chos zer dus theg pa dman pa'i chos/ dge 'dun zer dus theg pa dman pa'i 'phags pa'i gang zag brgyad po de tsho red/ theg pa chen po'i lugs la sangs rgyas la sku gsum bzhed/ sku gsum zer dus de snga dpe cha sbyang ma myong mkhan tshos gang zag gsum la go na 'grig gi ma red/ gang zag gcig sangs rgyas dus sku gsum thob kyi yod red/ de yang sangs rgyas ngo ma de longs sku red/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams na sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyis theg pa chen po'i chos 'khor gsungs/ 'khor byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa sha stag yin mkhan de longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku red/ chos sku ni de'i thugs la gsung gi yod red/ sprul sku gsung na longs sku des sems can mchog dman mang po'i don dag byed pa'i don du sprul pa bstan pa yin/ sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku des byang chub sems dpa'/ nyan thos/ rang sangs rgyas/ sems can gyi gzugs dang gzings dang zam pa la sogs pa'i gzugs sna tshogs dang / snyan dang mi snyan/ rnyed dang mi rnyed/ dgra dang gnyen la sogs pa'i rnam pa dang / gdul bya'i mos pa dang dgos pa dang bstun pa'i chos kyang sna tshogs pa ston par mdzad/ chos dkon mchog ni theg pa chen po'i chos red/ de la lung gi chos dang*/ rtogs pa'i chos zer ba gnyis yod red/ lung gi chos de go bde bo byas na/ sngon ma dang po sangs rgyas kyi gsung red/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs rgyud na bzhugs pa da lta glegs bam gyi thog la yod pa de rnams yin/

rtogs pa'i chos zer ba de 'gog lam gnyis la zer gyi yod red/ 'gog pa zer na byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa rnams kyi sems kyi gnas lugs lam gyi stobs kyis dri ma las grol ba de la 'gog pa'i bden pa zer gyi yod red/ lam zer na nyon mongs spong ba'i gnyen po byang sems 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud na yod pa'i shes rab dang snying rje la sogs pa lam gyi bden pa la zer/ dge 'dun dkon mchog ni sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang sems 'phags pa rnams yin/ de dag thams cad skyabs gnas yin bsam/ dkon mchog gsum po tshang ma nga tsho'i skyabs gnas red/ tshang ma la skyabs su 'gro dgos red/ yin na'ang shākya thub pa lta bu gcig la skyabs zhus na sangs rgyas thams cad la skyabs zhu 'gro gi red/ rgyu mtshan shes na gcig la skyabs zhus pa dang tshang ma la zhus pa la khyad par yod ma red/ 'o na sangs rgyas ga tshod yod red/ sangs rgyas tshang ma la skyabs su 'gro dgos kyi yod red dam zhes dris na/ sangs rgyas la grangs kyi mtha' yod ma red/ spyir mtha' med pa la mang po yod red/ nam mkha' la mtha' med/ sems can la mtha' med/ sangs rgyas la mtha' med/ chos la mtha' med/ dge 'dun la mtha' med/ 'o na dkon mchog gsum kho na la skyabs zhu dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zer na/ dper na nga tsho la khrims 'gal chen po byung skabs de'i 'jigs skrag dang*/ dka' ngal nga rang tsho so sos sel ma thub na mi gzhan zhig la rogs pa'am skyabs zhu dgos kyi yod red/ skyabs zhu sa de shes yon yod mkhan/ rogs pa byed 'dod yod mkhan/ nus pa yod mkhan te khyad chos gsum tshang dgos kyi red/ dpe de bzhin du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' de tsho la mkhyen pa dang*/ nus pa dang*/ brtse ba gsum ga yod pa yin pa dang*/ gzhan dag la yon tan de dag med pas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro dgos red/ dri ba de'i lan 'phags pa thogs med kyis 'di 'dra gsungs yod/

skyabs yul la yon tan bzhi yod dgos/ gcig so so 'jigs skrag las grol tshar ba dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ so so 'jigs skrag gi nang la yod pa yin na dper na chus khyer song na lag pas lag pa 'dzin sdod pa dang 'dra bar gzhan 'jigs pa las skyob thub kyi ma red/ yon tan gnyis pa ni sems can rnams 'jigs skrag las sgrol ba'i thabs la mkhas pa yin pa/ gsum pa snying rje yod pa/ bzhi pa ni rngan pa sprad mi dgos pa de red/ dper na gla rngan sprad nas rogs pa byed dgos kyi yod na rogs pa byed khag po chags kyi yod red/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' tshos phar gus zhabs zhu na'ang rogs pa byed kyi red/ phar gnod pa byed na'ang rogs pa byed kyi yod red/ phar gang yang ma byas na'ang rogs pa byed kyi red/ yon tan bzhi po de dag dkon mchog gsum kho na la tshang ba yin pas dkon mchog gsum kho na skyabs yul yin gsungs pa red/ / ji ltar skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul bshad pa ni/ gsum pa skyabs su 'gro stangs ni/ sangs rgyas la ston par 'dzin/ chos la thar pa thob par byed pa'i lam yin bsam/ dge 'dun rnams lam sgrub pa'i grogs po yin bsam pa la skyabs 'gro zer gyi yod red/ skyabs 'gro de gtso bo sems kyi steng la 'jog gi yod red/ skyabs su mchi'o zhes ngag gis brjod pa de ngag gi skyabs 'gro yin/ gang 'dra zhig byas na dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro tshad ldan zhig byed thub kyi red zer na/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis de la khyad chos bzhi tshang dgos kyi red gsungs/ de yang dang po dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan yag po shes dgos/ gnyis pa dkon mchog gsum gyi nang tshan gyi khyad par de tsho shes dgos/ gsum pa ga re khas blangs na skyabs 'gror 'gyur gyi yod pa shes dgos/ bzhi pa ni gzhan du mi smra ba'i skyabs su 'gro ba de yin/ de'i don dag ni/ chos lugs gzhan dag gi dkon mchog dang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi khyad par shes par byas nas/

sangs rgyas pa'i dkon mchog gsum kho na la skyabs su 'gro dgos zhes pa'i don yin/ / mchog gsum gyi yon tan gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul bshad pa/ de las dang po dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan shes pa de gnas skabs thams cad du gal chen po yin pas yon tan gyi skor cung zad zhu rgyu yin/ sangs rgyas zer ba de skyon rtsa ba nas med mkhan/ yon tan tshang ma yod mkhan/ khyad par du gzhan la chos ston dus nor 'khrul rtsa ba nas mi byed mkhan/ mdor bsdus na de tsho sangs rgyas kyi yon tan yin no/ da gsung gi yon tan bshad kyi yin/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung gcig gi gdul bya sna tshogs la khyab par byed pa sogs yan lag lnga dang / 'jam pa dang / yid du 'ong ba dang / rgyang ring du grags pa la sogs pa yan lag drug cu dang ldan pas tshad med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su dam pa'i chos go bar mdzad/ der ma zad chos nyan mkhan ga tshod yod na'ang*/ de dag gi skad kyi thog nas gsung gi yod red/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi gsung gcig la skad mi 'dra ba mang po'i thog nas brjod bya yang mtho ris kyi lam dang theg pa gsum gyi lam so sor go thub kyi yod red/ dper na sangs rgyas kyis chos gcig gsungs dus gdul bya mi 'dra ba gsum gyis mdo mi 'dra ba gsum go song ba da lta bka' 'gyur gyi nang la yod pa lta bu red/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs la zag med kyi chos sde tshan nyer gcig gi yon tan yod red/ de'i nang nas mkhyen pa dang snying rje gnyis zhus na/ dang po mkhyen pas shes bya thams cad da lta nga tshos mdun na yod pa'i ca lag la lta ba nang bzhin mngon sum du dus tshod gcig gi thog tu gzigs kyi yod red la/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs kyang mngon sum du gzigs kyi yod red/ sangs rgyas ma yin pa thams cad kyi shes bya de che/ mkhyen pa de chung bsdad yod red/ sangs rgyas la shes bya mkhyen dgos pa dang mkhyen pa gnyis che chung med par 'grigs bsdad yod red/

'jig rten pa'i lha la sogs pa phar bzhag sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems dpas kyang shes bya thams cad gzigs yod ma red la/ shes bya thams cad kyi gnas lugs kyang mkhyen yod ma red/ sangs rgyas la ltos na des gzigs pa de shes bya'i phyogs gcig tsam red/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mnga' ba'i rgyu mtshan des sangs rgyas de nyid lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi ston par gyur pa yin/ gnyis pa snying rje ni/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad srid zhi'i 'jigs pa las sgrol bar bzhed pa'i snying rje bskal pa grangs med pa du mar goms nas thugs nyid snying rje'i rang bzhin du gyur te sems can thams cad la dus rtag tu gzigs kyi yod red/ mdor na sangs rgyas kyi yon tan la tshad med/ tshad med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ni ga tshod bshad na'ang rdzogs rgyu yod ma red la nyung du 'gro rgyu yang yod ma red/ don gnyis pa rgyu'i skor bshad na/ de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan de dag gi rtsa ba snying rje dang/ rgyu byang chub kyi sems dang / mthar phyin pa'i rkyen sbyin pa dang tshul khrims la sogs pa'i thabs rnams yin/ de lta bu'i sems can la phan bde sgrub 'dod kyi bsam pa dang tshad med pa'i spyod pa yun ring por goms par byas pa las mthar thug gi grub 'bras 'di byung ba red/ des na sangs rgyas kyi rgyu yang phun sum tshogs pa yin/ gsum pa phrin las phun sum tshogs pa zhu rgyu yin/ phrin las zer na sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa red/ sangs rgyas rang don grub tshar ba yin pas rang don sgrub pa'i las ka gang yang yod ma red/ ga re gnang ba de thams cad gzhan don red/ phrin las de la dbye ba mang po yod/ dang po phrin las sna tshogs pa zhes pa sems can 'dul ba'i phrin las mi 'dra ba sgo mang po zhig gnang gi yod pa'i don red/ gtso bo chos gsung rgyu de red/ yin na'ang phrin las gzhan yang mang po gnang gi yod red/

sangs rgyas kyis dus tshod thung ngu zhig gi thog la mdzad pa mi 'dra ba ji tsam gnang ba'i grangs tshad de 'dzam bu gling gi sa yi rdul phran la yang yod ma red ces dbu ma 'jug pa las gsungs yod/ /gnyis pa khyab pa zhes pa gdul bya gang du yod na'ang de dag thams cad du phrin las kyis khyab pa'i don red/ /gsum pa lhun gyis grub pa zhes pa sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las ni 'di 'dra zhig bya snyam pa'i rnam rtog dang 'bad rtsol mi dgos par ngang gis 'jug cing sgrub par mdzad pa'i don yin/ bzhi pa dus las mi yol ba zhes pa dgos pa'i dus la legs par gnang thub kyi red/ dus tshod snga drags pa dang phyis drags pa'i skyon yod ma red/ /lnga pa bar chad pa med pa zhes pa bar mtshams med pa/ gung gseng med par mu mthud nas phrin las gnang gi yod pa'i don red/ /drug pa rgyun mi chad pa zhes pa 'khor ba 'di ji srid gnas kyi bar phrin las 'jug pa'i don red/ sems can thams cad sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du phrin las rdzogs pa'i skabs yod ma red/ sems can la rdzogs pa'i dus skabs yod ma red/ des na sangs rgyas kyi phrin las ni med pa'i dus skabs rtsa ba nas mi srid pa red/ de nas don tshan bzhi pa la/ sangs rgyas kyi phrin las des sems can la phan thogs ci tsam yod pa'i skor zhus na/ gzhan don 'ba' zhig mdzad pa sangs rgyas kyi phrin las kyi khyad chos red/ sangs rgyas kyis dbugs gtong rngub dang spyod lam bzhi po re res kyang sems can rnams la phan pa gnang gi yod red/ sangs rgyas kyi sku las 'od zer gcig spros pa dang*/ chos thun re gsungs pas sems can 'bum phrag mang po mtho ris gnyis dang / rgyun du zhugs pa sogs pa bzhi dang theg pa chen po'i lam la 'god par mdzad/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa'i rjes su'ang sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs dang*/ ring bsrel dang mchod rten dang*/

gang du mdzad pa bstan pa'i gnas rnams kyis kyang gdul bya la thar pa'i sa bon bskrun pa dang / khyad par du gsung rab kyis thar pa'i lam ston pa'i don che ba mdzad/ dper na sangs rgyas kyi sku 'dra yin na/ de la chos shes mkhan gcig gis sems bskyed dang dad pa byas te mjal ba dang phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa byas na bsod nams yod pa bshad ma dgos pa red/ chos gang yang ma shes na'ang mjal 'dod med par sangs rgyas kyi sku mjal ba dang*/ mchod rten skor 'dod med par skor ba thebs song na'ang sangs rgyas rnams bsod nams kyi zhing bla na med pa yin zhing / de rnams la 'brel ba byung ba'i rgyu mtshan des de rnams mthar thug nges par 'tshang rgya ba'i khyab pa yod red/ /da chos kyi yon tan gyi skor zhu rgyu yin/ sems can tshang mas las ka re byed kyi yod red/ de'i dmigs yul ni bde ba thob pa dang*/ sdug bsngal med pa bya rgyu red/ dmigs yul cha tshang ba sgrub mkhan de chos kyis 'grub kyi red/ de gzhan gyis 'grub thub kyi ma red/ dam pa'i chos ni sdug bsngal thams cad med par byed pa'i sman/ bde ba thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin zhes zhi ba lhas gsungs pa red/ de theg pa che chung gi chos tshang ma'i dgongs don gcig pa yin pa red/ khyad par du theg pa chen po'i chos ni yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sgrub mkhan la zhu gi yod red/ des na 'bras bu'i thog nas bsam blo btang na yon tan chen po yin pa des rtogs thub kyi yod red/ theg pa chen po'i chos de la bsdus bsdus shig byas nas bshad na/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis yod red/ thabs zhes pa ni snying rje'i sgo nas gzhan don byed pa dper na sbyin pa gtong ba lta bu red/ shes rab zer na gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab red/ thabs la sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bskyed pa'i nus pa yod red/ shes rab la skyon ma lus pa spong ba'i nus pa yod red/

thabs kyi nang tshan snying rje/ byams pa/ sbyin pa gtong ba de tsho la phan yon mang po yod gsung gi yod red/ de tsho'i phan yon tshang ma'ang chos kyi yon tan red/ da dge 'dun gyi yon tan zhu rgyu yin/ theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun tshang ma bslab pa gsum la gnas pa yin pas mdo'i nang la legs par bzhugs pa dang rig par bzhugs pa la sogs pa'i yon tan rnams yod pa yin/ de yi dbang gis sems can gzhan dag gis phyag 'tshal ba'i 'os dang / mchod pa phul ba'i 'os yin pa sogs kyang mdo las gsungs pa red/ khyad par du byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa de tsho la yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod red/ dper na sa dang po thob dus yon tan mang po'i mdzod brnyes tshar yod red/ nyon mongs pa dang sdug bsngal yod ma red la 'jigs skrag kyang yod ma red/ byang chub sems dpa' de tshos da dung yang dmigs yul cha tshang ba 'grub med pa yin pas sangs rgyas bsgrub pa la phyag las mang po gnang dgos kyi yod red/ phyag las gal che ba ni so sos tshogs gsog rgyu dang*/ sems can gyi don byed rgyu gnyis red/ de gnyis ka la yang dka' ngal gang yang yod ma red/ dper na sa dang po'i byang sems kyis dus gcig gi thog la gzugs po brgya sprul thub pa dang / gnyis pas stong*/ gsum pas khri la sogs gzugs po mang pos sangs rgyas mang po'i sku mdun la chos thos bsam byed/ sangs rgyas de tsho la mchod pa phul/ dper na zang zing gi mchod pa phul dgos na/ khong sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin pas dpal 'byor chen po yod red/ thogs pa yod ma red/ der ma zad ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis sprul nas mchod pa mang po dbul gyi yod red/ dper na byang chub sems dpa' gcig gis sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa gdan 'dren zhu skabs gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan/ bzhugs sa'i khang pa/ bzhugs gdan/ zhal lag gi snod/ zhal lag/ dbul bya'i chos gos la sogs pa tshang ma ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis sprul nas rgya chen po de 'dra dbul thub kyi yod red/

mchod rdzas de rnams rgyu las nyon gyi bdag 'bras ma yin par rgyu ting nge 'dzin las byung bas bla na med pa'i mchod pa red/ yang dper na dngos su bshams pa'am ting nge 'dzin gyis sprul pa'i me tog dbul ba'i tshe me tog kha shas nam mkha' la bla bre/ kha shas khang bzang / kha shas gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / me tog kha shas kyis me tog gi phreng bar gyur pa sku'i rgyan du phul/ kha shas sil ma byas te sa gzhi khyab par bkrams/ de 'dra ba nam mkha' gang ba bzos nas dbul/ de bzhin du bdug spos/ mar me dang zhal zas sogs mchod rdzas du ma dbul gyin yod/ de'i rgyu mtshan che chung dang*/ mang nyung zer ba rnams sems kyis bzos bzhag pa red ma gtogs don gyi steng du bden par grub pa med pa'i gnas lugs dngos su mkhyen gyi yod pas chung chung chen po dang / nyung nyung mang por bzo thub kyi yod red/ der ma zad dus tshod ring thung zhes pa'ang sems la snang ba tsam las don gyi steng du med pa dngos su mkhyen gyi yod pas yun ring po bskal pa mang por gsag dgos pa'i tshogs kyang dus tshod thung ngu la gsog thub/ da lta nga tshos de 'dra dngos su mi nus pas mos pa byas te blo sbyong dgos kyi yod stabs/ dper na me tog 'dra po gcig bshams te sangs rgyas la 'bul rgyu yin na de dman pa yin yang bzang po yin bsam/ chung chung dang nyung nyung rnams mang po yin bsam pa sogs de 'dra'i mos pa byed dgos kyi yod red/ der ma zad dper na maṇḍal gcig phul na dus ring po bskal pa mang por gsag dgos pa'i tshogs rnams ngas maṇḍal gcig gi ring la rdzogs par bya dgos bsams na yun rieng po'i tshogs rdzogs pas da lta nas mos pa byed dgos kyi yod red/ nga tshos da lta nas mos pa de 'dra bas tshogs bsags nas rjes ma sa thob yong dus dngos su sgrub thub pa yong gi yod red/ byang sems 'phags pa sa mtho ba de tsho la nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting nge 'dzin yod red/

ting nge 'dzin de bsgom yong dus nam mkha' 'di longs spyod kyi mdzod du 'gyur thub kyi yod red/ nam mkha' la phyag gis byugs byugs 'dra po re re byed dus ga re dgos na'ang 'bab yong gi red/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pas sems can gyi don mdzad stangs kyang de dang phyogs mtshungs red/ dper na dus tshod gcig gi thog la lus 'bum phrag mang po sprul nas sems can mang po'i don gnang gi yod red/ byang chub sems dpas phyogs mang po nas sems can kyi don mdzad kyi yod red de gtso bo nigadul bya'i sems can rnams thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam shes pa'i ched du chos bshad pa dang chos byed du bcug pa rnams red/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa rnams sangs rgyas las chos mang po thos pa dang sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi don rnams slob dpon la ma bltos par rang dbang du mkhyen pas chos mang po bshad rgyu yod red/ dus tshod gcig gi steng du sku gzugs mang po sprul/ sku gzugs re res dus tshod gcig gi steng du chos 'bum phrag mang po gnang thub kyi yod red/ yang byang chub sems dpa' la 'od zer mang po yod red/ 'od zer gcig spros pas sems can du ma'i ngan song gi sdug bsngal med par byed/ 'od zer gzhan gcig spros te sems can rnams kyi sems dge ba la bsgyur / de dang de 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi rigs mang pos gzhan don mi 'dra ba mang po gnang / de la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i mdzad pa phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa red/ mdor bsdus nas zhus na/ sangs rgyas/ chos/ dge 'dun gsum ka la yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod red/ de ring skyabs 'gro byed stangs gcig slob kyi yin/ so so'i khang pa rnams gtsang ma byas/ gra 'grigs na sangs rgyas kyi sku 'dra/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung glegs bam dang mchod rten rnams bshams/ de nas de'i mdun na sdig pa dang ma 'dres pa'i mchod pa bsham rgyu yod na/

chu/ me tog/ spos sogs bshams/ so so stan yag po gcig gi steng du bsam gtan gyi spyod lam gyis bsdad/ sems lhod lhod byas te ngal gso brgyab/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkha' la/ sangs rgyas la mchog dman yod ma red de da lta'i ston pa dang bstan pa'i bdag po yin pas shākya thub pa gtso bor byas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad/ byang chub sems dpa' tshang ma rang gi mdun du long ba'i mdun du mig ldan sdod pa nang bzhin dngos su bzhugs yod bsam/ de yang gu dog po ma yin pa so so'i bzhugs khri dang mchod rdzas dang / 'khor dang bcas pa gu yangs po byas nas bzhugs yod bsam/ skyabs su 'gro mkhan rang dang g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab rnams su sems can thams cad mi yi rnam pa sha stag byas nas bsdad yod bsam/ de nas skyabs 'gro'i tshig de tsho skyor/ bdag dang zer dus rang dran tsam byas/ 'gro ba sems can zer dus skyabs su 'gro mkhan sems can thams cad dran pa byas/ theg pa chen po'i lugs la rang dang sems can thams cad mnyam du skyabs su 'gro dgos pas dbyin ji'i 'gyur nang ngas skyabs su 'gro zer ba yod na de nga tshos zhes bsgyur dgos kyi red/ de theg dman gyi lugs srol red/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du zer ba des dus tshod bshad pa red/ theg dman yin na ma shi'i bar du gsung gi yod red/ theg pa chen pos sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du zhes skyabs su 'gro ba'i dus kyi khyad par ston pa red/ de nas sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o zer dus sangs rgyas ni ston pa yin bsam/ chos la skyabs su mchi'o zer dus chos de lam yin bsam/ dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o zer dus dge 'dun rnams lam gyi grogs po yin bsam/ dkon mchog gsum la mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan dang skyabs gnas kyi mtshan nyid bzhi tshang bas skyabs gnas mi bslu ba ni dkon mchog gsum po rang yin bsam/

rang dang sems can thams cad la bzod mi thub pa'i sdug bsngal dang mtha' med pa'i 'jigs skrag chen po yod pas snying rje'i yul ni rang dang sems can thams cad yin/ 'on kyang de snga phan chad dkon mchog la blo ma khel/ dkon mchog gi dgongs pa la mos mthun ma zhus/ so so rang ngos nas thabs shes yod rgu byas te dka' ngal chen po brgyab bsdad pa red/ de'i rkyen pas sdug bsngal rkyang pa min pa grub 'bras 'dod blo khengs pa gang yang ma byung ba red/ rgyu mtshan des na da ni dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro gi yien/ nga tsho mthon po la gtong*/ dma' sa la bzhag/ skyid po dang sdug po gang byung na'ang 'dra dkon mchog gsum mkhyen bsam pa'i blo gtad byed dgos kyi yod red/ blo phyogs re ma yin pa blo tshang ma gtad dgos red/ blo ling gis gtad nas skyabs 'gro byed dgos kyi red/ rang gi ngos nas khyed shes blo gtad dang bka' bzhin bsgrubs na theg chen gyi skyabs yul dkon mchog gi ngos nas srid zhi gnyis kyi nyes pa las skyob pa'i rgyu tshogs tshang zhing gegs med pa red/ skyabs 'gro grangs brgya stong sogs gang thub byed/ de'i mjug la zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gsol 'debs/ bdag blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs/ zhes sogs kyi tshig rkang bzhi po de rnams kyi don yid la sems pa'i sgo nas 'don dgos/ gsol 'debs de zhen pa bzhi bral gyi nyams len yag po yong ba'i gsol 'debs red/ gsol ba 'debs zhes pa zhu ba phul zhes pa'i don red/ mjug la dkon mchog mkhyen song*/ da bdag sogs dkon mchog gis skyob kyi red bsam pa'i yid ches byed/ de nas mjug la skyabs 'gro byas pa'i bsod nams des sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par shog la sogs pa'i bsngo ba byas/ de nas thun mtshams kyi spyod lam rnams kyi skabs su dkon mchog gi yon tan de tsho dran pa byas/

'o de ring chos thun rang sbyong skabs de 'dra gnang rogs gnang*/ / mchog gsum gyi nang tshan la khyad par gang zhig yod pa'i skor bshad pa/ da gnyis pa dkon mchog gsum gyi nang tshan la khyad par gang yod pa'i skor zhu rgyu yin/ sangs rgyas zhes pa ni byang chub la gsungs pa red/ chos zhes pa ni de'i 'bras bu red/ dge 'dun zhes pa ni chos de nyams len byed mkhan la zhu yi red/ gal che shos de dkon mchog gsum gyis sems can rnams sdug bsngal las ga 'dra byas nas skyob kyi red zer rgyu de red/ de la sangs rgyas kyis chos gsungs te mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam ston pa'i sgo nas gdul bya rnams gnas skabs ngan 'gro dang mthar thug 'khor ba spyi'i sdug bsngal dang 'jigs pa las skyob kyi red/ de yang sangs rgyas kyis chos gsungs/ chos de so sos nyams len byas te rim pas sdug bsngal las skyob thub kyi red gsungs/ dam pa'i chos kyis skyob stangs ni/ dper na dge 'dun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi thugs rgyud na yod pa'i chos kyis nged tsho dngos su'am thad kar skyob thub kyi ma red/ 'on kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i chos rnams so sos nyams len byed pa yin na/ nyams len des so so'i sems rgyud kyi sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba bdag 'dzin dang nyon mongs pa de tsho 'joms pa'i sgo nas sdug bsngal las skyob kyi yod red/ dge 'dun gyis grogs byed pa'i sgo nas skyob kyi red/ grogs byed stangs ni*/ nged tsho'i chos byed pa'i rogs pa dge 'dun de tshos chos byed pa la bsngags brjod byed cing spro ba spel ba'i sgo nas bskul slong yag po byed dus so sos kyang chos byed snying 'dod pa yong gi yod red/ dge 'dun gyis de 'dra'i sgo nas grogs sam rogs pa byed pa yin/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis gsungs pa'i don tshan gsum pa ni las sla po red/ ga 'dra byas nas khas blangs te skyabs 'gro byed dgos zer na/

sangs rgyas la ston pa yin bsam/ chos la lam dang/ dge 'dun la dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i grogs po yin bsams te skyabs 'gro byed dgos gsungs pa red/ don tshan bzhi pa ni/ chos lugs gzhan dag gi dkon mchog dang*/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi mi 'dra ba'i khyad par shes pa'i sgo nas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i dkon mchog kho na la skyabs 'gro byed dgos gsungs pa red/ de yang hin du'i ston pa tshangs pa dang*/ khyab 'jug/ drang srong chen po de rnams kyis nyon mongs pa spangs yod ma red la/ rang gzhan gyis gsod pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal yang yong gi yod red/ der brten 'jigs pa las grol yod ma red/ ston pa de tshos gsungs pa'i chos la 'gal ba'ang yod red/ dper na dbang phyug rtag pas snod bcud thams cad byed pa red zer ba lta bu rtag pa'i tha snyad kyi gnas tshul g.yo 'gul rtsa ba nas mi byed mkhan gcig yin zhing las ka byed thub kyi med pas de 'dra'i 'gal ba 'chad mkhan zhig red/ der ma zad chu chen po'i nang du khrus byas na thar pa thob kyi red zer ba dang*/ de bzhin du dbang phyug las dbang gcig zhu rgyu yod/ de zhus na thar pa thob kyi red zer ba dang*/ de kho na nyid nyi shu lnga shes na thar pa thob kyi red zer ba'i lam de 'dra bstan rgyu yod red/ lam de tshos rjes 'jug nyams len pa rang nyid thar pa thob thub kyi ma red/ rgyu mtshan gang red zer na/ lam de tshos 'khor ba spong thub kyi ma red/ 'khor ba'i rtsa ba bdag 'dzin red/ bdag 'dzin spong ba la bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab dgos kyi yod red/ bdag med ma shes na bdag 'dzin spong thub kyi ma red/ bdag 'dzin mi spong ba'i lam des 'khor ba las thar par byed thub kyi ma red/ hin du'i chos lugs pa tshang mas bdag yod zer gyi yod red/ sangs rgyas pa'i bdag med ces brjod pa la skyon chen po brtsi yi yod red/

sangs rgyas kyi chos lugs ni chad par smra ba yin zer te chad smrar ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod red/ de tsho'i rjes 'jug rnams ni chos de 'dra'i rigs nyams su len cing*grub 'bras de tsam med pa'i brtul zhugs la brtson te nga rgyal byas nas sdod mkhan red/ / skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa'i skor bshad pa/ skyabs yul dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa yod dgos kyi red/ sngon ma skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa'am/ byang sdom dang/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa zhus myong yod na sngon 'gro la nges par skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa yod red/ de min na skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa zhu dgos kyi red/ de nas sdom pa yod mkhan de la bsrung bya yod pas bsrung bya mdor bsdus zhu rgyu yin/ spyir btang sdom pa yod mkhan gyi bslab bya la bsgrub bya dang spang bya gnyis yod red/ lhag par du skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa yod mkhan gyi bsgrub bya la 'phags pa thogs med kyis bzhi tshan gnyis su byas te gsungs pa red/ de las gcig zhus na/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su phyin tshar dus skyes bu dam pa chos shes mkhan dang*/ chos nyams len byed mkhan zhig bla mar bsten dgos pa de don tshan dang po yin/ gnyis pa ni de las chos zhu dgos pa de red/ gsum pa ni skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa zhus tshar pa yin dus gang dran dran byas na 'grigs kyi med pas rang gi sdom pa dang 'brel ba'i blang dor rnams ma 'dres par blang bya 'di 'dra red/ dor bya 'di 'dra red ces spang blang kyi bslab bya rnams do khur byas te shes dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ bzhi pa ni gang thub thub kyis nyams len bya rgyu de red/ / skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya'i skor bshad pa/ skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya gal che ba gcig zhus na/ dus dus su mchod pa 'bul dgos kyi yod gsungs pa red/ de bzhin du skyabs 'gro nyin ma re la nyung mtha' la tshar drug bskyor thub thabs bya dgos/

'phral du gal che ba 'og nas 'byung ba 'di rnams yin/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs kyi rnam pa gang yang mjal dus de tsho sangs rgyas dngos yin bsams te mjal ba dang phyag 'tshal ba sogs kyi sgo nas gus zhabs zhu dgos kyi yod red/ sangs rgyas kyi sku mjal ba tsam la'ang bsod nams chen po yod red/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun nyan thos dgra bcom pa 'jig rten gyi khams gang ba la bsnyen bkur zhu ba las sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs gcig mjal na bsod nams che ba yod red/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten rnams kyi nang na sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel bzhugs yod pas sangs rgyas kyi thugs yin bsams te gus zhabs byed/ mchod rten de tsho'i chos nyid gcig pa red/ der brten dper na bal yul gyi mchod rten gsum lta bu gang rung gcig la phyag 'tshal ba na 'jig rten khams kyi mchod rten yongs su rdzogs pa la phyag 'tshal ba chags kyi red/ de bzhin du gtsug lag khang rnams mchod rten gyi khongs red/ yin na'ang de lta bu'i bsod nams thob pa la de'i gnad don shes dgos kyi yod red/ de nas gsung rab rnams ha cang gal chen po red/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ gsung rab de tsho la zhal yod ma red de blang dor ston gyi yod pas sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi tshab dngos gnas byed kyi yod red/ des na de tsho la'ang gus zhabs chen po byas te sangs rgyas kyi gsung dngos yin bsams nas sa cha mtho sa la bzhag/ mchod pa phul/ mdor na sangs rgyas kyi gsung tshan pa re re la'ang phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod pa dbul ba bcas byas na bsod nams chen po yod gsungs pa red/ de nas dge 'dun chos byed mkhan gyi rab byung yin na'ang 'dra/ khyim pa pho mo gang yin na'ang 'dra de tshos dge 'dun gyi tshab byed/ de tsho tshang mar gus zhabs snyoms po byed thub dgos kyi yod red/ dge 'dun dkon mchog ces pa ni theg chen byang sems 'phags pa sa dang po thob pa yan chad la byams pa mgon pos ngos 'dzin gnang ba red/

khyad par du byang chub sems dpa' de rnams sdig pa gsog sa dang bsod nams gsog sa'i zhing phul du phyin pa'i gras red/ byang chub sems dpa' su yin shes kyi ma red/ nga rang tsho chos byed mkhan gyi nang na byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ma zhus mkhan yod kyi ma red/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa zhus nas ma nyams pa yin na byang chub sems dpa' yin dgos red/ de tsho la'ang dmigs bsal gus zhabs chen po zhu dgos kyi yod gsungs pa red/ spyir btang sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa red/ thams cad mkhyen pa yin na ma gtogs gang zag gis gang zag gzhan gyi tshad 'dzin thub kyi ma red/ gang yin zhe na/ lus ngag gi spyod pa tsam la brten nas gang zag gzhan gyi sems gshis ngo ma gang 'dra yin shes kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ chos la skyon yod ma red de gang zag la skyon yod mkhan mang po yod kyang rab byung spyod pa dman pa tshor skyon brjod byed pa yin na ha cang nyes pa chen po yod gsungs/ der brten dper na mchod rten nang log gzungs gzhug yod med dang*/ bzo lta sogs legs nyes ga 'dra yin na'ang phyi'i rnam pa mchod rten yin dus gus zhabs zhu ba nang bzhin rab tu byung ba gzan sham bzhes shing sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'jug yin pa'i mtshan ma yod mkhan tsho la'ang rgyu mtshan de'i thog nas gus zhabs zhu dgos kyi yod red/ bsrung bya la/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su phyin tshar dus lha gzhan dag la ston par mi 'dzin/ chos la skyabs su phyin na sems can la gsod pa dang brdeg pa sogs kyi sgo nas 'tshe ba'am gnod pa mi byed/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song na grogs mu stegs pa dang 'grogs mi rung gsungs pa red/ chos la skyabs su song na chos ma yin pa la chos su mi 'dzin zhes kha shas kyis gsung gi 'dug snga ma de mdo las gsungs pa red/ rang gi srog la thug gi yod kyang dkon mchog gsum blos mi gtong*/ sdom pa gzhan dag yin na nyes pa 'di dang 'di byas na sdom pa gtong 'gro gi red/

'di 'dra byas na sdom pa la skyon byed kyi red zer ba yod red de skyabs 'gro la nyes pa 'di 'dra byas na 'di 'dra yong gi red zer ba de 'dra rgya gar gzhung na med pa 'dra/ yin na'ang bod kyi mkhas pa phal che bas gsungs na sangs rgyas ma yin pa gzhan la ston par 'dzin na skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa gtong 'gro gi red gsungs pa red/ gsal po rang med pa 'dra/ gang ltar gzab gzab byed dgos kyi yod red/ / skyabs 'gro'i phan yon skor bshad pa/ skyabs 'gro'i phan yon mdor bsdus zhu rgyu yin/ skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa blangs na nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gral du chud pa red/ gral du chud ces pa'i don ni sangs rgyas kyi 'khor ram rjes 'jug tu gyur ces pa'i don red/ sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la zhugs na nam zhig sdug bsngal rgyun chad 'gro gi yod red/ so so'i sems kyi skyabs 'gro de nyid srung ba chen po chags kyi yod red/ srung ba chen po chags pa'i don ni/ des mthar thug ngan song gi 'jigs pa las skyob cing 'phral du 'jigs skrag chung chung mang po las kyang srung ba'am skyob thub ces pa'i don red/ de bzhin du dkon mchog dang dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin tshos kyang so sor srung skyob byed cing / skye ba nas skye bar dkon mchog gsum dang mi 'bral/ sdig pa mang po zad/ bsod nams gsog khyad par du skyabs 'gros ngan song gi sgo 'gog gi red ces mang po gsung gi 'dug mthar thug gi phan yon la dkon mchog gi go 'phang 'thob kyi red/ bka' 'gyur nang skyabs 'gro'i mdo zhes pa zhig yod red/ de'i nang du shā ri'i bus nyin ma gcig khong gi dgongs pa la gzhan dag gcig gis skyabs 'gro la phan yon ga re yod ces dris byung na/ lan sprad rgyu dgos kyi 'dug dgongs nas ston pa la skyabs 'gro'i bsod nams dang phan yon gang yod ces bka' 'dri zhus pas/

sangs rgyas kyis dad pa can gyi mi zhig gis dper na rin po che rkyang pa las grub pa'i mchod rten chen po 'og min gyi bar du snyobs mkhan zhig bzos na bsod nams chen po yod red/ de las kyang skyabs 'gro byed pa bsod nams che yi red ces gsungs/ gzhung sbyangs ma myong mkhan tsho la 'di zhus na phan gyi red dran song / / theg pa gsum skor bshad pa/ gong du skyabs 'gro'i skabs la theg chen dang theg dman gyi dge 'dun zhes mang po bshad pa red/ de'i go rtogs la phan thabs tog tsam zhu rgyu yin/ deng sang theg pa gsum zhes pa ni/ theg dman/ theg chen/ gsang sngags gsum la go gi yod red/ spyir de 'dra gsung mkhan ha cang nyung nyung red/ yin na'ang chos rgyal 'phags pas thun mong min pa'i theg pa gsum zhes pa de gsum la ngos 'dzin gnang ba zhig 'dug dus rgyun theg pa gsum zhes pa nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang rgyal gyi theg pa dang / theg pa chen po gsum la zhu gi yod red/ theg pa 'di gsum po re re la'ang lam lnga lnga ste bsdoms pas tshogs lam/ sbyor lam/ mthong lam/ sgom lam dang / mi slob bcas lam bco lnga yod red/ mi slob lam zhes pa lam dngos ma red/ de theg pa gsum so so'i 'bras bu la lam gyi ming btags pa red/ lam dang po tshogs lam zhes pa ni/ 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag thams cad skyon du mthong ste 'khor ba spang dgos kyi 'dug bsams te theg dman gyi rigs can yin na thar pa 'thob dgos kyi 'dug bsam pa de theg dman gyi sems bskyed dam byang chub chung ngu dang 'bring gi sems bskyed zer gyi red/ de la nges 'byung gi sems kyang zhu gi red/ 'khor ba la skyon du mthong ste sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob dgos kyi 'dug bsam pa de theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed dam byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa zer gyi yod red/ sems bskyed de'i thog nas skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa dang /

dge slong gi sdom pa/ yang na byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa zhus pa yin na theg pa chen po'i lam gyi sne la zhugs pa red/ sems bskyed gsum po gang rung gi sgo nas rang rang gi tshul khrims srung bzhin pa'i ngang nas gtso bo thos bsam byed sdod pa'i lam la tshogs lam zer gyi yod red/ de nas rim gyis chos kyi go rtogs gong 'phel du phyin te gtso bo sgom byed pa'i lam la sbyor lam zer gyi yod red/ sgom la yang mang po yod red de bdag med sgom pa'i lam de la sbyor lam zer gyi yod red/ de nas theg pa dman pa'i lam du zhugs pa yin na bden pa bzhi'i gnas lugs dang / theg chen gyi nyams len pa yin na chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mngon sum du mthong yong dus de 'dra ba'i rtogs pa la mthong lam zer gyi yod red/ de dus nyams len pa de 'phags par gyur pa red/ theg pa chen po yin na sa dang po thob song ba red/ theg dman yin na 'bras bu dang po gsum rgyun zhugs/ phyir 'ong dang phyir mi 'ong gang rung thob song ba red/ de nas gnas lugs dngos su'am mngon sum du mthong zin pa'i go rtogs de nyid la yang yang goms cha sprod pa la sgom lam zer ba red/ sgom lam ni yun ring po yod red/ theg pa chen po yin na sgom lam la sa dgur dbye ba dang / mthong lam ni yun thung thung*/ gcig byas na chu tshod gcig gis bgrod 'gro gi yod kyi red/ de las thung ba la yang bgrod thub kyi red/ sgom lam de ha cang 'gor gyi yod red/ de dag bsdoms pas byang chub sems dpa' theg pa chen po la sa bcu yod red/ de nas mjug la shes rab nus pa che shos shig gis spang bya phra shos rnams rgyun gcod 'gro dus de yi phyi logs la theg chen yin na sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du byed/ theg pa dman pa yin na dgra bcom pa thob song ba red/ skyabs yul gyi chos dkon mchog 'gog bden dang*/

lam bden zer mkhan de byang chubs sems dpa' sa bcu yi thugs rgyud kyi 'gog lam gnyis po la zer gyi yod red/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud la 'gog bden dang lam bden yod kyang de gnyis la chos sku zhu yi yod red/ de dag ni skyabs yul gyi sangs rgyas dkon mchog red// dngos gzhi zhen pa bzhi bral gyi skor bshad pa/ yan lag bdun pa zhu dgos min 'gro dran song yang de ring zhen pa bzhi bral zhu rgyu yin/ kun mkhyen gyi gsung de gzigs rogs gnang*/ kun mkhyen gyi gsung gi mgo de spyi bshad 'dra po red/ zhen pa zhen bral rang gi thog la 'gro gi med pa 'dra/ de yang bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes pa'i dus su 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub pa mdzad pas zla ba drug nang zhal gzigs te/ mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal nas/ tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min/ /'khor ba la zhen na nges 'byung min/ /bdag don la zhen na byang sems min/ /'dzin pa byung na lta ba min/ /zhes gsungs pa'i tshig rkang bzhi po 'di'i nang pha rol tu phyin pa'i nyams len thams cad 'dus pa yin/ der ma zad 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mdo dang man ngag la sogs pa mang po gsungs/ de nas sa chen de nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs nas chos brjed rgyu rtsa ba nas med par gyur pa khong rang dang slob ma rnams thams cad kyis mthun snang la grub bsdad pa red/ der ma zad su dang 'gran zla med pa'i blo gros chen po thob pa red/ / tshe 'di la zhen na sogs tshigs bcad gcig gi don mdor bstan pa/ zhen pa bzhi bral gyi man ngag 'di'i don dag mdor bsdus shig zhus na/ tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa ma red gsungs pa red/ chos pa yin na tshe 'di blos thongs pa zhig dgos kyi yod red/ 'khor ba la zhen na nges 'byung min zhes pas thar pa sgrub pa la khams gsum 'khor ba la zhen pa spangs*shing 'khor ba las 'byung 'dod kyi nges 'byung gi blo dgos kyi yod red ces pa'i don red/

des na skye ba phyi mar ngan song du mi skye ba dang / mtho ris su skye 'dod byed pa lta bu mtho ris kyi phun tshogs la zhen na nges 'byung gi blo ma red gsungs pa red/ bdag don la zhen na byang sems min zer dus byang chub sems dpa' ni gtso bo gzhan don gnang mkhan yin pas so so rang gi don la gtso bo byed pa yin na byang chub sems dpa' ma red/ 'dzin pa byung na lta ba min zhes pa'i lta ba ni gnas lugs rtogs pa'i blo gcig la zer gyi yod red/ yul gnas lugs ni spros pa'i mtha' gang du yang ma grub pa yin pas mtha' gang yang rung ba gcig tu 'dzin pa'i blo byung na lta ba ma red gsungs pa red/ tshe 'di la zhen pa spong ba la dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras gsum bsgom dgos kyi yod red/ 'khor ba la zhen pa spong ba la 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ bdag don la 'dzin pa spong ba la/ byams pa/ snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems gsum/ 'dzin pa byung na lta ba min zhes pa'i don nyams su blang ba la/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong*bsgom pa dang de la'ang lta ba'i khrid dgos kyi yod red/ de dag ni blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral gyi khrid kyi 'bor sdom red/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha la theg chen gyi khrid skad grags che ba lam rim dang*/ blo sbyong*gnyis yod red/ lam rim ni thun mong gi khrid red/ blo sbyong ni thun mong ma yin pa'i gdul bya la 'khrid rgyu yin pa red/ lam rim gyi nang du nyams su blang bya'i chos sam lam la rim pa gsum du byas te chos byed mkhan la'ang skyes bu che 'bring chung gsum ste rigs mi 'dra ba gsum yod gsungs pa red/ skyes bu chung ngu ni skye ba rjes mar ngan song du mi skye zhing mtho ris thob na sems mkhan la ngos 'dzin gnang/ rang nyid thar pa thob na sems mkhan skyes bu 'bring / gzhan sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob na sems mkhan la skyes bu chen po zhu gi yod red/

de nang bzhin chos la yang gsum yod red/ skyes bu chung ngu'i chos zer na skye ba phyi ma'i don dag sgrub pa'i dge ba lta bu/ skyes bu 'bring po'i chos ni thar pa thob pa'i don du bslab pa gsum nyams len byed pa lta bu/ skyes bu chen po'i lam ni theg chen sems bskyed dang phar phyin drug lta bu red/ des na nyams su blang bya'i chos la nyung mthar gsum yod pas skye ba phyi ma'i don dag la byed pa gcig dgos kyi yod red/ der brten tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min gsungs/ tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min zhes pa des skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i lam ston gyi yod red/ 'khor ba la zhen na nges 'byung min zhes pa des skyes bu 'bring po dang thun mong ba'i lam/ tshig rkang rjes ma gnyis pos skyes bu chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lam ston pa red/ theg pa chen po'i lam mam nyams su blang bya'i chos la thabs dang shes rab gnyis yod red/ bdag don la zhen na zhes pas thabs dang / 'dzin pa byung na zhes pas shes rab ston gyi yod red/ zhen pa bzhi dang bral ba zhig byung na theg pa chen po'i lam mam chos 'gyur gyi red/ dper na skyabs 'gro lta bu gcig byed dus zhen pa bzhi dang bral bsdad yod na theg pa chen po'i chos red/ dus rgyun nga tshos kha ton 'don dus bdag blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs zhes sogs skyabs 'gro'i mjug tu skyor rgyu'i gsol 'debs de dag zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gsol 'debs red/ des na de'i don dag gsung gi yod red/ tshe 'di la zhen pa dang bral nas blo chos su 'gro ba ste sems kyis chos chos bzhin du byed pa dang / de'i steng du 'khor ba yongs rdzogs la zhen pa bral nas chos de'ang lam du longs pa ste thar pa yi lam mam rgyur 'gro ba gcig dgos kyi yod red/ 'khor ba la ma zhen na rang gis byed pa'i chos thams cad rang nyid thar par bgrod byed kyi lam du 'gyur ba yin/

dper na tshe phyi ma'i don dag gi ched du tshul khrims srung ba sogs byed pa yin na de rnams 'khor ba'i rgyu red ma gtogs lam du ma gyur pa red/ bdag don la zhen pa ste rang don la zhen na theg chen lam gyi 'khrul pa zhig red/ theg chen gyi lam la 'khrul pa gnyis yod red/ rang don byed dgos bsam pa ni 'khrul pa dang po dang / gnas lugs zhes pa gang yang rung ba zhig tu 'dzin pa ni 'khrul ba gnyis pa red/ / tshe 'di la zhen na sogs tshigs bcad gcig gi don rgyas par bshad pa/ cung zad rgyas par bshad na dang po tshe 'di la ma zhen zer ba tsam gyis rang gi sems kyis nyan gyi ma red/ rang gi sems la so sor dbang cha yod ma red/ so so sems kyis dbang du bsgyur/ sems ni nyon mongs pas dbang bsgyur byas te bsdad yod red/ der brten tshe 'di la zhen pa spong ba la thabs shes dgos kyi yod red/ de'i thabs lam la dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang las rgyu 'bras bsgom dgos red/ tshe 'di la zhen pa spong ba'i gnyen po ngo ma ni 'chi ba mi rtag pa dran rgyu de red/ des na dal 'byor rnyed dka' la sngon 'gro/ legs shos de 'chi ba mi rtag pa yin pas 'di la dngos gzhi zhes ming btags pa red/ de'i yan lag la las rgyu 'bras bsgom pa dang gsum yod gsungs/ tshe 'di la zhen pa zer ba ni 'jig rten chos brgyad la zhen pa la zer gyi yod red/ 'jig rten gyi chos ni 'jig rten gyis dus rgyun du bed spyod byed rgyu red*/ de la bde ba dang sdug bsngal/ longs spyod rnyed pa dang ma rnyed pa/ bstod pa dang smad pa/ snyan pa dang mi snyan pa bcas brgyad yod red/ de dag gi nang nas bde ba/ rnyed pa/ bstod pa dang snyan pa bzhi po rnams thob 'dod byed pa'am thob pa la zhen cing dga' po byed pa dang / de dag gi ldog phyogs sdug bsngal/ ma rnyed pa/ smad pa dang mi snyan pa bcas bzhi la mi dga' ba byed pa la 'jig rten gyi chos la zhen pa'am tshe 'di la zhen pa zer gyi yod red/

de dag la zhen pa gcod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe 'di ni skad cig gam yun ring mi sdod mkhan zhig yin pas 'jig rten gyi chos de dag la zhen pa byas na skyon chen po yod red/ rgyu mtshan ni/ lam 'bras nang tshe 'di la zhen pa ni chos rnal ma'am rnam dag byed pa la gegs che shos red gsungs pa red/ zhen pa des dang po chos byed mi spro ba ste chos byed mi 'jug de nas chos gcig byed na yang chos de skyon can nam phyin ci log tu byed bcug dper na/ za ma yag po la dug btab pa nang bzhin chos brgyad kyis kun nas bslangs pa'i skyon dang 'dres song na chos des go mi chod pa red/ dper na chos brgyad kyi kun slong gis tshul khrims bsrungs*/ thos bsam sgom gsum byed/ chos 'chad nyan byed/ dgon pa/ bshad grwa dang mchod rten bzhengs pa sogs ci tsam zhig byed na yang tshe 'di'i sgang la 'gro gi red/ tshe 'di'i don du phyin pa des phyi ma ngan song gi rgyu byed kyi red ma gtogs phan thogs yod pa lta bu snang yang phan thogs yod ma red/ tshe 'di la zhen pa spang dgos zer dus dngul sogs gang yang med pa byas te dka' las khag po byas nas bsdad dgos zhes pa'i don dag ma red/ de 'dra'i dka' spyad byed rgyu ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs la dgag bya red/ dper na nga rang tsho'i ston pa sangs rgyas kyis lo drug la dka' spyad chen po gnang ba red de/ des dka' spyad lam red ces gsung gi yod ma red/ dka' ba spyad tshar nas grub 'bras gang yang ma byung ba'i tshul bstan pa'i rjes de nas khong gis na bza' dang zhal lag yag po bzhes/ sku gzugs yag po bzos/ rdo rje gdan la phebs nas sgom byas/ de nas mtshan gcig gi ring la sangs rgyas thob song ba red/ des na chos sgom lta bu yag po byed dgos red ma gtogs dka' spyad kyis grub 'bras gang yang thon gyi ma red ces mu stegs pa la brda sprad pa'am/

dka' spyad lam ma red ces go brda sprad pa red/ chos la bshad sgrub gnyis gtso bo red/ bshad grwa ba tshor mthun rkyen za ma yag po dang / phyag dpe sogs gra 'grigs po dgos kyi yod pa red/ gra 'grig ma 'grigs kyi thog nas khyad par chen po 'gro yi yod red/ khyad par du sgom byed mkhan rnams la mthun rkyen za ma yag po bcud can dgos kyi red/ 'on kyang sbyin bdag rnams kyis dad pas phul ba'i rdzas rnams blangs te slob sbyong dang sgom gang yang ma byas par bsdad na ha cang nyes pa chen po yin gsungs pa red/ slob sbyong dang sgom byed mkhan tsho la gzhan gyis mthun rkyen phul na len dgos kyi yod red/ len dus mi la phan thogs kyi red bsams te bsod snyoms ji tsam dgos pa blangs nas slob sbyong dang sgom byas na dad rdzas zos pa'i nyes pa yod ma red/ dper na mchod rten 'dzam bu gling gang ba zhig bzos na bsod nams chen po yod red/ de las kyang slob sbyong byed mkhan gcig la mthun rkyen bsgrigs na bsod nams che ba red gsungs pa red/ slob sbyong byed mkhan stong phrag mang po la mthun rkyen phul ba las bsgom byed mkhan gcig la mthun rkyen phul na bsod nams che ba yod red ces mdo gcig gi nang gsungs 'dug / dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsgom dgos pa'i skor bshad pa/ dang po dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsgom pa ni/ dngos gzhi stan bde po zhig la bsdad nas skyabs 'gro byed dgos kyi red/ de yang sngon du zhus pa nang bzhin dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro mang du byas/ mdo yi lugs la bla ma la zur du skyabs 'gro ma byas na'ang 'grigs/ gal srid bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o zhes brjod dgos na dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o zhes brjod tshar ba'i rjes su brjod dgos/ sngags la yin na bsgyur bcos ma byas na 'grigs kyi red/ skyabs 'gro tshar dus blo chos su 'gro ba la sogs pa bzhi yis gsol ba thobs/

de nas sems bskyed la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob dgos/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i don dag la zhen pa bzhi bral bsgom gyi yin bsam/ de nas dngos gzhi dal 'byor rnyed dka' sgom pa'i tshul ni/ spyir btang chos sgrub pa la lus rten zhig dgos kyi yod red/ rigs drug gi nang nas mi yi lus rten ni yag shos red gsungs pa red/ de rnyed dka' ba bsgom pa la rim pa gsum yod red/ dang po dal 'byor gyi lus de thob khag po yin pa bsam pa dang/ gcig thob na lus des las mang po byed thub pas don dag gam phan thogs chen po yod par bsam pa dang/ da lan mi yi lus don dag chen po yin mkhan de thob dus don med ma byas par nges par chos gcig byed dgos bsam pa rnams yin/ thob dka' ba bsgom pa la don tshan bzhi gsungs pa red/ / ngo bo rgyu dpe grangs gsum gyi sgo nas dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba bshad pa/ 1 ngo bo'i sgo nas dal ba brgyad dang*/ 'byor ba bcu ste yon tan bco brgyad tshang ba'i mi yi lus 'di thob khag po yin pa bsam dgos kyi yod red/ dal ba zer dus chos sgrub pa la dal po yod pa'am/ mi khom pa ma yin pa ste chos sgrub pa'i go skabs yod pa la zer gyi yod red/ chos sgrub pa la mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad yod pa de dag tu skye ba ma blangs shing da lta mi khom pa ma yin pa'am chos sgrub pa la khom pa'i dus tshod red gsungs pa red/ 'byor pa zhes pa ni chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen la zer gyi yod red/ chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen rang gi ngos nas tshang dgos pa lnga la rang 'byor lnga zer gyi red/ gzhan gyi phyogs nas tshang dgos pa lnga la gzhan 'byor lnga ste bsdoms pas bcu bcas bco brgyad tshang ba la dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che zer ba red/ bco brgyad po de dag gang red 'dug so sos dpe cha la bltas nas nges par byas te bsgom dgos/ 2

rgyu'i sgo nas de 'dra ba'i mi lus rnyed dka' ba bsam pa ni/ da lta nga tshos mthong ba'i dngos po thams cad rgyu rkyen la brten nas skye dgos kyi yod red/ des na mi yi lus la'ang rgyu rkyen yod red/ de yi rgyu dge ba stobs chen po 'dul khrims lta bu sgrub mkhan ha cang dkon po yin pas 'bras bu dal 'byor gyi mi yi lus rten thob pa dkon po red gsungs pa red/ sems can mang che bas sdig pa gsog sdod kyi yod red/ ngan song nas ngan song la skor ba rgyag sdod pa ma gtogs mi lus thob mkhan dkon po yin pa red ces yang nas yang du bsam dgos/ 3 grangs kyi sgo nas thob dka' ba bsam pa ni/ grangs ka mang nyung gi thog nas bsam blo btang na yang rigs drug gi sems can rnams gong ma gong ma rnams las 'ogam 'og ma rnams mang ba yod red/ der brten mi yi lus rten thob pa nyung nyung red gsungs pa red/ nga tshos da lta mthong rgyu'i sems can ni mi dang dud 'gro gnyis red/ de gnyis kyi grangs ka 'gran bsdur byas pa yin na bsdur rgyu yod ma red/ dper na dbyar kha bkod ma'am chu mig gcig gi nang gi dud 'gro'am/ shing gcig gi rtsa ba la gnas pa'i dud 'gro'i grangs ka ni 'dzam bu gling gi mi thams cad la med/ des na grangs kyi sgo nas bsam blo btang na yang mi lus ni rnyed khag po yin zhes gsungs pa red/ 4 dpe yi sgo nas bsam na'ang/ gyang gi ngos la sran ma gtor na gyang la sran ma 'byar dka' ba nang bzhin mi lus thob dkon po dang / rgya mtsho chen po'i chu'i thog la gnya' shing bu ga gcig yod pa zhig phyogs bzhi'i rlung gis ded de/ chu de'i nang la rus sbal long ba zhig lo brgya re nas steng la re re yong gi yod pa de'i mgrin pa dang gnya' shing gi bu ga gnyis 'phrad srid pa tsam red/ de bzhin du mi yi lus rten thob khag po red gsungs pa red/ rnyed dka' ba'i lus rten 'di da lta thob cing bed spyod chos nas gsungs pa bzhin byas na lus rten 'dis mi tshe 'di'i 'dod don tsam min pa skye ba phyi ma mtho ris dang /

thar pa dang sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yang bsgrub thub pas ca lag gnad 'gag chen po red/ de 'dra'i las don nam dmigs yul gal chen po sgrub thub mkhan gyi rin po che yin pa'i ca lag gzhan dag yod ma red/ des na phan thogs sam don dag chen po red ces bsam dgos/ dper na a mi ri ka lta bu zhig la 'gro dgos pa'i 'grul pa gang zhig gnam gru da phan chad thob pa'i nges pa med pa'am thob khag po yod pa zhig la/ de ring gnam gru yod pa yin na de ring gnyid khug sdod kyi ma red/ dpe de bzhin du dal 'byor gyi lus 'di gnam gru dang gru 'dra po red/ lus rten 'di la brten nas 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las brgal thub pa byed dgos red/ dngos gnas 'khor ba las brgal thub pa'am thar pa thob thub pa'i chos shig byed dgos kyi yod red/ / 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i skor bshad pa/ gnyis pa 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i skor zhu rgyu yin/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa de shin tu gal chen po red/ chos gcig byed dgos bsam na'ang*/ mang che bas rjes ma byed chog bsam pa yong gi yod red/ de le lo red/ des na phyi bshol gyi bsam blo'am le lo de 'gog thabs dang / de ring nas bzung ste chos byed thub pa'i don du 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa'am bsgom dgos kyi yod red/ de la le tshan gsum yod red/ nges par 'chi ba bsam pa dang/ nam 'chi ba'i nges pa med pa bsam pa dang / 'chi dus chos kyis phan la chos ma yin pa gzhan gang gis kyang mi phan pa bsam pa dang gsum red/ re re la'ang rgyu mtshan gsum gsum gyi sgo nas sgom gyi yod red/ nges par 'chi ba bsgom pa'i skabs la dang po skyes tshar ba yin dus de'irgyu mtshan gyis nges par 'chi yi red bsam/ gnyis pa ni nga rang tsho'i gzugs po ni chu yi chu bur 'dra po 'jig sla ba nyams chung chung red/ de ni rjes su me la bsregs/ thal ba las med pa 'gro mkhan brtan po yod ma red bsam/

gsum pa ni nga rang tsho'i tshe srog ni skar ma dang / chu tshod/ nyin ma/ zla ba dang lo byas te bri ba'am thung du 'gro gi yod red/ tshe yi steng nas mar bri zhing rtsa ba nas sdod kyi med pa'i thog tu de la bsnan pa yod ma red bsam/ gnyis pa nam 'chi nges pa med pa bsam rgyu de gal chen po red/ de'ang rgyu mtshan gsum gyi sgo nas bsgom tshul gsungs yod/ dang po nga rang tsho 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi'i tshe la 'di tsam thub zer ba lta bu tshe tshad yod na 'chi ba'i dus la nges pa yod red de/ tshe tshad yod ma red/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis kyang ga dus 'chi min nges pa med bsam/ rgyu mtshan gzhan dag la/ ma shi ba gson por sdod pa'i mthun rkyen nyung nyung dang 'chi rkyen yang mang po yod red ces bsam/ 'chi rkyen mi byed pa'i dngos po 'di red ces mdzub mo btsugs sa rtsa ba nas yod ma red/ nges par 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe 'chi ba las bzlog thabs rtsa ba nas byed rgyu yod ma red/ nges par 'chi ba'i dus la ma bab na sman bcos dang / tshe dbang dang tshe sgrub sogs kyis 'chi ba bslu rgyu yod red de 'chi ba'i dus tshod la slebs dus rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis kyang de las thar thabs gnang rgyu yod ma red/ gsum pa 'chi dus chos ma yin pa gzhan gang gis kyang phan mi thogs par bsam pa de la yang gsum/ dngapo 'chi dus rang gi nye du dang*grogs po dang*/ 'khor de tshos phan thogs rtsa ba nas yod ma red/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal la bgo bsha' brgyab rgyu ni yod ma red/ 'chi ba'i skabs da lta mnyam du yod pa tsho'i nang nas rang gcig pu 'gro dgos kyi yod red/ gnyis pa longs spyod kyis kyang phan thogs kyi ma red/ gang lags she na/ so so gcig pu gcer bu lag pa stong pa byas nas 'gro dgos kyi yod red/ gsum pa ming dang go gnas de tshos kyang phan thogs kyi ma red/ kha shas rgyu mtshan gsum pa de lus kyis phan thogs kyi ma red gsungs kyi 'dug

lus kyang bzhag nas 'gro dgos kyi yod pas de 'dra gsungs pa 'dra/ gang ltar gson pa'i ring la rang gi gnyen nye ring gi don dag zas gos kyi don dag gzugs po'i don dag dang/ go gnas med pa/ 'thob pa dang yod pa mi shor ba'i don dag la sdig pa mang po bsags yod pa de tsho khur nas 'gro dgos red/ der brten 'chi ba mi rtag pa yang yang bsam pa'am sgom bsdad na 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i blo gcig skye yong gi yod red/ blo de skyes na chos ma gtogs pa'i las ka gzhan dag byed longs med pa zhig dang/ tshe 'di'i don gyi bya ba rnams ngal gso rgyab sa'i khang pa bzo ba lta bu gcig tu mthong yong gi yod red/ ngal gso brgyag dus chu tshod gcig gnyis sam nyin ma kha shas tsam red/ dngos gnas byas na de'i don du khang pa bzo dgos don yod ma red/ ma 'ongs par las ka 'di 'dra zhig byed dgos kyi 'dug ces 'char gzhi 'jog dus de'i nang la 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i tshogs mi de nges par du dgos kyi yod red/ des kha grags dgos kyi yod red/ de byung na khyad par 'gro gi yod red/ blo chos su 'gro ba'i thabs kyi gtso bo 'di yin zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ chos rnam dag gam rnal ma byed thub pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo ni 'chi ba bsam pa 'di red gsungs pa red/ des na thun grol tshar dus thun mtshams rnams kyi skabs su yang thun mtshams kyi bya ba dper na za ma yag po za ba/ gos bzang po gyon pa/ 'khor mang pos bskor nas skad cha 'chad pa'i skabs su 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dran dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ za ma yag po za dus da lta za ma yag po za yi 'dug ste rjes ma za ma kham gcig kyang mi 'gro mkhan/ za ma'i rjes ma de bza' dgos pa'i dus tshod gcig gtan gtan yong gi red bsam/ de bzhin du gos bzang po gyon dus da lta gos yag po 'dug ste rjes ma ro la bskon rgyu'i gos gcig gtan gtan gyon dgos yong gi red bsam/

gnyen dang 'khor mang pos bskor nas skad cha 'chad skabs da lta 'khor mang po 'dug ste rjes ma 'di tsho dang gtan bral byed pa'i dus tshod gcig yong gi red bsam/ 'di la sogs pa mdo yi nang 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom tshul mang po gsungs pa red/ de tsho yang nas yang du dran dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ rgyal sras thogs med kyis 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i blo skyes na chos byed rgyu la dka' las med pa dang / snying rje tshad ldan skyes byung na gzhan don byed pa la dka' ngal med pa dang/ bdag med pa'i go rtogs la goms na nyon mongs spong ba la dka' ngal med ces gsungs pa red/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul ston dus/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa red ces gsungs pa 'di khong gi gsung gi rjes ma de yin zhes gsungs srol yod red/ tshe 'di'i don 'grub pa la chos dang mthun pa byas na/ gzhan la gnod 'tshe med pa'i thog nas byed pa sogs legs pa yod red/ de ni chos med na'ang sgrub thub kyi yod red/ 'on kyang 'chi ba'i tshe chos ma gtogs pa gzhan gyis phan mi thogs pa yin dus chos ni med thabs med kyi gal chen po yin pa mdo yi nang du dpe mang po'i thog nas gsungs yod red/ dper na nad pa la sman dpyad dang/ dbul po la longs spyod dang/ lung pa gzhan dag tu 'gro ba la dngul dang rlangs 'khor dang gnam gru dang/ bkres pa la zas dang / skom pa la btung ba rnams nang bzhin 'chi ba'i tshe chos ni med thabs med zhig red gsungs pa red/ / las 'bras kyi skor mdor bstan pa/ las rgyu 'bras kyi skor zhu rgyu yin/ nga tshos da lta mthong bzhin pa'i phyi'i lung pa'i bkod dbyibs yid du 'ong mi 'ong sna tshogs dang*/ nang gi sems can gyi ris sna tshogs dang / de rnams kyi bde sdug sna tshogs pa 'di tsho gang 'dra byas nas byung ba red zer na/ chos lugs kha shas kyis rgyu med pa las byung ba red zer/

kha shas kyis dkon mchog gis byas pa red zer mkhan de 'dra yod red de/ nang pa sangs rgyas pas gsungs na rgyu rkyen tshogs pa las grub pa'i rten 'brel red gsung gi yod red/ de yang snod lta bu thun mong ba de tsho thun mong gi las las byung ba dang/ sems can gyi lus lta bu yin na so so'i thun mong ma yin pa'i las kyi stobs kyis byung ba red gsungs pa red/ des na las kyi skor bshad pa red/ las la mi dge ba/ dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi las te gsum bshad rgyu yod red/ / bye brag mi dge ba bcu yi skor rgyas par bshad pa/ dang po mi dge ba la/ mi dge ba'i las kyi ngo bo gang 'dra yin pa/ las des 'bras bu gang sprod kyi yod pa/ de shes tshar dus mi dge ba'i las de spang dgos snyam ste yang yang bsam pa don tshan gsum gyi thog nas bshad pa red/ dang po las mi dge ba'i ngo bo ni/ kun slong nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang*dang gti mug gsum gang rung gis byed pa'i las tshang ma la mi dge ba zer gyi yod red/ las zer na bya ba la zer gyi yod red/ las mi dge ba'i rtsa ba yin pa'i 'dod chags ni bde ba'i rgyu rkyen du snang ba'i srid pa'i dngos po tsho la dga' zhing zhen pa dang/ zhe sdang ni sdug bsngal gyi 'byung gnas tsho la mi dga' zhieng sems 'khrugs pa dang/ gti mug ni rang gi sgo gsum gyi bya ba las blang bya dang dor bya gang yin mi shes mkhan gyi sems byung la zer/ spyir las mi dge ba la mang po yod red de che ba rnams tshur bsdus na bcu yod gsungs pa red/ lus kyi las mi dge ba gsum/ ngag gi bzhi dang*/ yid kyi gsum bcas yin/ dang po lus kyi las gsum las srog gcod pa'i las ni/ gsad dgos bsam bzhin du*ma nor bar sems can gzhan zhig bsad pa la zer/ gsad dgos ma bsams nas 'gro ba'i skabs su rkang 'og tu 'bu lta bu shi song ba la srog bcad pa'i nyes pa yod ma red/

dper na dgra gcig gsad dgos bsams nas mi gzhan zhig shi song ba yin na de'ang srog bcad pa'i dngos gzhi'i nyes pa ma red/ rang gis rang bsad na'ang srog bcad pa'i dngos gzhi'i nyes pa med pa red/ rang gis gsad dgos bsams te gnod pa byas pa'i rkyen pas ga dus shi song na'ang shi ba'i skabs su srog bcad pa'i nyes pa yong gi yod red/ gcig la mngags nas srog bcad na'ang srog bcad pa'i nyes pa yong gi red/ gnyis pa ma byin pa len pa ni/ rkun ma rku ba la zer gyi yod red/ de yang btsan po byas nas dngos su len pa'am 'phrog na'ang 'dra/ lkog nas mi mthong ba byas nas brkus na yang gcig pa red/ de yang bsam bzhin du ma nor ba gcig dgos kyi yod red/ mi gzhan dag gcig mngags nas rku bcug na'ang gcig pa red/ /gsum pa log g.yem ni/ /log g.yem gyi sgo bzhi yod red/ bgrod bya ma yin pa zer na gzhan gyi chung ma lta bu rang la mi dbang bas longs spyod bya ma yin pa/ yul ma yin pa dper na sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs pa'i sa'am gnas khang lta bu/ dus ma yin pa nyin mo lta bu/ yang na rang gi chung ma'am bza' zla sbrum ma yin pa dang bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa srung ba'i skabs lta bu/ yan lag ma yin pa yan lag gzhan kha dang bshang lam lta bu/ nor ba yin na log g.yem gyi nyes pa med gsungs yod red/ mi tshangs spyod pa lta bu yin na nor ma nor khyad par med par snang / log g.yem la gang ltar ma nor ba gcig dgos kyi yod red/ log g.yem de gzhan la mngags nas las rdzogs rgyu yod ma red/ mi tshangs pa spyod pa de nyon mongs pas kun nas bslangs pa yin na mi dge ba red/ kun slong nyon mongs pa gsum gyis zer dus srog gcod pa lta bu gcig la dper brjod byas na/ sha za 'dod dam sha btsong nas dngul sgrub 'dod kyi thog nas dud 'gro gsod pa ni/ 'dod chags kyi sgo nas gsod pa dang / zhe sdang gi sgo nas dgra gsod pa lta bu dang /

gti mug gi sgo nas dmar mchod byed pa lta bu red/ dmar mchod byas na phan thogs yong gi red bsam pa de gti mug red/ mi dge ba gzhan la'ang de bzhin du rigs 'gres nas shes dgos/ ngag gi mi dge ba bzhi las rdzun smra ba'i las mi dge ba ni/ rdzun bshad dgos bsam bzhin du gang yang rung ba gcig la lab nas lab sa des go song na rdzun gyi mi dge ba rdzogs pa red/ phra ma ni pha rol po gnyis mthun po yin na'ang 'dra/ mi mthun pa yin na'ang 'dra/ de gnyis mi mthun pa byed dgos kyi 'dug bsams nas skad cha bden pa dang brdzun pa gang yang rung ba bshad nas pha rol pos go song na phra ma yi mi dge ba byas pa red/ tshig rtsub ni gzhan la skyon brjod byed pa de gzhan gyis go na de'i nyes pa rdzogs pa red/ ngag 'khyal ni rgya chen po red/ dper na nyon mongs pa'i sgo nas glu len pa dang/ sbyin bdag lta bu la ngo bstod phul ba dang/ dmag gi gtam dang smad tshong ma'i gtam bshad pa lta bu dang / de bzhin du chos lugs gzhan dag gi gzhung yid ches kyi sgo nas 'don pa tshang ma ngag 'khyal gyi las mi dge ba red/ de la mi yis go ma go khyad par med pa red/ lab tshar dus nyes pa byas tshar ba red/ ngag gi nyes pa bzhi ka'ang mi gzhan dag la de 'dra gyis shog ces bcol bzhag na'ang de dang de'i nyes pa yod red/ lus ngag gi mi dge ba bdun po de dag sngon ma zhus pa nang bzhin rgyu nyon mongs pas kun nas bslang dgos red ma gtogs spyir btang srog gcod pa lta bu mi dge ba yin pa'i khyab pa yod ma red/ de dag dge ba yin pa yang yod red/ lung ma bstan yin pa'ang yod red/ gsum pa yid kyi las mi dge ba gsum las brnab sems ni/ mi gzhan dag gcig gi longs spyod dam yid du 'ong ba'i ca lag de 'dra po nga la byung na sems pa la zer/ gnod sems ni/ gzhan la gnod pa byed dgos bsams te sems thag bcad pa/

log lta ni las rgyu 'bras dang tshe snga phyi zer ba rnams yod ma red/ dkon mchog bden pa ma red ces sems pa la zer/ de yang yod dam med/ yin nam min snyam du the tshom za ba la zer ba ma red/ las rgyu 'bras sogs med thag chod red ces sems pa la zer gyi yod red/ lus ngag gi mi dge ba bdun po rnams las snga ma snga ma rnams nyes pa che ba dang / yid kyi mi dge ba gsum las phyi ma rnams nyes pa che ba red/ /las kyi 'bras bu'i skor zhu rgyu yin/ las kyi 'bras bu la kha shas yod red/ mi dge ba bcu po'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ni ngan song gsum du skye ba red/ mi dge ba bcu po la chung ngu*dang/ 'bring dang chen po gsum gsum yod red/ che chung gi mtshams ni mi dge ba de rnams tshar mang po dang / kun slong drag po'i sgo nas byed pa dang/ mi dge ba byas tshar ba la byed nyes byas song bsam pa'i 'gyod pa med pa dang/ byed pa'i dus su ngo tsha dang khrel yang med pa'i khar yag po byung song bsams te dga' po byed pa de 'dra'i thog nas byas na mi dge ba chen por 'gyur gyi yod red/ de tsho 'bring tsam byas na 'bring po/ de rnams chung chung byas na mi dge ba chung chung red/ chen po de tsho'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bur dmyal bar skye/ 'bring pos yi dwags dang/ chung ngu de tshos dud 'gro la skye ba len par byed kyi yod red/ yang na kun slong gi sgo nas zhe sdang gi kun nas slong ba'i mi dge bas dmyal bar 'phen/ 'dod chags kyis yi dwags dang / gti mug gi sgo nas byas pa'i mi dge ba'i las kyi rnam smin dud 'gro la skye ba lta bu/ dper na mi gcig gis khong khro drag po langs te tshig ngan gcig lab pa yin na/ dmyal bar skye ba'i rgyu cha tshang rdzogs tshar yod red/ yang mi dge ba'i las kyi 'bras bu gzhan dag rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu zer mkhan gcig yod red/ de la yang myong ba rgyu mthun dang*/

byed pa rgyu mthun te gnyis yod red/ myong ba rgyu mthun zer ba ni/ dper na mi dge ba de tshos dang po 'bras bu ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal myong bar byed/ de nas mir skye ba blangs pa yin na'ang*srog bcad pas tshe thung ba/ ma byin pa blangs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis longs spyod dbul por gyur pa/ log g.yem byas pas chung ma yag po ma thob pa la sogs pa red/ byed pa rgyu mthun zer ba ni sngon ma srog bcad bsdad pa'i rkyen gyis da lta'ang srog gcod snying 'dod pa'am srog gcod pa la dga' ba/ rkun ma rgyag rgyur rang bzhin gyis dga' ba de tsho yong gi yod red/ las de dag gi 'bras bu gzhan dag gcig la bdag po'i 'bras bu zer gyi yod red/ de phyi rol khor yug gi steng du smin pa red/ dper na sngon ma srog bcad pa'i bdag po'i 'bras bur da lta sa phyogs gzi mdangs med sar skyes shing gnas dgos pa dang/ ma byin pa blangs pas char pa mang drags pa'am dkon po yod sa/ log g.yem byas pas sa phyogs rdul 'khrigs pa'am sa cha skyo po la skye ba blangs shing de 'dra la rgyun ring po gnas bca' ba dang/ de bzhin du lung pa skyo po ston 'bras kyi rigs yag po mi smin sa/ za ma'i rigs de tsho gzugs po la yag po mi 'phrod cing na tsha byed pa/ de min lung pa'i nang dmag 'khrugs sogs mang po yong ba/ gcan gzan gdug pa can gyi rigs yod sa/ rkun ma dang jag pa'ang mang po yod sa lta bur mi tshe bskyal dgos pa de tsho mi dge ba'i 'bras bu red/ mdor na sdug bsngal thams cad dang*/ mi 'dod pa yongs rdzogs mi dge ba'i 'bras bu yin pa red/ des na mi dge ba'i las ka rnams rang la sdug po sprod mkhan red 'dug/ de sngon mang po byas yod red/ de tsho byed nyes byas 'dug bsams te 'gyod pa byed/ da phyin chad srog la bab na'ang sdig pa rtsa ba nas mi byed bsam pa'i sdom sems byed dgos kyi yod red/

de ltar byas na sngar byas kyi nyes pa rnams dag cing phyi ma rnams 'gog gi red/ der brten sdig pa bshags rgyu gal chen po red/ / zhar byung stobs bzhi'i sgo nas sdig pa bshags tshul bshad pa/ sdig bshags byed stangs mang po yod red de yongs grags la sdig bshags byed pa'i skabs su stobs bzhi tshang dgos red gsungs pa red/ stobs bzhi ni/ sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ rten gyi stobs/ gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs dang nyes pa las sor chud pa'i stobs bcas bzhi yin/ de las dang po sun 'byin pa'i stobs ni/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod pa byed pa la zer/ dper na dug 'thungs pas de'i 'bras bu mthong nas 'gyod pa byed pa bzhin yin/ gnyis pa rten gyi stobs ni/ sdig pa las skyob nus kyi bshags yul rnams la bsten pa ste/ sman pa la bsten pa bzhin yin/ gsum pa gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs la drug gsungs kyi yod red/ dang po mdo sde klog pa/ gnyis pa stong pa nyid sgom pa/ gsum pa yi ge brgya pa lta bu bzlas pa byed pa/ bzhi pa sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs bzo ba/ lnga pa sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs la mchod pa phul ba/ drug pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mtshan blo la bzung ste yang yang skyor ba rnams yin/ bzhi pa nyes pa las ldog pa'i stobs ni/ bshags pas sdig pa dag pas da phyin chad mi byed bsam pa'i sdom sems byed pa la zer gyi red/ dus myur bar bshags pa byed thub pa bya dgos red/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ zhes pa'i bshags tshig 'di skyor bsdad na 'grig gi red/ / dge ba bcu dang de'i rnam smin 'bras bu sogs kyi skor bshad pa/ gnyis pa dge ba ni/ 'dod chags med pa/ zhe sdang med pa/ gti mug med pa zer mkhan gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yin pa'i sems dge ba gsum dang /
