dad pa dang byams snying rje sogs kyis kun nas slong ba'i sgo gsum gyi las sam bya ba rnams la dge ba zer gyi yod red/ kun slong de tsho'i thog nas mi dge ba bcu mi byed bsams te dge bsnyen lta bu'i sdom pa blangs/ de min na mi dge ba bcu rtsa ba nas mi byed bsam pa'i spong sems sam dam bcas mi dge ba'i las bcu spong ba la dge ba bcu zer gyi yod red/ dge ba'i las kyi 'bras bu 'chad dus mi dge ba'i 'bras bu rnams go ldog bzhag na snga ma dang gcig pa red/ de'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bu la mtho ris lha dang mi yi lus rten thob kyi yod red/ myong ba rgyu mthun la srog gcod spong bas tshe ring ba la sogs pa dang/ byed pa rgyu mthun la dge ba sgrub pa la rang bzhin gyis dga' po yong ba dang/ bdag po'i 'bras bu la sa phyogs yag por skyes shing 'tsho ba dang/ za ma dang gyon rgyu sogs yag po thob pa/ der ma zad dge ba bcu po rnams theg dman sems bskyed kyis sgo nas byed pa yin na dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob/ theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed kyi sgo nas bsgrubs na sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byed kyi red/ dge sdig gi las tshang ma la stobs che chung gi khyad par chen po yod red/ de yang dper na chos pa zhig gis mi tshe'i ring nyi ma rer mchod rten la skor ba re byed kyi yod na/ mi des de ring skor ba gcig rgyag pa dang*/ dus rgyun skor ba mi rgyag mkhan gyi mi gzhan zhig gis skor ba gcig rgyag pa gnyis po stobs che chung khyad par yod red/ nyin ma rtag par byed pa'i las de stobs che ba dang/ de bzhin du kun slong shugs che chung dang / rang dbang yod pa dang dbang med du bya dgos byung ba'i dge sdig ga re yin yang stobs che chung dang / de bzhin du gnyen po yod med kyis stobs che chung du gyur pa dper na sdig pa la 'gyod pa byas na sdig pa chung ba dang /

dge ba la 'gyod pa byas na dge ba chung ba dang / de ga nang bzhin mi dge ba 'di 'dra gcig ngas byas pa yin zhes gzhan la lab na nyes pa dag 'gro yi yod red/ dge ba 'di 'dra zhig ngas byas pa yin zhes gzhan la ngom ngom byas na dge ba de'i nus pa shugs chung du 'gro gi yod red/ de bzhin du yul gyi sgo nas kyang che chung gi khyad par dper na yul dkon mchog la dad pas mchod pa phul ba'am ma dad pas ma gus pa dang / pha ma la phan gnod byas pa'i dge sdig rnams stobs che ba dang / dkon mchog gi rten yod sar dge sdig ga re byed kyang stobs che ba lta bu/ de bzhin du dus tshod kyis kyang khyad par 'gro yi yod pa dper na sangs rgyas kyi dus chen bzhi la sogs par dge sdig gang yang rung ba byas na sa ya phrag bdun 'gyur 'gro yi yod red gsungs pa red/ / las kyi 'bras bu myong ba'i dus kyi khyad par bshad pa/ las kyi 'bras bu ga dus myong gi yod med kyi skor ni gnad 'gag chen po red/ de la 'bras bu myong nges pa dang myong ba ma nges pa ste gnyis gsung gi 'dug las stobs che ba de tsho'i 'bras bu myong bar nges pa red/ sems pa g.yengs nas kha ton byed pa lta bu'i las ni 'bras bu myong ba ma nges pa red/ myong ba nges pa de la rigs gsum yod red/ dper na pha ma la phan gnod byed pa lta bu las stobs chen de tsho'i 'bras bu tshe 'di la smin pa srid kyi yod red/ las de'i rigs la mthong chos myong 'gyur gyi las zhes zer gyi yod red/ nga rang tshos gsog pa'i las kha shas kyi 'bras bu skye ba rjes ma la smin gyi yod red/ de'i rigs la skyes nas myong 'gyur gyi las zhes zer gyi yod red/ las kha shas kyi 'bras bu skye ba gnyis pa phan chad la 'byung gi yod red/ de'i rigs la lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur gyi las zhes zer gyi yod red/ las kha shas yun ring po bsdad de chud zos mi 'gro bar dus la bab dus 'bras bu smin gyi red/

las rgyu 'bras go don chen po red/ mus chen sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa'i blo sbyong gi 'grel pa'i nang la las 'bras kyi skor ngo mtshar chen po 'dug nges par slob sbyong bya dgos sa red/ lung ma bstan gyi las ni nyon mongs pa dang dge ba'i sems gang gis kyang kun nas bslangs pa ma yin pa/ dper na gnyid khug pa dang / za ma za ba dang gos log gyon pa lta bu la ngos 'dzin gnang gi 'dug de ma bshad na'ang 'grigs kyi yod sa red/ kun mkhyen gyi 'grel pa 'di'i nang mi 'dug las de'i rigs la 'bras bu bde sdug gang yang thob rgyu yod ma red gsungs pa red/ yin na'ang de rnams dge ba la bsgyur thabs bya dgos red/ nye sngon 'di'i skor gcig zhus pa yin/ dper na stan la 'dug pa'i skabs sems can thams cad kyis rdo rje'i gdan thob par shog bsam pa dang/ phyi log la 'gro dus 'khor ba'i phyi log la 'gro gi yod bsam pa/ gnyid khug dus sems can thams cad kyis chos sku thob par shog bsam pa sogs mdor na sems can gyi don dag la smon lam chen po rgyag thub na lung ma bstan gyi las de tsho dge ba la bsgyur 'gro gi gsungs pa red/ de 'dra byed thub pa yin na 'gro song gtong mi dgos pa thabs mkhas po'i thog nas nyi ma re re la'ang bsod nams mang po gsog thub kyi yod red/ de tsho lag len bya dgos rgyu yin pa red/ mdor na gong du zhus pa'i thabs gsum la goms cha sprod pa'am bsgom pa'i sgo nas tshe 'di la zhen pa bcad nas tshe 'di blos gtong thub kyi yod na chos min pa gzhan mi byed mkhan zhig 'gyur yong gi yod pas chos pa ang dang po de red 'gro yi yod red/ de 'dra ma byung na'ang rang gis chos dper na thos bsam sogs gang byed kyang nges par tshe 'di la ma zhen pa ste tshe 'di'i don dag yin zhes ma bsams pa zhig dgos kyi yod red/ tshe 'di'i don dag yin bsam pa yin na phyi ma phan chad la phan thogs med pa 'dra/

jo bo rje la slob ma gcig gis (byang chub mchog ) khong gis sgom rgyag gi yin zhu dus/ de las ngan pa red/ sgom byed rgyu yod ma red gsungs pa red/ 'o na chos bshad na zhus pas/ de yang las ngan pa red ces gsungs pa red/ 'o na ga re bya dgos red zhu dus/ tshe 'di blos gtong dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ de nas gcig gis tshe 'di'i don dag la chos byas pas 'bras bu gang smin gyi red ces dri dus/ tshe 'di la smin 'gro gi red gsungs/ phyi ma la ga re byed kyi red zer dus/ phyi ma la dmyal ba'am yi dwags la 'gro gi red gsungs pa red/ des na tshe 'di'i don dag la chos byed na chos 'gyur gyi yod ma red/ der ma zad skye ba rjes mar ngan 'gro la mi 'gro ba'am/ mtho ris thob pa'i don dag la bsams te chos byas na 'khor ba'i rgyu red 'gro ba ma gtogs nyon mongs dang sdug bsngal las thar par byed pa'i lam rnam dag tu mi 'gyur/ so so rang nyid thar pa thob pa'i ched du yin bsams nas chos ga 'dra zhig byed na'ang theg dman gyi lam red/ des na sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i ched du yin bsam dgos kyi yod red/ chos gang byas kyang sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob pa'i ched du yin bsams na rang gi nyams len de zhen pa gsum dang bral ba 'gyur gyi yod red/ da lta nga tshos chos 'chad dus/ mgo la sems bskyed dang / mjug la bsngo ba byed kyi yod red/ de bzhin du dge ba gang bsgrub na'ang mgo la sems bskyed/ dngos gzhi dmigs pa med pa ste bdag med pa shes mkhan yin na so sos byed rgyu'i dge rtsa de bden par ma grub pa stong pa nyid yin bsam pa zhig dang*/ mjug la bsngo ba byed dgos kyi yod red/ kha sang las rgyu 'bras skor bshad pa red/ las rgyu 'bras la yid ches byed pa de 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba red/ de ha cang gal chen po yin gsungs pa red/

nga tsho'i sems rgyud la 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba yod na ngan 'gror 'gro mi dgos pa byed kyi yod red/ / tshe 'di'i ched du tshul khrims bsrungs ba chos min par bstan pa/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis gsungs pa'i zhen pa bzhi bral gyi tshigs bcad kha shas tshe 'di la zhen pa'i don tshan 'di dang 'brel nas gsungs pa red/ de yang / dang po tshe 'dir ma zhen pa/ /tshul khrims dang thos bsam sgom pa gsum/ /zhes bya ba gsungs pa ste/ tshe 'di la dmigs nas tshul khrims srung ba sogs kyies dge ba sgrub mkhan ni chos pa min gyi gshol la zhog/ tshe 'di'i don dag la tshul khrims srung ba sogs byed pa yin na de tsho chos ma red/ bzhag na legs pa red gsungs pa red/ thog mar tshul khrims bshad tsa na/ /tshul khrims ni mtho ris sgrub pa'i rtsa ba can te mtho ris kyi lus rten thob pa la tshul khrims dgos kyi red/ thar pa sgrub pa'i them skas can te thar pa sgrub pa la'ang tshul khrims dgos kyi red/ sdug bsngal spong ba'i gnyen po can te ngan song dang 'khor ba spyi'i sdug bsngal med par byed pa'am der mi skye ba byed pa la'ang tshul khrims dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ des na/ tshul khrims la med thabs mi gda' ste/ /zhes dmigs yul de tsho 'grub pa la tshul khrims ni med thabs med yin pa'i rgyu mtshan des na rang gi khas blangs pa'i tshul khrims bsrung rgyu ni shin tu gal chen po red gsungs pa red/ 'on kyang tshe 'di la zhen pa'i tshul khrims des skyon mang po byed kyi red gsungs pa red/ skyon gang dang gang byed kyi red zer na/ chos brgyad sgrub pa'i rtsa ba can/ /zhes pa ste bstod pa dang snyan grags dang*/ dpal 'byor la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi chos rnams sgrub cing / de'i khar/ tshul khrims ngan la gshe ba can/ /zhes pa ste tshul khrims gtsang ma'am yag po med mkhan rnams la smad pa byed cing/

tshul khrims rang las legs tsam yod mkhan rnams la phrag dog byed cing mi snyan pa bshad/ rang gi tshul khrims de dngos gnas byas na ngo lkog med mkhan gcig gal chen po red de g.yo sgyu'i sgo nas ngo lkog byed/ ngo lkog byed pa'i tshul khrims des 'bras bu ga re thob kyi red zer na/ des ngan 'gro la 'khrid par byed kyi yod pas/ /ngan 'gro sgrub pa'i sa bon can/ /zhes gsungs/ de lta bu'i tshul khrims ni bcos ma'i tshul khrims te tshul khrims tshad ldan ma yin pas de bzhag dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ 'o na tshul khrims med pa byas pa'am bsrung mi dgos pa red dam zer na/ rang gis tshul khrims gang khas blangs te srung gi yod pa de kun slong brjes te bcos pa'am yag po bzo dgos red/ yag po gang 'dra zhig tu zer na/ tshul khrims gang zhig la thar pa sgrub thub mkhan/ mtho ris sgrub thub mkhan/ sdug bsngal spong thub mkhan/ de 'dra'i tshul khrims yag po gcig dgos gsungs pa red/ / tshe 'dir zhen pa'i thos bsam chos min par bstan pa/ de nas/ thos bsam byed pa'i gang zag de/ /shes bya sgrub pa'i longs spyod can/ /zhes gsungs te shes bya zer na 'dir yon tan la go de'i don ni thos bsam gyi las ka ni shes bya rig pa'i gnas kyi longs spyod dam yon tan phyug po bzo mkhan dang / ma rig sel ba'i sgron me can/ /zhes gsungs te/ ma rig pa ni blang dor mi shes pa dang shes bya'i chos rnams kyi gnas lugs mi shes pa la zer zhing thos bsam gyi las ka ni ma rig pa'i mun pa de dag sel ba'am med pa byed mkhan gyi sgron me lta bu dang / 'gro ba 'dren pa'i lam rgyus can te so so rang nyid nam zhig rang mgo thon pa tsam min pa 'gro ba sems can gzhan rnams kyang thar pa'i lam la 'dren pa rgyus yod mkhan du 'gyur ba dang/ der ma zad thos bsam byed pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs yin pas/ chos kyi sku yi sa bon can/

/zhes kyang gsungs/ der brten/ thos bsam la med thabs mi gda' ste/ /zhes gsungs te thos bsam mi byed pa thabs rtsa ba nas yod ma red zer/ gang lags she na/ chos chos bzhin du byed pa la rang gi bya rgyu'i chos rnams nang don rig pa la slob sbyong byas pa'i sgo nas ma shes na chos tshul bzhin du byed mi shes pa'am/ slob sbyong ma byas na chos tshul bzhin du byed thub pa'i thabs yod ma red ces pa'i don bstan to/ /tshe 'di la zhen pa'i thos bsam de/ /zer dus da lta dpe cha ba tshos chos la slob sbyong byed pa'i skabs so so'i thos bsam gyi bya ba rnams tshe 'di la zhen pa'i thos bsam yin min ji ltar byas te rtogs dgos kyi red ces dri na/ 'og nas 'chad pa'i rtags sam skyon 'di tsho byung na tshe 'di la zhen pa'i thos bsam du 'gro ba yin/ de yang / nga rgyal sgrub pa'i longs spyod can/ /zhes gsungs te 'khor dang longs spyod sgrub pa'i sgo nas nga rgyal mang po gsog sdod mkhan/ thos bsam dman pa dang thos bsam mi byed mkhan tsho la brnyas bcos dang/ thos bsam rang las legs pa yod mkhan tsho la phrag dog de bzhin du rang gis chos bshad nas dngos su 'khor dang longs spyod sgrub pa sogs de 'dra'i rigs kyi thos bsam ni/ ngan 'gro sgrub pa'i rtsa ba can/ /zhes gsungs te skye ba phyi mar ngan song la khrid par byed pa'i rgyu red gsungs pa red/ de lta bu'i chos brgyad kyi thos bsam ni/ gshol la zhogs zhes gsungs te ma byas na legs pa red ces gsungs pa red/ sgom pa byed pa'i gang zag de/ nyon mongs spong ba'i gnyen po can/ /zhes gsungs te rang rang so so'i sems rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa rnams thos bsam tsam gyis spong mi thub par sgom nyams len gyis spong dgos kyi yod pas sgom ni shin tu gal chen po red/ 'khor ba'i rgyu zag bcas kyi las dang nyon mongs pa dang/ 'bras bu 'khor ba 'gro ba drug gi skye gnas rnams las thar pa yang sgom nyams len med na mi 'thob cing/

sgom byed na mthar thug dgra bcom pa'ang thob yong gi yod red/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i longs spyod can/ /zhes gsungs te de'i don ni sgom nyams len la brten nas nyams len pa rang nyid shes bya'i chos rnams kyi gnas lugs gsal por rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi longs spyod phyug po yod mkhan du 'gyur ba dang/ mthar thug la/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i sa bon can/ /zhes gsungs te sgom gyis rang nyid gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob ces pa'i don red/ des na sgom ni sangs rgyas thob pa dang gnas skabs thams cad du med thabs med pa zhig yin pas gtan gtan sgom byed dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ tshe 'di la dmigs pa'i sgom chen gyis tshe 'di la zhen te sgom nyams len byed kyi yod pa'i rtags mang po yod red ces gsungs pa red/ dper na/ dben par 'dod pa'i 'du 'dzi can/ /sgom byed dus gnas dben pa mi med sa rang gcig pu byas te sdod dgos kyi yod red ces gsungs pa bzhin chos brgyad kyi sgom byed mkhan de tshos ri mgo mthon po sa dben pa la phyin te der gnas bcas nas sdod kyang mi mang po bkug nas 'du 'dzi byed/ 'du 'dzi ni nyung mtha' mi gnyis gsum mnyam du 'du ba la zer/ long gtam smra ba zhes kha ton dang sgom brgyab dgos rgyu yin pa la de tsho ma byas par long gtam ste don med pa'i gtam mang po dang*/ grub 'bras med pa'i gtam bshad cing / thos bsam ni chos min gyi bya ba nang bzhin mi dgos pa red ces sogs zer te thos bsam byed mkhan tsho la skur 'debs mang po byed/ sgom byed mkhan yag po gzhan dag la phrag dog byed cing mi snyan pa bshad/ sgom zer dus rnam g.yeng dang bying rgod med pa byed dgos kyi yod red/ de rang gis sgom nyams len skabs dran shes kyi cha shas tsam med par yang na sems bying zhing rmugs/ yang na sems bsgom bya gang yin pa'i don la mi sdod par rnam g.yeng ngam rgod pa'i dbang du 'gro

de 'dra'i rtags mtshan byung na 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi sgom 'gyur gyi yod red/ de lta bu'i chos brgyad kyi sgom gyis phan mi thogs pas chos brgyad kyi bsam gtan gshol la zhogs/ zhes pa ste/ bzhag na legs pa red gsungs pa red/ / 'khor ba la zhen na nges 'byung min pa'i tshul bshad pa/ da de ring 'khor ba la zhen na nges 'byung min zhes pa'i tshig rkang pa gnyis pa de'i skor zhu rgyu yin/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la re ba rgyag pa la 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag tshang ma la skyon mthong zhing zhen pa log dgos kyi yod red/ 'khor ba la skyon ma mthong na de las gzhan zhig dgos bsam pa'i bsam blo yong gi ma red/ dper na ca lag dang*/ mi lta bu brje len byed dgos dus sngon ma de rnams kyi skyon nges par du mthong dgos kyi red/ de nas brje dgos pa'i bsam blo yong gi yod red/ 'khor ba la zhen pa log pa la 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sam skyon shes dgos kyi yod red/ de yang dang por 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mang po thos/ mang po bsam dgos kyi yod red/ tshar gcig thos na'ang 'khor ba la zhen pa log pa la tog tsam phan gyi red de rgyun ring sdod kyi ma red/ dper na rdo yi steng na char pa babs dus de'i nang ma sbang ba yin pas char pa chad dus rdo de skam por 'gyur 'gro gi yod red/ des na tshar gcig thos pa tsam la de tsam gyi phan thogs chen po med pas yang nas yang du bsams nas 'khor ba spong 'dod kyi blo ma skyes bar du goms 'jug dgos kyi yod red/ / 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs spyir bshad pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bshad pa'i skabs su/ dang po 'khor ba spyi yi nyes dmigs bshad/ de nas so so'i nyes dmigs bshad de don tshan gnyis byas nas zhu rgyu yin/ 'khor ba la nyes pa'am skyon bsam gyis mi khyab pa mang po yod pa de'i nang nas che ba de tsho bsdoms nas sdug bsngal gsum dang/

yang na sdug bsngal brgyad/ yang na sdug bsngal drug ces gsungs pa de 'dra yang yod/ sdug bsngal zhes pa'i don ni cung zad go khag po red/ de la sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang / 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal te sdug bsngal gsum yod/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal zer ba de lus dang sems kyi tshor ba sdug bsngal dang de tsho'i mnyam du yod pa'i sems sems byung rnams dang*/ tshor ba de rnams 'byung sa'i yul zag bcas kyi chos dang bcas pa tshang ma la zer gyi yod red/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ lus sems kyi tshor ba bde ba*dang de dag gi grogs sems sems byung yul dang bcas pa la zer/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ni/ bde ba'ang ma yin sdug bsngal yang ma yin pa'i tshor ba btang snyoms dang*/ de'i grogs sems sems byung dang / de tsho skye ba'i yul zag bcas dang bcas pa la zer gyi yod red/ mngon pa las de ltar gsungs pa red/ dpal chos kyi grags pas/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa las byung ba'i 'bras bu zag bcas thams cad khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal zer gyi red gsungs pa red/ zag bcas ni chos gang zhig la brten nas nyon mongs pa skye zhing rgyas su rung ba la zer gyi yod red/ sdug bsngal gsum khrid byas te sgom pa'i skabs su lam 'bras dang 'di rnams gcig pa red 'dug sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal ni ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal dang / 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ni mtho ris kyi sdug bsngal dper na phyug po dbul por 'gro ba lta bu dang / khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ni las ka rdzogs mtha' med pa lta bu la ngos 'dzin gnang ba red/ sdug bsngal brgyad ni/ dang po skye ba'i sdug bsngal ma yi mngal du gnas pa'i gnas skabs dang*/ skye ba'i gnas skabs na sdug bsngal drag po yong gi yod red/ gnyis pa rgas pa'i sdug bsngal la mang po yod pa dper na gzugs mdzes pa mi mdzes par gyur pa/

lus ngag yid gsum gyi stobs yod pa med par gyur pa/ na tsha med na'ang rgas kyi yod pa de la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mang po yod red/ gsum pa na ba la dper na/ zug brgyab pa dang gshags bcos 'dra po sman bcos dka' las khag po byed dgos pa dang / longs spyod zad pa la sogs pa'i skabs sems sdug rigs mi 'dra ba mang po yod/ bzhi pa shi ba la yang sdug bsngal mang po red/ dper na shin tu gces pa'i lus longs spyod dang bcas pa rang la yod pa tshang ma g.yug dgos dus sems la mya ngan gyi tshor ba drag po'am chen po yong gi yod red/ lhag par du sdig pa tshabs chen byed mkhan tsho la dmyal ba'i snang ba 'char te zhed snang chen po yong gi yod red/ de min chos tog tsam go myong ba yin na'ang lag len byed rgyu ma byung ba tshor de'i skabs la 'gyod pa chen po skye gi yod red/ lnga pa dgra sdang ba dang 'phrad pa'i sdug bsngal dper na mi sger so so la yin na'ang 'dra/ tshogs pa dang lung pa spyi la yin na'ang 'dra/ dgra dang 'phrad pa tsam gyis lus dang sems la sdug bsngal rigs mi 'dra ba mang po yong gi yod red/ drug pa gnyen byams pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ rang rang so so'i pha ma gnyen tshan byams pa rnams su dang gnas skabs sam lhag par du gtan du kha bral dus sems la bzod mi thub pa'i mya ngan yong gi yod red/ bdun pa re ba'i 'bras bu med pa'i sdug bsngal ni/ dper na tshong pa rnams la tshong yag po ma byung ba dang*/ so so'i chos dang 'jig rten gyi las don 'grub pa'i don du mi gzhan zhig la re ba brgyab nas de ma byung ba la sogs pa'i skabs sems la dka' ngal chen po yong ba sogs mdor na rang gi re ba'am 'dod pa gang yod pa sems la bsam pa nang bzhin mi 'grub pa'i sems kyi sdug bsdul sna tshogs pa la zer gyi red/ brgyad pa mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga ni sdug bsngal lo zhes gsungs pa red/

nyer len gyi phung po zer na/ so so'i gzugs po dang sems 'di tsho red/ des nyon mongs pa gzhan dag dang sdug bsngal gyi rten byed cing / khong tsho yang khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi ngo bo red/ sdug bsngal drug ni/ dang po dgra dang gnyen la nges pa med pa/ gnyis pa 'dod pas tshims pa med pa ste dper na bza' btung gi rigs la ci tsam zhig longs spyad na'ang tshims pa med pa dang / dpe de bzhin du 'khrig spyod kyi las ga tshad longs spyad na'ang tshims pa med pa de'ang skyon red/ gsum pa lus mang po 'dor dgos pa'i sdug bsngal ni nged tsho 'khor ba la nam yong ba'i thog ma yod ma red/ thog ma med pa'i dus nas byung sdod pa yin pas sems can mang po'i lus mang po blangs te dor tshar yod red/ bzhi pa tshur lus mang po blang dgos pa de red/ da dung yang las dang nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las ma thar bar du sems can re re'i skye ba tshad med pa mang po zam ma chad par blang dgos pa'ang 'khor ba'i skyon nam sdug bsngal zhig red/ lnga pa mtho dman nges pa med pa'i sdug bsngal ni mthon po dma' bor gyur/ phyug po dbul por gyur pa de tsho red/ drug pa ni shi ba'i gnas skabs na rang nyid grogs med gcig pu 'gro dgos pa de red/ / dmyal ba tsha grang dang nye 'khor gyi sdug bsngal bye brag tu bshad pa/ da sems can so so'i sdug bsngal zhu rgyu yin/ de'i nang nas dmyal ba la grang dmyal gyi skor zhus na/ grang dmyal ni sa cha gangs ri dang 'khyags roms/ kha ba bab sdod sa de 'dra/ gyon gos med pa/ khang pa med pa de 'dra red/ dmyal ba'i gnas de tsho la snang ba yang yod ma red/ de la brgyad yod red/ dang po chu bur zer ba'i grang dmyal ba ni/ shin tu grang ba'i stobs kyis lus po la chu bur mang po byung ba dang/ gnyis pa chu bur brdol ba zhes bya ba'i grang dmyal ba ni/ shin tu grang bas lus kyi chu bur brdol nas rmar gyur pa dang/

gsum pa a chu zer ba ni/ shin tu grang nas a chu zhes rang dbang med par sdug skad rgyag pa dang / bzhi pa kye hud zer ba ni/ skad shugs chung chung kha de tsam grags mi thub mkhan de 'dra yod/ lnga pa so tham tham pa zer ba ni/ kha grags mi thub cing so tham tham dang lus po 'dar shig shig byed pa/ drug pa utpal ltar gas pa ni/ utpal sngon po nang bzhin gzugs po sngon po chags nas tshal pa mang po gas pa/ bdun pa padma ltar gas pa ni/ me tog padma nang bzhin mdog dmar po phar gog nas sngon po chags 'gro zhing dum bu kha shas gas song ba/ brgyad pa padma ltar cher gas pa ni/ de yang dum bu mang po nang khrol dang bcas pa tshos gzhi dmar po byas nas gas 'gro ba de tsho red/ nga tsho mi la dmyal ba pa de rnams kyi sdug bsngal de dag skar ma gcig la byung ba yin na'ang shi 'gro gi yod red/ yin na'ang dmyal ba'i sems can de rnams rang rang gi las kyi dbang gis shi rgyu med par yun ring po gcig sdod kyi yod red/ tsha dmyal brgyad las dang po yang sos ni/ sems can de tsho brdzus te skye 'gro gi yod red/ skye tshar dus de na yod pa'i sems can rnams phan tshun dgra sha stag tu mthong zhing lag par rang bzhin gyis mtshon byung ste gcig gis gcig gsod res byed cing / dngos su shi yi yod ma red de tog tsam brgyal 'gro ba dang*/ yang yar sos/ yang sngar bzhin phan tshun gsod res byed pa'i sdug bsngal de 'dra'i rigs myong bzhin gnas pa dang / gnyis pa thig nag ni/ dmyal ba'i las byed rnams kyis lus po la thig mang po brgyab nas sta re bsnun te gshags kyi yod red/ gsum pa bsdus 'joms zer ba ni/ ri dud 'gro'i gdong pa 'dra po de 'dra'i bar lam na yang yang dmyal ba'i las byed rnams rgyugs te de gnyis bar lam 'thab/ khrag 'bab pa la sogs pa kha shas yod sa red/ bzhi pa ngu 'bod zer ba ni/ lcags kyi khang pa sgo med pa me 'bar ba gcig gi nang bsregs nas ngu skad brgyab pa de red/

lnga pa ngu 'bod chen po zer ba ni/ khang pa nyis rim nang tshud nas sngon ma'i sdug bsngal las che tsam myong ba zhig yod/ drug pa tsha ba dang bdun pa rab tu tsha ba zer ba de lcags kyi gsal shing rtse gsum pa gcig yod pa de'i rtse la bskon nas mnar gcod byed pa de red/ brgyad pa mnar med zer ba de ni sdug bsngal che shos red/ dmyal ba'i lus dang me gnyis khyad par dbye mi thub pa'i rang bzhin can/ sdug bsngal che shos myong dgos pa de yin pa red/ spyir dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal la rigs mang po yod red/ dper na lcags bsregs kyi dum bu za dgos pa/ lcags bzhus pa'i khu ba 'thung dgos pa/ kha shas lcags me 'bar ba'i lcags leb kyi nang du lus dril ba/ kha shas lcags me 'bar bar thag pas bsdams pa la sogs pa mang po yod red/ nye 'khor ba zer ba de ni tsha dmyal gyi 'khor red/ tsha dmyal brgyad po'i re re'i 'khor la phyogs bzhi la sdug bsngal mi 'dra ba bzhi bzhi byas pas bcu drug yod red/ me ma mur zer ba ni/ me 'dag gi nang la 'gro nas gzugs po 'tshig 'gro ba de 'dra zhig yod/ gnyis pa ro myags kyi 'dam zer ba ni/ ro rul song ba de'i nang la 'gro skabs dri ma ngan pa kha ba/ de'i nang la 'bu yod red/ 'bu des lus po phug yong gi yod red/ gsum pa mtshon cha'i skor red/ spu gri'i lam zer dus ral gri mang po yar slong bsdad pa'i lam/ de na rkang pa mar bzhag na 'bigs 'gro mkhan/ rkang pa yar len dus sos 'gro ba de 'dra gcig yod red/ de nas ral gri lo ma'i nags tshal zer ba zhig yod pa nags tshal de'i yal ga de tsho mtshon cha red/ de tsho rang gi thog la bab nas sdug bsngal tshad med pa myong gi yod/ yang mtshon cha'i ri bo'am shal ma la yi sdong po zer ba zhig yod/ de na log g.yem byed mkhan dang*/ longs spyod la chags zhen chen po byed mkhan de tsho der skyes te ri de'i rtsa ba nas so sos 'dod chags byed sa'i bud med de der yod pa'i snang ba 'char/

so sos da lta chags zhen chen po byed sa'i longs spyod de tsho de na yod pa'i snang ba 'char/ de na phyin te rtsa ba na slebs dus khyi chen po gcig gis za yi yod red/ ri de nas yar 'gro dus yal ga de tsho kha thur du bstan te gzugs po phug yang snga ma'i bud med de ri mgo la yod pa'i snang ba 'char yong gi yod red/ thog kha la slebs dus de tsho'i shul yang yod ma red/ de ru bya chen po gcig bsdad yod red/ des klad pa dang mig sogs bru yi yod red/ yang chags yul dang longs spyod de tsho gsham la yod pa'i snang ba 'char/ yang gsham la mar yong dus mtshon cha de tsho kha gyen la bstan/ de 'dra'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa zhig yong gi yod red/ de nas nyi tshe ba'i dmyal ba zer ba gcig yod red/ de sdug bsngal chung ba'i gras red/ de dmyal ba'i gnas dang mi yi gnas gang sar yod red/ nyin mo bde po yin pa dang mtshan sdug bsngal yin pa de 'dra yod red/ yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal bshad pa/ gnyis pa yi dwags skor zhu rgyu yin/ yi dwags de la rigs mi 'dra ba gsum yod red/ spyir btang yi dwags la sdug bsngal mang po yod red/ de'i nang nas sdug bsngal chen po bzhi yod red/ dang po/ yi dwags la bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal dang / gnyis pa/ 'jigs skrag chen po dper na mi mtshon cha khyer mkhan 'dra po mthong na zhed snang chen po byed kyi yod pa dang / gsum pa/ za ma 'tshol ba'i don dag la gzugs po yag po med cing thag ring po 'gro dgos pa sogs dka' ngal chen po dang/ de bzhin du dmigs bsal tsha grang gi sdug bsngal yod red/ bzhi pa/ dper na dgun khar nyi ma yang grang mo chags/ dbyar khar zla ba yang tsha po chags song ba lta bu/ de 'dra'i sdug bsngal chen po bzhi yod red/ yi dwags rigs gcig za ma 'dra po mthong byung na yang mtshon cha khyer mkhan 'dra pos bkag ste mi gtong ba byed kyi yod red/

rigs gcig la de 'dra 'gog mkhan med na'ang gzugs po rang bzhin gyis skyo po dang mig ha cang chung chung*/ khab kyi mig tsam ma gtogs yod ma red/ mgrin pa skra tsam/ grod pa chen po lung pa tsam/ rkang pa de tsho rtsa nyag tsam ma gtogs yod ma red/ der brten za ma ngan ngon mi gtsang ba 'dra po gcig thob na'ang ser sna goms pa'i dbang gis dang po de za mi bra/ gcig zos na'ang kha nang ma chud/ mid pa'i nang ma thar/ khog pa'i nang slebs na'ang khog pa shin tu che bas phan thogs yod ma red/ yang rigs gcig la za ma de grod pa nang phyin na me 'bar 'gro mkhan gyi rigs gcig yod red/ yi dwags de tshos shing 'bras bu yod mkhan de 'dra mthong na mthong ba tsam gyis shing de skam po chag yong gi yod red/ kha shas chu chen po de 'dra mthong dus chu de skam po chag 'gro yi yod red/ kha shas rnag la 'gyur 'gro yi yod red/ yi dwags su skye ba'i rgyu ni spyir btang kha sang las rgyu 'bras skabs bshad pa ltar ser snas byed kyi yod red/ dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal bshad pa/ dud 'gro'i skor zhu rgyu yin/ dud 'gro mang che ba'i gnas ni rgya mtsho red/ rgya mtsho'i nang dud 'gro'i rigs mang po yod red/ de tsho la spyi yongs nas grogs la nges pa med pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal mang po yod red/ khyad par du dud 'gro'i dmigs bsal sdug bsngal ni dud 'gro gcig gis gcig za ba de red/ chen po gcig gis chung chung mang po mnyam du gson po za ba/ chung chung mang pos rub brgyab ste chen po gcig za ba/ kha 'thor ba'i dud 'gro ni lha dang mi yi lung pa la yod red/ de'i nang nas dper na ri dwags sha ba lta bu rtag par zhed snang dang dngangs skrag chen po yod red/ mi phal cher blo mi bde ba yod red/ khyi phal cher ltogs po yod red/ ri dwags phal cher zhed snang chen po yod red ces gcig gis gsungs 'dug

mi yi bdag bzung byed pa'i dud 'gro de tsho ni bdag pos las ka dka' las khag po bskul te tha mar gsod kyi yod red/ dud 'gro de tsho gsod mkhan shin tu mang po yod red/ sha dang pags pa la sogs pa'i don tu kho rang tsho nang khul dang*/ mi yis kyang gsod kyi yod red/ dud 'gro'i rigs mang po la so so rang nyid srung skyob bya rgyu'i khang pa dang mtshon cha sogs yod ma red/ mi yi za ma legs shos de sha yin stabs dud 'gro rnams dka' ngal chen po yod pa mthong chos red/ mi yi sdug bsngal bshad pa/ da mi yi sdug bsngal zhu rgyu yin/ nga rang tsho mi la rigs drug gi sdug bsngal 'dra po cha tshang yod red/ dper na tsha grang gyi sdug bsngal dang / de'i steng la mi gzhan dag gis gsod pa/ gtub pa/ me la sreg pa la sogs pa dmyal ba dang cha 'dra ba'i sdug bsngal dang / yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal dang cha 'dra ba bkres skom dang / dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal dang cha 'dra ba gzhan gyi dbang yod dang*/ phyug po rnams kyis las ka la bkol ba'i bkol spyod yod red/ lha ma yin gyi sdug bsngal dang cha mtshungs pa 'thab rtsod gyi sdug bsngal mi sger dang sger 'khrugs pa rgyag pa dang / rgyal khab dang rgyal khab dmag 'khrugs byed kyi yod red/ lha yi sdug bsngal dang cha 'dra ba mthon po dma' ru 'gro ba lta bu dang / gzhan yang mi rgyu dang go gnas che ba rnams la sems kyi sdug bsngal che ba dang / skyo ba rnams la lus sam gzugs po'i sdug bsngal che ba dang mang ba yod red/ dngos gnas byas na tshang ma sdug bsngal yin pa red/ de yang dper na tshe thung na yun thung drags pa'i sdug bsngal/ tshe ring na rgas pa'i sdug bsngal/ dbul po yin na dka' ngal chen po 'dug dran gyi yod red/ phyug po yin na'ang dka' ngal yod red/ zag bcas kyi chos re la sdug bsngal re dang sdig pa re yod red/ mi mang na rnyog dra mang ba'i sdug bsngal dang /

nyung na rogs pa nyung drags pa'i sdug bsngal lta bu/ 'gro na'ang sdug bsngal red/ sdod na'ang sdug bsngal red/ dper na 'gro drags dus bsdad na spro bo yod red de/ de bde ba ma red/ sdug bsngal brje len byed pa la spro snang 'char gi yod red/ sdod pa de dngos gnas kyi bde ba yin na ga tshod sdod na'ang bde ru 'gro dgos kyi yod red de/ yun ring sdod drags na dka' ngal chags kyi yod red/ de bzhin du 'gro ba'ang de 'dra rang red/ mdor na tshang ma sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin red/ dper na nga tshos sdug bsngal srung skyob byed kyi yod red/ de'i don du nga tshos brel ba byed kyi yod red/ dper na za ma zos pa'i rjes su chu tshod gnyis gsum nas grod pa ltogs tshar yod red/ za ma zos pa de yun ring sdod kyi ma red/ yang za ma zos pa de ga rang gis dka' las sprod kyi yod red/ tsha grang la cha bzhag na dug log gi dka' ngal byed kyi yod red/ mdor na nga tshos sdug bsngal la srung skyob byed pa'i las ka rkyang pa byed kyi yod red/ mdor bsdus na skyid po ga tshad yin na'ang 'dus byas mtha' bzhi las ma 'das pa gsungs pa red/ de'i don ni 'dus byas thams cad mtha' bzhi las 'gro sa yod ma red/ mtha' bzhi ni skye ba'i mtha' ma 'chi rgyu red/ tshur 'dus pa'i mtha' ma 'bral ba dang/ bsags pa'i mtha' ma 'dzad zer ba dngul lta bu rgyu nor ga tshod gsog sdod na'ang rjes ma gtan gtan rdzogs 'gro gi yod red/ brtsigs pa'i mtha' ma 'gyel zer ba khang pa lta bu brtsigs pa de tsho rjes ma 'jig 'gro gi red gsungs pa red/ lha yi sdug bsngal bshad pa/ da lha yi sdug bsngal bshad kyi yin/ lha la rigs gnyis yod/ rigs kha shas dpal 'byor dang 'dod yon tshang ma mi dang 'gran rgyu med pa de 'dra yod pas skyid po yod red/ yin na'ang de la'ang dka' ngal yod red/ lha ma yin dang 'khrugs pa brgyab nas sdod dgos kyi yod red/

lha kha shas dbul po yod red/ pus mo min pa ca lag gzhan med pa tha na de 'dra'i rigs kyi dka' ngal yod mkhan kyang yod/ shi dus dka' las khag po yod red/ shi rtags gzugs mi mdzes pa chags 'gro gi yod red/ me tog gi phreng ba rnying pa chags pa lta bu shi rtags bcu yong gi yod red/ de 'dra byung na rang gi grogs de tshos blos gtong gi yod red/ rgyang ring po nas me tog sprad/ ga le phebs zer ba 'dra po byas/ de nas so so'i grogs po dang grogs mo de tsho gzhan dag mnyam du 'gro ba mthong dus so so shi rgyu yin pa shes/ de 'dra yin stabs sems la dka' ngal ha cang chen po yong gi yod red/ dmyal ba'i lus kyi sdug bsngal las kyang lha'i 'chi kha'i sems kyi sdug bsngal de che ba yod red gsungs pa red/ sdug bsngal de ni nyi ma kha shas tsam gyi ring ma red/ mi yi tshe tshad lta bu byas na lo stong phrag mang po la sdug bsngal de myong dgos kyi yod red/ khams gong ma la lha zer mkhan yod red/ de tsho la sdug bsngal dngos su yod ma red/ yin na'ang sems kyi thog la mi dge ba'i sa bon yod red/ der brten slar tshe 'phos yong dus ngan song du 'gro gi yod red/ ston par 'khor ba la skyon gang yod red ces zhus dus/ sdug bsngal ba dang mi rtag pa'i skyon gnyis yod red gsungs pa red/ 'di sdom tshig chen po red/ sdug bsngal ni mi 'dod pa red/ mi rtag pa ni 'dir bde ba la gsungs kyi yod red de bde ba de tsho rtag pa yod ma red/ de gnyis cha skyon red gsungs pa red/ / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la bsam pa'i phan yon bshad pa/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal de tshor bsams te ga re byed dgos red zer na/ sdug bsngal de tsho sems can la tsho bgos byas nas sems can gcig gi sdug bsngal gcig gis khur rgyu de 'dra yod ma red/ so sos da lta bar du bsags pa'i sdig pa'i las rnams kyi 'bras bu sdug bsngal de tsho tshang ma so sos myong dgos yod red/

da dung yang thar pa ma thob pa yin na mtha' med pa dang tshad med pa'i bskal pa'i bar du sdug bsngal cha tshang so sos myong dgos kyi yod red/ 'khor ba 'di btson ra chen po 'dra po red/ btson khang gi nang la btson pa rnams lcags sgrogs kyis bsdams te sdug bsngal mang po myong gi yod red/ de bzhin du 'khor ba 'di'i nang la nyon mongs pa'i sgrogs kyis bsdams te 'khor ba'i sems can rnams sdug bsngal mang po myong dgos kyi yod red/ des na 'khor ba 'di btson ra yin bsams/ btson khang de'i nang tshud pa'i btson pa de tshos btson khang 'di'i nang nas thar na dran gyi yod red/ de bzhin du 'khor ba 'di nas thon dgos kyi 'dug/ 'khor ba 'di bzhag dgos kyi 'dug 'khor ba 'di nas thar dgos kyi 'dug bsam pa'i blo la nges 'byung zer gyi yod red/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la zhen chags byed mkhan su yang yod ma red/ dud 'gros kyang byed kyi ma red/ 'khor ba'i phun tshogs 'dod yon la sogs pa la rmongs pa rnams ha cang dga' po byed kyi yod red/ des na de spong dgos kyi yod red/ 'khor ba'i phun tshogs ni dug gi 'bras bu 'dra po red/ dug gi 'bras bu za dus zhim po yod red*/ 'on kyang des lus dang srog la skyon byed kyi yod red/ 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la zhen pa byed pa ni phra men ma'i bu mo mna' ma blangs pa 'dra po red/ 'phral du dga' po byed kyi yod red de phugs la des gsod kyi red/ dper na nags tshal me 'bar song na de'i nang la yod pa'i bya de tsho zhed snang gi thog nas bros 'gro gi yod red/ dpe de bzhin du 'khor ba 'di la zhed snang byed pa'i sgo nas 'khor ba g.yug dgos kyi 'dug bsam dgos kyi yod red/ klu sgrub kyis gsungs pa red/ dper na mgo la me shor/ dug log la me shor byung na las ka gzhan dag bzhag nas me de 'gog thabs las ka byed dgos red/

de'i phyir mgo dang gos la me byung na de bzlog rgyu phar bzhag nas 'khor ba nas thar thabs byed pa de gal che gsungs pa red/ de'i don dag lus dang srog la ma ltos nas 'khor ba spong thub thabs las ka byed dgos red gsungs pa red/ / chos 'chad nyan skabs kyi kun slong ji ltar byed dgos pa'i skor bshad pa/ chos 'chad mkhan gyis kun slong yag po dang bshad rgyu yang ma nor ba byed dgos/ nyan mkhan gyis kyang nyon mongs pa spang dgos bsams nas nyan rgyu'i chos rnams kyang gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob pa'i ched du yin bsams nas don gnyer byas te yag po nyan na 'chad nyan byed mkhan gnyis ka la dge ba gzhan dag las lhag pa'i bsod nams chen po yod gsungs pa red/ kun slong de lta bu'i sgo nas byed pa'i 'chad nyan gyi las rnams theg pa chen po'i lam yang red/ der ma zad chos 'chad nyan gyi ched du dbugs gcig gtong ba dang*/ gom pa gcig spo ba yang bsod nams chen po yod gsungs pa red/ / nyon mongs kyi skor bshad pa/ 'khor ba rgyu 'bras bshad pa'i skabs 'khor ba'i rgyu las dang / 'bras bu 'khor ba de tsho zhus grub pa red/ yin na yang las las kyang nyon mongs pa gal che ba red/ gang yin zhe na/ nyon mongs pa rkyang pas 'khor bar 'khor ba byed thub kyi yod red/ dper na khong khros dmyal bar skyed par byed pa lta bu/ nyon mongs pa dang ma 'brel ba'i las rkyang pas sdug bsngal skyed thub kyi yod ma red/ des na 'khor bar skyed par byed pa'i rgyu dang rkyen gnyis kyi thog nas bsam blo btang na'ang nyon mongs pa rnams rgyu'i gtso bo yin pas nyon mongs pa la bag yod dam gzab gzab bya rgyu gal che/ 'khor ba spang ba la'ang las spangs te 'khor ba spangs nas thar pa bsgrub rgyu de dgos pa med pa'i rgyu mtshan gsum yod red ces sa skya paṇḍi tas gsungs pa red/ des na nyon mongs pa'i skor tog tsam zhu gi yin/

nyon mongs pa zer ba ni sems ma zhi bar byed mkhan gyi sems kyi rnam 'gyur la zer gyi yod red/ nyon mongs pa la spyir btang mang po yod sa red/ 'on kyang gal che ba de tsho tshur bsdus na/ rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa drug dang*/ nye ba'i nyon mongs pa nyi shu yod red gsungs pa red/ de la rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa drug ni/ 'dod chags/ zhe sdang*/ gti mug gsum ste 'di tsho gong du zhus zin pa yin/ de tsho gsum gyi thog la bzhi pa nga rgyal ni gzhan las nga drag pa yin sems pa'i bsam blo lta bu la zer gyi red/ lnga pa nyon mongs pa'i the tshom ni las rgyu 'bras yod dang med/ bden pa bzhi ni bden pa yin dang min bsam pa la zer gyi red/ nged tsho'i sems kyi steng du 'char rgyu'i the tshom tshang ma nyon mongs pa ma red/ dper na sang nyin char pa brgyab kyi yod dam med bsam pa lta bu/ rtsa nyon drug pa ni nyon mongs pa'i lta ba red/ nyon mongs pa'i lta ba ni shes bya'i yul rnams kyi gnas lugs dang mi mthun pa phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa'am gnas lugs la rgyab 'gal du 'dzin pa'i blo la zer/ de la nang tshan gyi dbye ba byas na lnga yod/ dang po 'jig lta ni bdag 'dzin lta bu/ lta ba lnga po rnams bsdus bzhag na nyon mongs pa drug chags kyi yod red/ nye ba'i nyon mongs pa ni rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa las tog tsam shugs chung ba/ rtsa nyon de rnams kyi cha shas la zer gyi yod red/ dper na mi gzhan yag po yod pa'am byung ba la mi dga' ba byed pa la phrag dog zer/ rang la dbang ba'i phyi nang gi longs spyod rnams sems kyis dam por 'dzin pa la ser sna/ dge ba byed 'dod med pa lta bu la le lo zer gyi yod red/ de la sogs pa mang po yod/ nyon mongs pa dang las de tshos 'khor bar ji ltar byas te skyed kyi red zer na/ 'di'i rim pa 'di 'dra red/ nga rang tsho'i rgyud kyi bdag 'dzin ni 'khor ba'i rtsa ba red/

de las byung ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams ni rang rang so so mu 'thud 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i kun nas slong ba'i las rnams ni rkyen red/ rgyu dang rkyen gyi go don ni dper na me tog lta bu skye dgos na/ de'i sa bon la rgyu dang / chu dang lud sogs la rkyen zer gyi yod red/ cung zad rgyas bshad byas na dang po so so'i gzugs po dang*/ tshor ba dang sems de tshor brten nas nga bsam pa zhig yong gi yod red/ de la bdag 'dzin zer gyi yod red/ nga zhes 'dzin pa de yod dus de la ltos nas gzhan zhes 'dzin pa gcig yong gi yod red/ de nas nga la chags pa dang gzhan la sdang po byed/ de nas chags sdang la brten nas nga rgyal la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa gzhan dag mang po skye gi yod red/ nyon mongs pa la brten nas las sna tshogs pa bsags/ de lta bu'i las dang nyon mongs pa la brten nas 'gro ba ris lnga'am drug gi skye ba sna tshogs pa grub 'gro gi yod red/ nyon mongs pa tshang ma sems byung red/ des na gzhung sbyang ma myong mkhan tsho la phan pa'i re ba byed de sems sems byung skor tog tsam zhus na dran song / de yang spyir sems zer ba gcig dang sems byung zer ba gcig ste gnyis yod red/ sems ni gtso bo dang / sems byung rnams de'i 'khor red/ sems ni yul tsam mam yul gyi ngo bo 'dzin mkhan la zer gyi yod red/ yul gyi khyad par/ dper na yul mdzes pa'am mi mdzes pa lta bu 'dzin mkhan de tsho la sems byung zer gyi yod red/ gtso bo sems de la theg dman pas ris mi 'dra ba drug yod red gsungs pa red/ theg chen pas sems kyi dbye ba brgyad yod gsungs pa red/ mig gi dbang po la brten nas dbyibs dang kha dog gi gzugs shes mkhan la mig gi rnam shes zer gyi red/ rna ba la brten nas sgra shes mkhan de la rna ba'i rnam shes dang / sna la brten nas dri shes mkhan la sna yi rnam shes/

lce yi dbang po la brten nas ro myong mkhan la lce'i rnam shes/ lus la brten nas reg bya 'jam rtsub lta bu shes mkhan la lus kyi rnam shes zer gyi red/ drug pa yid kyi rnam shes ni yul dus gsum tshang ma 'dzin mkhan/ mi dran dgu dran sna tshogs dran mkhan gyi blo la zer gyi red/ rnam shes drug po de rgyu rkyen 'dzoms dus yod red/ rgyu rkyen mi 'dzoms pa dper na gnyid mthug po log pa'i skabs de tshor rgyun chad de yod ma red/ bdun pa nyon mongs pa'i yid ni kun gzhi rnam shes la tshur dmigs shing de la brten nas ngar 'dzin pa'i shes pa so so skye bo'i gnas skabs na nam yang rgyun chad rgyu med pa zhig la ngos 'dzin gnang ba red/ gnyid mthug po log dus yod dam med mkhas pa rnams kyis brtag dpyad byed dgos pa gcig red/ brgyad pa kun gzhi rnam shes ni/ yul thams cad 'dzin mkhan/ gzugs sgra la sogs pa 'di red ces yul dmigs bsal med mkhan/ rnam pa'ang gsal po med pa ste rang gi yul rnams gsal por mi 'dzin mkhan/ thog ma med pa'i dus nas sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du dus nam yang rgyun chad rgyu med mkhan/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba gang bsags na'ang de'i bag chags 'dzin mkhan gcig red/ mdzub mo btsugs pa yin na da lta'i shes pa gsal tsam yul 'dzin la khad pa'i shes pa la kun gzhi rnam shes zer gyi yod red/ sems byung ni sems kyi rnam 'gyur ram 'dzin stangs mi 'dra ba rnams la zer/ de yang dpe'i sgo nas go brda sprad na sems ni rgya mtsho lta bu dang/ sems byung rnams rba rlabs 'dra po red/ rgya gar gyi grub mtha' mtho ba tshos sems sems byung gnyis ngo bo gcig yin gsung gi yod red/ sems byung la'ang nang gses mang po yod sa red/ yin na'ang gal che ba de tsho bsdus nas mngon pa gong ma'i nang lnga bcu nga gcig gsungs pa red/ da lta zhu bzhin pa'i nyon mongs pa 'dod chags zhe sdang la sogs pa tshang ma sems byung red/

de bzhin du dad pa dang skyabs 'gro dang byams snying rje dang brtson 'grus zer ba de tsho'ang sems byung red/ / rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi ngo sprod bsdus te bshad pa/ 'khor 'das bshad pa'i skabs su rten 'brel gyi don go rgyu ha cang gnad chen po red/ der brten rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi ngo sprod mdor bsdus shig zhu rgyu yin/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis shes pa yin na las dang nyon mongs pa gnyis kyis sems can rnams khams gsum 'khor bar ji ltar byas nas 'khor gyi yod pa dang*/ lam nyams len byed pa la brten nas 'khor ba ji ltar byas nas spong thub kyi yod pa bcas kyi gnas tshul shes thub kyi yod red/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi nang nas dang po ni ma rig pa red/ de nyon mongs pa'i rtsa ba gsum gyi gti mug ma red/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ gti mug des las dge ba slong thub kyi ma red/ des na de bdag 'dzin la gsungs pa red/ rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ bdag 'dzin gyis las dge mi dge tshang ma byed kyi yod red/ gnyis pa 'du byed ni las la zer gyi yod red/ las la dge ba dang mi dge ba gnyis dang*/ khams gong mar skye bar byed pa'i las te gsum yod red/ gsum pa rnam shes ni 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis gsungs na/ ma yi mngal du dang por zhugs pa'i rnam shes de la zer gyi yod red gsungs pa red/ bzhi pa ming gzugs ni/ sems can gyi phung po las ming ni tshor ba/ 'du shes/ 'du byed dang rnam shes te phung po bzhi la zer gyi yod red/ gzugs ni ma'i mngal du dang por grub pa'i gzugs mer mer po lta bu la zer/ lnga pa skye mched ni/ mig rna ba/ sna/ lce bzhi dang*/ snga ma gnyis yod pa ste/ drug yod pa de rnams la skye mched drug zer gyi yod red/ drug pa reg pa ni yul gyi khyad par bzang ngan/ 'di yag po 'dug 'di ngan pa 'dug ces 'dzin mkhan gyi sems byung gcig red/

bdun pa tshor ba ni bde ba dang sdug bsngal sogs myong ba'i sems byung gcig red/ brgyad pa sred pa ni bde ba dang ma bral na bsam pa'i zhen chags lta bu'i sems byung la zer gyi yod red/ sdug bsngal dang bral na bsam pa de yang sred pa red/ dgu pa len pa ni bde ba'i rgyu la chags pa'am/ bde ba'i rgyu thob 'dod byed pa'i sems byung zhig la zer gyi yod red/ bcu pa srid pa zer ba de las red/ las zer na bya ba'am las ka la zer/ de la gnyis yod red/ bya ba'am las gsar pa dang rnying pa sngon ma yod pa 'bras bu ma smin par sdod yod pa de tsho red/ sred pa dang len pa ste sred len gnyis pos 'dod chags shugs chen po byung ba'i las de nus pa chen por bskyed nas skye ba rjes ma la 'bras bu smin thub mkhan gcig ste rigs gnyis yod red/ bcu gcig pa skye ba zer dus phung po skye ba rang red/ bcu gnyis pa rga shi zer ba ni rgas pa dang shi ba gnyis mnyam du sdom pa red/ bcu gnyis po de tsho'i nang nas dang po ma rig pa/ brgyad pa sred pa/ dgu pa len pa zer ba gsum nyon mongs pa red/ gnyis pa 'du byed dang*/ bcu pa srid pa zer ba gnyis las red/ gzhan dag bdun po rnams rnam smin gyi 'bras bu red/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis po la rgyu 'bras cha gnyis yod red/ dper na skye ba sngon ma la ma rig pa dang 'du byed gnyis byas/ tshe bar pa la rnam shes nas srid pa'i bar du brgyad 'gro yi yod red/ skye ba rjes ma la skye ba dang rga shi gnyis te mgyogs na tshe gsum gyis rdzogs 'gro gi yod red/ rgyu 'bras bshad na/ ma rig pa dang 'du byed gnyis kyis rgyu/ rnam shes la sogs pa lnga po rnams 'bras bu/ sred len srid pa gsum gyis rgyu dang/ skye ba dang rga shi gnyis 'bras bu red/ nyon mongs pa'i nyes dmigs mdor bsdus shig zhu rgyu yin/ 'phags pa byams pas mdo sde rgyan gyi nang du mdor bsdus te gsungs pa red/

nyon mongs pa 'dod chags sam khong khro lta bu gang yin yang des rang la gnod pa byed kyi red/ gzhan la'ang gnod pa byed kyi red/ dge rtsa la'ang gnod pa byed kyi red gsungs pa red/ nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis tshul khrims nyams song na/ rang 'gyod pa chen po byed dgos pa dang*/ mi yi brnyas bcos byed pa la sogs pa de 'dra'i nyes dmigs mdor bsdus shig gsungs pa red/ zhi ba lhas spyod 'jug gi nang du/ nyon mongs pa ni rang la gnod pa byed pa'i dgra yin pa'i skor tha mal pa'i dgra dang 'gran bsdur byas nas nyes dmigs rgyas tsam gsungs pa red/ dper na tha mal pa'i dgra bos rang la yun ring por gnod pa byed thub kyi ma red/ so so'i sems kyi steng gi nyon mongs pa rnams kyis thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar dang*/ da nas tha ma med pa'i bar du rgyun ring po bar mtshams med pa gnod pa byed kyi yod red gsungs pa red/ sems can thams cad rang gi dgrar langs na'ang tshe 'di la sdug po byed kyi red ma gtogs dmyal ba la 'khrid thub kyi ma red/ dmyal bar 'khrid mkhan gyi dgra ni nyon mongs pa red gsungs pa red/ tha mal pa'i dgra de la phar phan sems dang gus btud kyi sgo nas 'brel ba byed pa yin na/ tshur gnod pa byed kyi yod ma red/ nyon mongs pa'i dgra des phar ci tsam zhig bstun kyang sdug tu 'gro yi yod red/ tha mal pa'i dgra ni rang gis med pa byed ma thub kyang kho rang nam zhig 'chi 'gro gi red/ nyon mongs pa'i dgra ni gnyen pos bcom ma thub na rang bzhin gyis rtsa ba nas med pa 'gro gi ma red ces de la sogs pa'i sgo nas so so rang gi nyon mongs pa rnams la so sos bag yod dam gzab gzab byed stangs dang / byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gsal por gsungs pa red/ / srid pa 'khor lo'i mtshon don mdo tsam bshad pa/ nang chos kyi brjod don la gzhi bcol te srid pa 'khor lo zhes pa'i ri mo zhig 'bri srol yod red/

de'i go don gang yin mdor bsdus shig zhu 'dod byung / de ni ri mo'i thog nas 'khor 'das kyi 'gro stangs brda sprod kyi yod red/ de la dus rgyun theg pa che chung gi gsung rab rnams su bshad rgyu'i brjod bya bden pa bzhi zer ba zhig yod red/ de shes dgos kyi yod red/ bden pa bzhi ni 'khor ba rgyu 'bras gnyis dang*/ thar pa rgyu 'bras gnyis te bzhi la zer gyi yod red/ 'khor ba'i rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa gnyis dang/ 'bras bu 'khor ba ni phyi'i snod dang*/ nang sems can la gsung gi yod red/ thar pa rgyu 'bras ni go bde po byas na/ chos nyams su len mkhan gyi sems rgyud kyi yon tan 'phags lam yan lag brgyad lta bu ni lam gyi bden pa dang*/ sems kyi skyon nyon mongs pa dang de'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal las bral ba'i bral ba la 'gog pa'i bden pa zer gyi yod red/ srid pa 'khor lo de'i lte ba la sems can dud 'gro gsum bris yod red/ de dag 'khor ba'i rgyu kun 'byung mtshon byed red/ de yang phag pas gti mug mtshon pa dang/ sbrul gyis zhe sdang*dang / bya phug ron gyis 'dod chags mtshon kyi yod red/ phyi log la ngan song gsum dang*/ lha mi gnyis te cha lnga yod red/ de dag gis sdug bsngal gyi bden pa mtshon pa dang / mu khyud kyi nang la rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis yod red/ des rgyu dang 'bras bu ji ltar byas nas 'khor bar 'khor stangs bshad pa red/ 'khor lo'i g.yas phyogs kyi 'og tu sangs rgyas kyi gsung tshigs bcad gnyis ni lam bden mtshon byed red/ de'i thog la zla ba gcig bris yod pa des 'gog pa'i bden pa mtshon pa dang / ston pa'i sku gcig 'khor lo'i g.yon phyogs na bzhengs nas zla ba dang 'khor lo gnyis la phyag mdzub ston sdod pa zhig yod pa des thar pa'i lam dang 'bras bu la ltos zer ba'i don dag red/ 'dis 'khor ba la zhen na nges 'byung min zhes pa'i zhen pa bzhi bral gyi tshig rkang pa gnyis pa de'i don mdor bsdus shig tshar ba red/

/ bdag don la zhen na byang sems min pa'i tshul bshad pa/ da bdag don la zhen na byang sems min zhes pa de'i brjod don skor zhu rgyu yin/ 'khor ba la phan thogs yod pa ltar snang yang phan thogs rtsa ba nas med pa dang / skyon chen po dang mang po yod pa'i mtshangs bcom ldan 'das kyis dam pa'i chos kyi nang du bton pa bzhin mkhas pa yin na so so rang gis kyang gong du zhus pa bzhin 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag gi skyon rnams la bsam blo zhib tu btang ste 'khor ba spang bya yin pa ngo 'phrod cing de la zhen pa log ste de las thar thabs nges par byed dgos kyi 'dug bsam/ 'khor ba spong dgos sems pa'i blo tshad ldan zhig skyes tshar dus da gang zhig byed dgos red zer na/ de la gnyis yod red/ theg dman dgra bcom pa'am rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob thabs byed dgos kyi yod red/ de gnyis 'gran bsdur byed dus dman pa'i dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang ni ha cang yag po yin na'ang / de las kyang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ni ches shin tu legs pa yod red/ der brten sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bsgrub dgos bsam dgos kyi yod red/ de la theg chen sems bskyed zer gyi red/ khyad par du spyir nga tshor bsgrub bya gang zhig 'dug dmigs yul gang zhig 'dug ces bsam blo yag po byas te gtong dus yang na tshe 'di bsgrub dgos kyi yod red/ yang na skye ba rjes ma ngan song du mi 'gro bar lha dang mi'i skye ba'ang bsgrub bya gcig red/ yang na thar pa bsgrub dgos kyi yod red/ yang na sangs rgyas bsgrub dgos kyi yod red/ de rnams las gang la do snang sprad de 'bad brtson byas na phugs su khe phan che ba 'dug ces 'gran bsdur byed dgos kyi yod red/ / smon 'jug gnyis kyi rgyu byams pa bsgom pa'i tshul bshad pa / theg chen sems bskyed la dbye ba mang po yod red/

yin na'ang ngo bo'i sgo nas smon pa dang 'jug pa gnyis gsungs kyi yod red/ smon pa ni sems can gzhan gyi don du sangs rgyas thob dgos bsam pa'i blo la zer gyi red/ rang don du theg chen gyi sems bskyed pa'i lugs srol med pa red/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i ched du sangs rgyas kyi rgyur gyur pa'i dge ba bsgrub dgos bsam pa de la 'jug pa sems bskyed gsungs kyi yod red/ sems bskyed de rnams rang gi sems kyi thog tu bskyed pa la rgyu rkyen yod dgos red/ rgyu mang po'i nang nas gal che shos de snying rje red/ des na sems bskyed kyi sngon du snying rje 'gro dgos kyi yod red/ snying rje'i rgyu de byams pa red/ der brten dang po byams pa sgom dgos kyi yod red/ byams pa ni rang ma yin pa'i sems can gzhan dag chos dang mthun pa'i tshe 'di'i bde ba/ skye ba phyi ma'i bde ba/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar kyi bde ba de dag thob na bsam pa'am/ bde ba'i rgyu dge ba sgrub rogs byas na bsam pa la zer gyi yod red/ byams pa ni chos pa gsar pa la yod ma red/ bzo dgos kyi yod red/ spyir btang chos byed zhes pa'i don dag sems yag po bzo ba la zer gyi yod red/ dper na nga rang tsho'i sems ni gser yag po 'dra po red/ gser yag po de gser bzo bas bzo lta ga 'dra bzo dgos na'ang bzo thub kyi yod red/ bzo bcos rtsa ba nas ma byas pa'i da lta'i sems la skyon mang po yod red/ nga rang tsho'i skyon tshang ma sems kyi thog dang sems las 'byung gi yod red/ sems de'i skyon rnams chos nyams su len pa'i sgo nas bzo bcos byas pa yin na sems de yon tan can dang / yon tan mang po'i 'byung khungs chags kyi yod red/ sems de gang la goms pa de nyid la 'gyur thub kyi yod stabs chos thos bsam gyis shes pa tsam gyis chog shes ma byas par shes pa'i don rnams sems kha nang du slog ste so so'i sems rgyud kyi thog tu sim pa'am/

sems dang 'dris thabs la 'bad brtson yang nas yang du lhod g.yeng ma shor bar bya dgos/ / byams pa bsgoms pa'i phan yon bshad pa/ byams pa sgom pa'i phan yon zhus na/ sangs rgyas mang po la mchod rdzas mdzes shing yid du 'ong pa sna tshogs pa mang po dus ring por dbul ba las byams pa skar ma bcu tsam zhig sgom pa bsod nams che ba yod red gsungs pa red/ ba 'jo ba'i dus tshod gcig gi tshad du byams pa sgom na lha dang mi yis rang la byams po byed pa la sogs pa'i yon tan brgyad thob kyi red gsungs pa red/ phar la byams po byas na tshur la'ang byams po byed kyi yod pa mthong chos red/ 'di la rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu zer gyi red/ der ma zad byams pa'i sems kyis rang gzhan gnyis ka gnod 'tshe las srung skyob byed thub kyi yod red/ dper na bdag cag gi ston pa la bdud mang pos gnod 'tshe byed par rtsom dus ston pa'i byams pa'i stobs kyis gnod 'tshe byed ma thub pa red/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa la snying rje dgos shing de la'ang byams pa med thabs med red/ sems la byams pa dang po bzo ba'am sgom pa'i skabs rim pa gsum byas te bsgom dgos/ dang po nye sa la sgom/ de nas dgra la bsgom/ de nas nye ring gang yang ma yin pa'i bar ma'i sems can gzhan dag la sgom/ nye sa la bsgom pa la'ang rim pa gsum byed dgos/ dang po ma la bsgom/ de nas pha lta bu dmigs bsal gyi drin yod pa gzhan dag/ de nas 'brel ba yag po yod pa'i gnyen tshan gzhan rnams la bsgom/ de nas sems can tshang ma rang gi ma yin bsams te bsgom gyi yod red/ de 'dra byas te bsgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni snying du sdug pa gcig bzos na byams pa skye bde ba yod red/ dper na so so'i ma lta bu gtsigs chen po/ bu lta bu/ chung ma lta bu'i snying du sdug pa de la rang shugs kyis bde po byung na/ sdug bsngal ma byung na sems pa'i bsam blo'am rig pa de tsam sgrim mi dgos par skye yi yod pas/

byams snying rje rnams rang rgyud la skye bde thabs byas nas dang po snying rje'i yul rnams so so'i a ma yin pa ngo shes te ma yin bsam/ gnyis pa de'i drin chen po yod pa rnams bsam/ gsum pa drin gzo ba'am drin lan sprad dgos bsam pa rnams sngon du btang ste rang gi sems la byams sogs tshad dang ldan pa bzo tshul bstan pa yin/ dang po so so'i ma de gshin po dang gson po gang yin kyang gzugs dbyibs rnam pa ji ma ji bzhin rang gi mdun du bsam/ mdun gyi ma'i rnam pa de la sems rtse gcig tu gtad de 'di nga'i drin can gyi ma yin snyam tshar kha shas bskyor/ de nas mu 'thud de sems mdun gyi ma'i rnam pa la dmigs te ma 'dis so so la byams po byas pa'i skabs kyi spyod lam dang drin yod pa rnams bsam/ de yang rang gi ma'i drin rnams tshur bsdus na/ rang la da lta'i lus dang srog byin pa'i drin/ lam ston nam slob ston mang po byas pa'i drin/ rang gi don du dka' ba spyad pa'i drin te drin gsum yod red/ zla ba bcu ma zin tsam mngal nang la bzung nas gzab gzab byas te bskyangs/ phyi la btsas tshar dus so so rang nyid kyi lus kyis gang yang byed thub kyi med pa dang / ngag gis kha grags thub kyi med pa dang sems kyis kyang gang yang bsam shes kyi med kyang / ma yis rang nyid ltogs ma bcug/ skom ma bcug/ tsha ma bcug/ grang ma bcug par ha cang byams po byas te shi ma bcug par srung skyob byas pa yin stabs lus po 'di dang srog 'di ma yis byin pa red/ de nas tog tsam che ru phyin dus slob sbyong sprad yod red/ a ma'i ming 'dra po lab bcug de nas 'gro stangs dang sdod stangs/ za stangs dang 'thung stangs sogs de 'dra ba mang po bslabs/ de nas rang mgo 'thon pa'i mir chags skabs ma mo rang gis lo yun mang po'i ring sdig pa dang dka' ngal chen pos bsags pa'i longs spyod rnams ma rang gi phyi ma'i lam rgyag chos kyi ched du gtong ma thub/

so so'i tshe 'di'i bde ba'i don du bed spyod mi byed par phangs sems med par bu nga la sprad/ mdor na mas shes tshad 'jon tshad kyis bu nga la sgo mang po nas phan btags/ gnod pa dang dka' ngal gyi rigs mi 'dra ba du ma las skyabs pa sogs kyi drin rnams sems kyi gting nas dran dgos/ ma yi drin dran pa'i skabs su a ma 'di tshe 'di la de lta bu'i bka' drin chen po yin pa ma zad skye ba sngon ma rnams su'ang lan grangs tshad med par ma byas shing phan btags pa dang / rang gi pha yang lan grangs mang po byas shing phan btags pa dang / spun nye la sogs pa tshar mang po byas nas byams brtse chen pos bskyangs pa'i bka' drin chen po yin pa rnams kyang sems kyi gting nas bsam/ gsum pa de'i rjes su drin lan 'jal 'dod bsam tshul ni/ ma 'di de lta bu'i drin chen po yin pas drin lan nges par du 'jal ba'am sprad dgos bsams te ma yi da lta'i gnas tshul la brtag dpyad btang nas ma 'di bde ba 'dod kyi yod kyang / bde ba'i rgyu dge ba yin pa mi shes pa'i sgo nas bde ba thob pa'i don du srog gcod pa dang/ rkun ma rku ba dang rdzun bshad pa la sogs pa'i las mi dge ba byed de sdug bsngal gyi rgyu gsog pa'am bsgrubs kyi 'dug de'i phyir da dung yang ma mo rang gi don dag byed thub kyi mi 'dug ngas rogs pa byed dgos kyi 'dug bsam/ ma 'di bde ba dang ldan pa dang / 'dis bde ba'i rgyu dge ba sgrub na bsam pa ste 'dun pa dang 'brel ba'i byams pa'i sems dang / de'ang byams pa sgom stangs gcig red/ ma 'di bde bar gyur cig bde ba'i rgyu dge ba dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pa smon lam dang 'brel ba'ang byams pa sgom stangs gzhan zhig red/ yang ma 'di bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan pa bla ma dang dkon mchog gis gnang rogs gnang bsam ste gsol ba 'debs pa gsol 'debs dang 'brel ba dang /

de bzhin du ma 'di bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan pa zhig ngas byed bsam pa dam bca' 'am sems bskyed dang 'brel ba'i byams pa ste/ de dag bzhi po gang gi sgo nas rang gi sems la byams pa rnal ma bzo ba'i skabs su mtshams rer byams pa skye dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bsams te bsgoms/ mtshams mtshams la rgyu mtshan ma bsams par bsgom/ gang ltar mnyam rjes bar ma chad par bdun phrag dang zla ba 'thud de bsgoms pas nam zhig ma 'di bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan na bsam pa'i bsam blo rang shugs kyis rgyun du yong na/ de dus byams pa yag po'am rnal ma byung ba red/ gnyis pa rang gi pha lta bu nye ba'i phyogs de tsho la'ang sgom stangs gcig pa red/ 'di tshos da lta phan thogs/ skye ba sngon ma phan chad rang gi a ma mang po byas te phan btags yod bsam pa'i sgo nas de tsho la'ang byams pa skye dgos/ gsum pa rang dang 'brel ba yag po yod mkhan gzhan la'ang byams pa bsgom tshul yang / gong du ma la byams pa sgom stangs bshad pa ltar yin/ gnyis pa dgra la'ang byams pa bsgom dgos/ dgras rang la tshe 'di la phan 'dogs pa'i lo rgyus 'jig rten pa'i lta phyogs kyi sgo nas bshad rgyu yod ma red/ yin na'ang kho'am mos gnod pa byas byung / byed kyi 'dug ces bsams te dgra la sdang po byed pa'i tshab tu de'i lan du phan sems byams pa skye thabs bya dgos/ gang yin zhe na/ da lta dgrar mthong ba'i mi 'dis skye ba sngon ma nas ma tshar mang po byas*/ ma byas rim bzhin so so'i tshe 'di'i ma bzhin du phan btags pas drin chen po yin/ drin lan sprad dgos bsam ste dgra la'ang ma la byams pa skyes pa nang bzhin byams pa bsgom dgos/ de nas rim pa gsum pa sems can thams cad la byams pa sgom tshul ni/ byams pa sgom pa'i thun gyi skabs su sems can thams cad mdun du yod bsams nas/ 'di dag skye ba sngon ma phan chad kyi ma yin bsam pa sogs kyi rim pa yongs rdzogs 'gro dgos kyi yod red/

de bzhin du mtshams rer sems can thams cad yid yul du byas te sems can 'di dag thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig bsams/ mtshams rer sems can gyi rigs mi 'dra ba rnams sde tshan du bcad de bsgoms pa/ dper na dmyal ba mnar med pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig bsam pa lta bu/ mtshams rer bal yul lta bu lung pa gcig gi sems can/ mtshams rer lung pa gzhan gyi sems can dmigs yul byas te sgom dgos/ thun gyi skabs su de ltar sgom tshar ba'i mjug tu bar gseng skabs phyi log la 'gro dus mi gcig mthong byung na'ang 'di bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig bsam/ khyi gcig mthong na'ang khyi 'di bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig bsams te sgom dgos kyi yod red/ bde ba med mkhan su 'dra zhig mthong na'ang bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig bsam/ dge ba mi sgrub mkhan de 'dra mthong dus bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig bsam/ de gnyis kha phral nas kyang sgom/ bde ba la rigs mi 'dra ba mang po dang*/ bde ba'i rgyu dge ba la'ang ris mi 'dra ba mang po yod red*/ yin na'ang de tsho sems can rnams la mi 'dug de tsho sems can rnams kyis thob par shog bsam/ sgom tshul gyi rnam pa mi 'dra ba de tsho'i thog nas bsams na byams pa mang po dang shugs chen po skye gi yod red/ dper na chos mi shes mkhan de 'dra mthong na slob sbyong byed par shog sbyin pa mi gtong mkhan de tshos sbyin pa gtong bar shog tshul khrims med mkhan rnams kyis tshul khrims srung bar shog ces sogs sgo mang po'i thog nas rang rgyud kyi byams pa gsal po dang brtan po bzo thabs bya dgos/ mdo gcig gi nang la skyes bu dam pa'i bsam pa sum cu so gnyis gsungs yod red/ de byams pa'i phyogs yin pa red/ dper na nga shes rab yod mkhan red 'dug sems can 'di shes rab med mkhan red 'dug

shes rab med na 'grig gi mi 'dug des na sems can 'di shes rab dang ldan par shog bsam pa dang/ ngas sbyin pa gtong gi 'dug sems can 'dis ser sna byed kyi 'dug des 'grigs kyi mi 'dug sems can 'dis kyang sbyin pa gtong bar shog bsam pa sogs pa de dag la skyes bu dam pa'i bsam blo sum cu so gnyis zer gyi red/ / snying rje'i ngo bo dang phan yon bshad pa/ gnyis pa snying rje'i skor zhu rgyu yin/ snying rje zhes pa ni sems can gzhan su 'dra zhig yin na'ang sdug bsngal med na bsam pa dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba mi byed na bsam pa'i blo la zer gyi yod red/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu zer na/ bdag 'dzin dang*/ 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs dang / de tshos slong ba'i las sam bya ba rnams la zer gyi red/ snying rje ni theg pa chen po'i chos la slob 'dod yod mkhan la lhag par du gal chen po yin pas de'i phan yon mdo yi nang gsal zhing rgyas pa gsungs pa red/ de yang mdo las sangs rgyas thob dgos na chos mang po byed dgos ma red/ snying rje sgom bsdad na 'grigs kyi red gsungs pa red/ snying rje yod na sangs rgyas kyi chos tshang ma yong gi red gsungs pa red/ snying rje des dang po lam la ma zhugs pa'i skabs su theg chen gyi sems bskyed bcug lam la zhugs tshar dus snying rjes lam gong 'phel du gtong*/ sangs rgyas tshar dus kyang snying rjes chos 'khor bskor ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas grangs kyi tshad med pa'i sems can gyi don byas te nam mkha' ma zhig gi bar du rtag par bzhugs bcug gi yod red/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis sbyin pas longs spyod thob par byed kyi red la sogs pa snying rje las gzhan pa'i theg pa chen po'i lam yin mkhan gyi dge ba de tshos las 'di dang 'di byed ces gsungs pa'i mjug la/ snying rje yis ni don kun byed/ /ces snying rje theg pa chen po'i nyams len tshang ma'i sngon la 'gro ba byas te bya ba thams cad byed kyi yod red ces gsungs pa red/

der brten snying rje ni shin tu gal chen po yin pa ngo 'phrod dgos/ snying rje sgom stangs las sla ba de byams pa bsgom stangs dang mtshungs pa sde tshan gsum du bcad de/ dang po nye ba'i phyogs/ de nas ring ba'i phyogs/ de nas bar ma'i phyogs te gsum la rim pa bzhin bsgom dgos red/ / de yang dang po rtsa ba'i ma dran pa dang / drin dran pa dang drin lan 'jal 'dod kyi blo rnams gong du byams pa sgom stangs bshad pa'i skabs nang bzhin byas te rtsa ba'i bsgom rgyu de snying rje sgom dgos red/ de yang mnyam bzhag gam thun gyi skabs su mdun du dmigs pa'i ma 'di sdug bsngal las bral na/ ma 'dis rang sdug rang gis myong ba'i don du sdig pa mang po gsog sdod kyi 'dug sdig pa'i las 'di dang 'di ma byas na bsam pa 'dun pa dang 'brel ba'i snying rje dang / ma 'di sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu rnams dang bral bar gyur cig snyam pa smon lam dang 'brel ba'i snying rje dang / de bzhin du skabs res ma 'di sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral ba zhig dkon mchog gis mkhyen snyam pa gsol 'debs dang 'brel ba dang/ de nas gal che shos ma 'di sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bcas pa las bral ba ngas byed bsam pa lhag bsam mam sems bskyed dang 'brel ba ste sgom tshul mi 'dra ba bzhi'i sgo nas rang sems kyi steng du snying rje bcos ma ma yin pa'am rnam dag bskyed thabs bya dgos/ mtshams rer dmigs bsal byas te snying rje bsgom dgos sa'i yul sdug bsngal chen po yod pa la sogs pa de 'dra yang mang po gsungs yod pa red/ mdo sde rgyan gyi nang du 'dod yon la ha cang zhen chags chen po yod pa dang*/ chos bsgrub 'dod yod kyang bar chad kyi dbang du phyin pa la sogs pa snying rje'i dmigs bsal gyi yul bcu dang / de bzhin du bstan bcos de'i nang du pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs ser sna chen po yin pa/

tshul khrims 'chal ba yin pa la sogs pa snying rje'i dmigs bsal gyi yul drug dang/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis snying rje'i yul dmigs bsal brgya dang bcu gsungs yod pa dang / mdo gcig gi nang du'ang dper na bdag 'dzin can gyi sems can de'i bdag 'dzin 'dul ba'i don du chos bshad bsam pa lta bu de 'dra'i snying rje'i dmigs yul bcu drug gsungs yod/ thub pa dgongs gsal gyi nang du byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje'i dmigs yul la/ theg dman gyi lam la zhugs pa dang / srid pa ba ste 'khor ba pa dang gnyis su phyes te gsungs/ de bzhin du snying rje'i dmigs yul dmigs bsal byed dgos pa/ dper na nga rang tsho'i mi'i spyi tshogs nang gi mi stobs chen po/ longs spyod chen po/ go gnas chen po yod mkhan de tshos nyin ltar kho rang gis kyang sdig pa gsog/ mi gzhan mang po'ang sdig pa'i las la skul sdod cing / shi ma thag tu ngan song la skye yi yod pas de rnams kyang snying rje bsgom sa'i dmigs bsal gyi yul red/ de ga nang bzhin dmigs bsal sdug bsngal chen po yod mkhan ngan song gsum gyi sems can rnams dang / mtho ris kyi sems can mi lta bu yin na'ang nad drag pos zin zhing mnar ba dang / khrims 'gal gyis khrims kyi nyes pa chen po khel yod pa de tsho'ang red/ de bzhin du mtshams re kha nang du slog ste sems can spyi'i tshe'i 'gro stangs la brtags pas/ sems can mang pos sdug bsngal mang po'i rgyu mi dge ba mang po byed kyi 'dug/ de med pa byung na bsam pa dang / sems can thams cad nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang*dang sdug bsngal gyi gzhan dbang yin pas de rnams snying rje bsam pa dang / mi 'dod bzhin du sdug bsngal mang po dang drag po myong dgos pa 'di tsho snying re rje bsam pa dang / dmyal ba tsha grang gi sdug bsngal lan grangs tshad med pa myong dgos pa 'di tsho snying rje/

yi dwags bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal lan grangs tshad med pa myong dgos pa rnams snying rje bsam/ gcig gis gcig za ba'i dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal lan grangs tshad med pa myong ba snying rje/ mi yi sdug bsngal skye rga na 'chi lan grangs tshad med pa myong ba snying rje/ lha yi sdug bsngal 'chi 'pho ltung ba'i sdug bsngal lan grangs tshad med pa myong dgos pa rnams snying rje bsam/ de nas khrag dang mchi ma gnyis kyi rgya mtsho bskyil/ sha dang rus pa'i ri bo brtsegs pa'i sems can 'di rnams snying re rje bsam/ de bzhin du nga rang tsho mi lta bu gnas ga bar skyes kyang 'dra/ gang du gnas na'ang skyid po med pa rnams snying rje bsam/ mi zhig spobs pa chen po ga tshod yin na'ang nyon mongs pa dang sdug bsngal gyi gzhan dbang yin pa'i nyams thag red/ nyams thag yin pa'i sems can rnams snying re rje bsam/ nyon mongs pa spong khag po yin pas da dung 'khor ba la rgyun ring gnas dgos pa'i sems can 'di tsho snying re rje bsam pa la sogs pa de lta bu'i tshul gyis yang nas yang du thun dang thun mtshams sbrel te snying rje la goms cha sprad bsdad na snying rje shugs che ru 'gro gi yod red/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis mtho ris kyi sems can mi lta bu ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sdig pa gsog mkhan dang / ngan song gi sems can rnams ni sdig pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal myong sdod kyi yod pas/ sems can gyi gnas stangs de 'dra bsams nas khong gis 'khor ba'i sems can spyi la snying rje bskyed kyi yod gsungs pa red/ / byang chub smon pa'i sems kyi skor bshad pa/ de nas gsum pa bsam pa byang chub kyi sems sgom pa la/ smon pa byang chub kyi sems/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems dang bcas gsum yod red gsungs pa red/ de tsho'i mtshams 'jog bde po red/

byams pa dang snying rje sgom dus sems can thams cad la bde ba yod pa ngas byed/ sdug bsngal med pa ngas byed bsams pa red/ de ltar du sems bzhin pa tsam la'ang bsod nams chen po yod red de/ de tsam gyis ma tshims par sems can rnams la 'dod pa bde ba byung ba dang mi 'dod pa sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i thabs la bsam blo gtong dgos red la/ sems can thams cad la bde ba yod pa dang*/ sdug bsngal med pa ji ltar byed dgos kyi 'dug sus byed thub kyi 'dug snyam ste bsam blo 'khor gyi red/ de ltar du bsam blo gtong dus 'jig rten pa'i dpon po dang / lha yi rgyal po tshangs pa la sogs pa dang / nyams rtogs ha cang mthon po yin pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa zer mkhan de tshos kyang byed thub kyi ma red/ de tsho la byed 'dod kyang yod ma red la/ nus pa'ang yod ma red/ da gzhan don sus byed thub kyi red zer na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis byed thub kyi red/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gzhan don tshad med pa byed thub kyi yod red/ des na sems can gzhan gyi don dag la/ sems can rnams la bde ba yod par byed pa dang*/ sdug bsngal med par byed pa la sangs rgyas thob dgos kyi 'dug bsam dgos kyi red/ dmigs yul de sems can gyi don dag red/ de'i lag cha de sems bskyed red/ der brten sems can thams cad kyi don du ngas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa byed dgos kyi 'dug bsam pa de la smon pa byang chub kyi sems zer gyi red/ sems bskyed 'di med na dge ba ci 'dra zhig bsags na'ang de rnams kyis rgyu byas nas nyams su len pa'i chos pa rang nyid sangs rgyas thob mi thub/ sangs rgyas ni theg chen sems bskyed la brten nas thob dgos pa yin pas sems bskyed de la phan yon mang po gsung gi yod red/ dper na sems bskyed yag po byung na de byang chub sems dpa' chags 'gro gi yod red/

don dag la'ang lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyis mchod bstod kyi 'os su gyur pa la sogs pa phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod red/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems de las sla po skye rgyu yod ma red/ lo dang zla ba mang po sgom dgos kyi yod red/ sems kyi rnam 'gyur rang gzhan 'phral phugs gnas skabs kun tu phan pa de tsho'i gras phreng ba la bgrangs te tshar mang po gsog dgos kyi yod red/ sems pa ma yengs pa byas na phan thogs yod red/ dper na sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces pa de mang po bgrang*/ 'bum phrag kha shas bsag sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig zer ba dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya zer ba de tsho tshar mang po bsags na sems la phan thogs nges pa yong gi yod red/ der ma zad de dag rang gi sems rgyud la skye ba'i don dag la dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs pa dang / tshogs gsog pa dang sgrib pa sbyong ba'i thabs shes mang po byed dgos kyi yod red/ dper na chos nyan dus mi go go na yang bden pa ma red bsam pa dang / ngas nyams su len mi thub/ ngas byed dgos med bsam pa sogs byung ba ni dge ba'i bag chags ma sad pa red gsungs pa red/ skye ba sngon ma'i dge ba'i sa bon gcig yod pa de smin ma thub pa red/ de'i phyir dge rtsa sad pa'am smin pa la gsol 'debs dang / tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong gi las rnams byas na da gzod chos yag po go ba dang / go ba bzhin nyams su len thub pa'ang yong gi yod red/ mdor na theg pa chen po'i chos la zhugs pa'i chos pa skya ser gang yin yang nges 'byung dang byams pa/ snying rje/ byang chub kyi sems de tsho med thabs med pa red/ de tsho sems kyi thog la yag po gcig byung na/ shi na'ang 'gyod pa byed mi dgos/ byams snying rje la sdom pa zhu rgyu yod ma red de theg chen gyi sems bskyed la sdom pa zhu dgos kyi yod red/

sdom pa zhu dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang red zer na/ spyir dge ba la sdom pas zin pa dang ma zin pa bar ma'i dge ba ste gnyis yod red/ bar ma'i dge ba ni sdom pa med mkhan gyis byed pa'i dge ba la zer/ spyir btang bar ma'i dge ba byas na'ang chud zos mi 'gro zhing 'bras bu yag po yong gi red de/ sdom pa med pa'i dge ba des thar pa dang sangs rgyas kyi go sa thob thub kyi yod ma red/ des na dang po sdom pa zhus nas so so'i sdom pa dang 'brel ba'i dgag pa'i bslab bya rnams ma nyams par srung ba'i thog la bsgrub pa'i bslab bya'i dge ba gang yin pa rim pa bzhin du nus tshod dang bstun te bsgrubs pa ni lam mam nyams len gyi 'gro stangs red/ byang chub sems sdom 'bog pa'i cho ga la/ sems tsam pa'i lugs dang*/ dbu ma pa'i lugs te gnyis yod/ yin na'ang sems tsam pa'i lugs de tog tsam dka' ba yod red/ gang yin zhe na/ de'i lugs kyi cho gas sdom pa zhu ba la dge bsnyen nam dge slong lta bu'i sdom pa yod pa zhig dgos kyi yod pas dang po thob khag po red/ bsrung bya ltung ba chen po bzhi dang chung chung bzhi bcu zhe drug yod pas bar du srung khag po yod red/ sus sdom pa blangs na'ang dbang po rno rtul yin pa'i gnas stangs la ma ltos par tshang mas gcig mtshungs su sdom pa cha tshang bsrung dgos kyi yod red/ de'i lugs la rang gi bsrung bya'i bslab bya la rim gyis slob pa yod ma red/ dbu ma lugs kyi cho ga las thob pa'i byang chub sems kyi sdom pa dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya la phugs su rang gi nyes pa'am skyon thams cad spangs nas dge ba thams cad bsgrub dgos red de/ gnas skabs rim pa byed chog gi yod red/ de yang dang po khas len dus/ rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ zhes rim pas rim pas rang gi nus tshod dang bstun te dge ba sgrub/ sdig pa spong gi yin zhes khas len gyi yod red/

der brten sdom pa thob tshar dus rim pa byed chog gi yod red/ de'i rim pa la/ theg chen gyi lam la zhugs pa'i gang zag gam nyams len pa blo dman pa dang / 'bring dang blo mchog tu gyur pa gcig ste gsum gyi nyams su blang rgyu'i bslab bya mi 'dra ba yod pas/ de thob bde po dang srung sla po dang phan thogs chen po yag po yod red/ dper na blo rtul po des smon pa sems bskyed kyi bslab bya la sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya zhes snyam pa'i bsam pa de ma nyams par skyong ba dang / 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi bslab bya la mi dge ba spong gang thub byed kyang rang rgyud kyi mi shes pa dang ma gus pa la sogs pa ltung ba'am sdom pa 'gal ba'i nyes pa mi dge ba'i las byas shor na bshags pa byed/ dge ba gang sgrub gang thub byed/ dge ba gang bsgrubs na'ang de bsngo ba dang / gzhan dag gis byas pa dang byed bzhin pa'i dge ba la rjes su yi rangs byas na gnas skabs 'grigs kyi yod red/ khyim pa lta bu bya ba mang po yod mkhan tshos de 'dra byas na 'grigs kyi red ces sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa red/ nga tshos sems zhum pa'am blo stobs chung chung bya rgyu de spong pa gal chen po red/ rgyu mtshan gang red ces dris na/ nga 'dra po thabs sdug gcig gis sangs rgyas zer mkhan yon tan chen po de ji ltar thob thub bsams nas sems zhum pa yin na/ des rang ngos nas 'bad brtson bya rgyu'i gegs byas te skyon chen po byed kyi yod red/ sems zhum ste rtsol ba ma byas na snga ma'i go sa de spong thub kyi yod ma red/ des na sems ma zhum pa bya dgos/ rje btsun byams pa mgon pos skad cig re re la sems can mang po sangs rgyas 'gro gi yod ces gsungs pas ga re byas nas ngas sangs rgyas sgrub mi thub ces bsams te so so'i sems la spobs pa bzo dgos/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang /

sngon ma'i sangs rgyas yon tan chen po yod pa de tsho gnam nas mar char pa 'bab pa lta bu babs pa ma red la / sa nas yar lo tog skye ba nang bzhin 'khrungs yong ba ma red/ nged tsho 'dra po gcig gis byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing 'bad rtsol byas te lam la bslabs nas sangs rgyas song ba red ces gsungs pa dang / de bzhin du rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lhas kyang spyod 'jug gi nang du/ 'bu chung chung gis kyang rtsol ba byas na sangs rgyas thob thub kyi red ces sangs rgyas kyis gsungs yod ces dang / de las kyang mis sangs rgyas thob bde ba yod red ces gsungs yod red/ dbang po 'bring po'i bslab bya bshad na/ dus rgyun nag po'i chos bzhi spong zer yag de tsho gal chen po red/ skye ba rjes ma byang chub kyi sems thob pa la nag po'i chos zer ba bzhi yod pa de tsho spong dgos kyi yod red/ 1 skyag brdzun bshad nas skyes bu dam pa dbu skor gtong ba/ 2 byang chub sems dpa' la smod pa'am skyon brjod byed pa/ 3 dge ba byed mkhan rnams la byed nyes byas pa zer te 'gyod pa skye bcug pa dang / 4 sems can rnams la g.yo sgyu byas nas ngan pa byed pa rnams red/ yang dkar po'i chos bzhi zhes pa/ 1 brdzun mi smra ba/ 2 sems can rnams theg pa chen po'i lam du bcug pa/ 3 byang chub sems dpa' la bstod pa phul ba/ 4 sems can la lhag bsam byed pa de tsho red/ de nas bsrung bya ltung ba de la'ang*/ ser sna'i sgo nas chos mi bshad pa dang/ sbyin pa mi gtong ba la sogs pa bzhi yod red/ de tsho srung dgos/ smon pa sems bskyed kyi bslab bya rgyas pa ni byams pa dang snying rje bsgoms/ bla ma bsten/ dkon mchog la dad pa byed cing spyir sems bskyed yod mkhan la bdud kyi bar chad byed kyi yod pas bdud kyi bar chad gang 'dra byed kyi 'dug shes pa byas/ bdud kyi bar chad mi 'byung ba sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gsol ba 'debs/

'jug pa sems bskyed kyi bslab bya rgyas pa la yan lag bdun pa de shin tu gal chen po gcig yin gsungs pa red/ der brten sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mdun du yan lag bdun pa byed kyi yod bsam nas nyin la tshar gsum/ mtshan la tshar gsum byed dgos kyi red/ / bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i go don bshad pa/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa'i don bshad na/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems ni sgom bde po red/ bdag bde ba 'dod pa bzhin tu sems can thams cad bde ba 'dod kyi yod red/ bdag sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa bzhin tu sems can thams cad sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa gcig pa gcig rkyang*go brda sprad bde po red/ go brda ma 'phrod na mi gnyis skad cha bshad na thag gcod thub kyi ma red/ de ltar yin pa ra 'phrod nas ngas nga rang dang sems can gnyis ka'i bde ba sgrub/ rang dang sems can gnyis ka'i sdug bsngal spong dgos snyam ste bsam pa la bdag gzhan mnyam pa'i sems zer gyi red/ / bdag gzhan brje tshul bshad pa/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i skor zhu rgyu yin/ bdag gzhan brje ba zhes pa'i don ni/ rang gi dge ba dang bde ba gnyis sems can la sbyin/ sems can gyi mi bde ba dang sdug bsngal de tsho rang nyid kyis len pa ste gtso bo dang po sems kyi thog tu brje ba dang / de nas dngos su yang lag len byed dgos pa red/ de la bod pa'i mkhas pa kha cig gis zer na rang gzhan gyi dge ba dang sdig pa/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal brje thub rgyu yod ma red/ des na bdag gzhan brje zhes pa'i don ni gces 'dzin brje ba la zer gyi red/ de yang thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du rang la gces 'dzin byed sdod pa de da yal bar bor te sems can gzhan la gces 'dzin byed pa la zer gyi red gsungs pa red/ yin na'ang dpal mgon klu sgrub kyis dge sdig brje dgos red gsungs pa dang / rgyal sras zhi ba lhas kyang bde sdug brje dgos red ces yang yang gsungs yod red/

mdor na thams cad brje dgos kyi yod red/ gzhan gyis mi 'dod pa skyo po de tsho tshang ma rang gis tshur len/ 'dod pa thams cad phar gzhan la sbyin pa la goms cha sprad dgos kyi yod red/ dper na rang la gos yag po yod/ gzhan dag la skyo bo yod na de dag brje/ rang gi za ma yag po yod pa de gzhan la za bcug gzhan gyi za ma ngan ngon de rang gis bzas/ de tsho yang bde sdug brje ba red/ de bzhin du spyod 'jug nang dngos su brje ba'i skor mang po gsungs pa red/ dper na gral sa mtho dman brje ba dang / dus rgyun rang gi nyes pa de sbas/ gzhan gyi nyes pa de khyab bsgrag byung na bsam pa'i re ba byed cing/ skabs byung na rang gis nyes pa byas pa rnams gzhan gyis byas pa red ces khag 'dogs byed kyi yod red/ byang chub sems dpas rang gis nyes pa byas pa de ma gsang bar gzhan la bshad/ gzhan gyis nyes pa byas pa de rang gis byas pa yin zhes lab pa de yang dngos su brje ba'i tshul red/ nam rgyun du bdag gces 'dzin gyi sems kyis rang la skad grags byung na bsam pa dang / mi gzhan rang gi kha gtad dam dgra lta bu'i snyan grags de khyab bsgrag ma byung na bsam gyi yod red/ yin na'ang bdag gzhan brje ba sgom dus rang gi skad grags zil gyis gnon thub mkhan gyi mi gzhan gyi bsngags brjod byed pa lta bu'i nyams len la brtson dgos/ de bzhin du bdag gces 'dzin gyis mi gzhan la rang la phan thogs pa'i ca lag gang du 'dug brtag dpyad byas/ ca lag de 'dra yod na thabs shes gzhan ma byung na'ang rkun ma rgyab dgos kyi 'dug bsam/ 'phrog dgos kyi 'dug bsams te thob thabs byed kyi yod red/ da de brjes te gzhan la phan thogs pa'i ca lag rang la gang 'dug bltas/ de sems kyi steng nas nges par gtong ma thub na'ang rang gis rang las 'phrogs te gzhan la gtong dgos kyi yod red/ bdag gzhan ma brje na nyes pa'am skyon gang yod red zer na/
