sangs rgyas thob thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ tshe 'di la yang skyid po yong gi ma red/ dper na mi khag gcig so so ma gtogs gzhan dag pha ma dang spun mched la sogs pa la bsam blo mi gtong mkhan de 'dra yod red/ de'i rigs la tshe 'di la thams cad dgrar langs/ kho rang gcig pur lus/ gra ma 'grigs pa dang*/ dka' las khag po gcig gi nang mi tshe skyel dgos kyi yod red/ mi phal che ba de nga rang legs po byed dgos/ rgyal kha nga rang la thob dgos/ nga rang skad grags che ba byed dgos bsam gyi yod red/ so so rkyang pa gces po byed pa'i bsam blo de tsho la brten nas 'khrugs pa thams cad yong gi yod red/ pha dang bu 'khrugs/ dpon dang g.yog 'khrugs/ dge rgan dang dge phrug dang bza' tshang nang phan tshun 'khrugs pa sogs 'khrugs pa'i nyes pa thams cad de las yong gi yod red/ der brten bdag gces 'dzin de'i gnyen po la byang chub kyi sems sgom dgos gsungs pa red/ yin na'ang go ba len stangs 'di 'dra byed dgos red/ bdag 'dzin spangs pa tsam la ngo mtshar rgyu yod ma red/ nyan thos dgra bcom pas kyang bdag 'dzin spangs tshar yod red/ de'i steng du gzhan gces 'dzin byed pa dang*/ gzhan phan byed pa de theg pa chen po'i lugs red/ bdag gzhan brje ba sgom stangs de byams pa sgom stangs dang gcig pa red/ rtsa ba'i ma nas phyogs gsum bgos te sgom gyi yod red/ dper na ma la sogs pa'i sems can rnams mdun du dmigs te sems can 'di rnams kyi rgyud kyi sdug bsngal thams cad dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu nyon mongs pa la sogs pa rnams dang snod kyi 'jig rten skyo po yin pa la sogs pa'i skyon thams cad rang la thob par shog bsam/ de yi rkyen pas sems can thams cad nyon mongs pa dang sdug bsngal med pa 'gro bar shog bsam/ bdag gzhan brje ba la len pa dang gtong ba'i bya ba gnyis yod red/

len pa la cha mtshon na sangs rgyas dang bla ma gnyis kyi rtsa nas blang rgyu yod ma red/ sangs rgyas las blang rgyu'i mi 'dod pa gang yang yod ma red/ bla ma la gus zhabs zhus pa yin pa red/ de min sems can thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu pa'i bar thams cad las tshur skyon gyi cha rnams blang dgos/ gnyis pa gtong ba'i skabs sangs rgyas la'ang gtong chog gi yod red/ thams cad la gtong gi yod red/ de nas rang gi dge ba dang bde ba yongs rdzogs sems can thams cad dang*/ sangs rgyas la phul gyi yod bsam/ rang gi dge ba cha tshang gcig sems can re re la sprad kyi yin bsam/ de byin pa'i rkyen gyis sems can de rnams gnas skabs gzugs po bde po dang sems bde po/ dpal 'byor longs spyod gra 'grigs po/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas thob pa'i nang gi cha rkyen snying rje dang dad pa la sogs pa dang*/ phyi'i cha rkyen bla ma dang*chos grogs/ dngul la sogs pa gang dgos na'ang gra 'grigs nas sangs rgyas thob la nye bar gyur song bsam/ mtshams rer len pa'i gnas skabs na/ sems can rnams kyi sdig pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad 'od kha dog nag po'i rnam par byung nas rang gi snying kha la thim nas sems can thams cad kyi mi 'dod pa thams cad rang la smin song bsam/ phar gtong dus rang gi snying kha nas 'od dkar po song nas sems can thams cad la phog nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur song bsam/ mtshams rer nyams len 'di dang 'brel ba'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung mdo'i tshig dang / klu sgrub kyi gsung de 'dra skyor dgos kyi yod red/ dper na tshur len pa'i gnas skabs na/ ma gyur 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bdag la smin/ zhes pa'i tshig rkang pa gcig pu 'di tshar mang po brjod/ phreng bar bgrang*ste tshar brgya tsam brjod/ de'i skabs su thams cad tshur rang la smin byung bsam pa byas/ de nas phar gtong ba'i gnas skabs na/

bdag gi bde dges ma rnams bde gyur cig/ ces brjod de bde ba dang dge ba gtong gi yod/ des ma thams cad bde po chags song bsam/ de tshar grangs mang po bsags/ tshar 'bum mang po gsog dgos red/ des sems la 'gyur ba 'gro gi red/ gal chen po gcig spyod 'jug le'u gsum pa'i nang / bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*/ /dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po rnams/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don bzhin du rang gis da phan chad lus dang longs spyod/ dus gsum gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sems can re re la tsha tshang ba re sbyin thub par shog ces smon lam dang / sbyin gyi yin zhes dam bca' byas pa red/ de byas nas ga re dran dgos red zer na/ rang nyid sems can mgon med pa rnams kyi mgon du gyur/ chu la 'gro mkhan tsho'i zam par gyur/ khang pa dgos mkhan la khang pa/ mar me dgos mkhan la mar me/ yang longs spyod dbul po tsho la rin po che rtsa chen po/ dpag bsam gyi shing lta bur gyur song bsam dran dgos kyi yod red/ ched du gtad nas sgom gyi yod sa red/ dper na nga dpag bsam gyi shing yin/ rin po che'i nor bu yin/ des sems can gyi don mang po byed kyi yod bsam/ dngos gnas byang chub sems dpa'i lam nyams len byas na/ spyod 'jug nang dper na sa/ chu/ me/ rlung ste 'byung ba bzhi po de dag gis phyogs mang po nas sems can gyi don byed kyi yod red/ nam mkha' stong pas las ka'i go skabs sprod kyi yod pa de bzhin du nga'i lus dang*/ longs spyod dang*/ dus gsum gyi dge rtsa gsum po rnams kyis sems can thams cad la phyogs mang po nas sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du phan thogs par shog bsam dgos kyi yod red/ dper na za ma za dus za ma yag po 'dug na za ma yag po thob pa'i dge rtsa de sems can thams cad la thob par shog bsam/ za ma sdug po 'dug na za ma sdug po za dgos pa'i sems can thams cad kyi las ngan pa de nga la smin par shog bsam/

yongs rdzogs de 'dra red/ bzang ngan gnyis kyi nang nas ngan pa thams cad nga la yong bar shog/ bzang po thams cad gzhan la thob par shog bsam/ gser gling pas rang sdug po byung na sems can thams cad kyi sdug po rang la smin par shog sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho skam 'gro bar shog ces dang / rang skyid po byung na skyid po 'di 'dra sems can thams cad kyis thob par shog bde ba dang dga' ba dang skyid pas nam mkha' khengs 'gro bar shog ces bsam dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ / bdag gzhan brje ba'i phan yon bshad pa/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i phan yon zhu rgyu yin/ mar gyur 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bdag la smin la zhes pa'i bdag gzhan brje ba'i tshig de 'don pa dang mnyam du de'i don tshar gcig hrib tsam sgom pa'am bsam pa la bsod nams tshad med pa yod ces gsungs pa red/ spyod 'jug dang sdom gsum rab dbye gnyis ka'i nang bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyi nyams len ni sangs rgyas thob pa'i myur lam mam lam mgyogs shos dang / gsang ba'i lam yang yin gsungs pa red/ gang yin zer na/ bsod nams ma bsags pa rnams kyis de la mos pa byed khag po yod red/ der ma zad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i snying po'ang yin gsungs/ mdor na mdo nas ston pa'i thar pa'i lam las bdag gzhan brje ba 'di mtho shos red/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas/ byang chub sems kyi rgyab skyor la rang don byed pa'i nyes dmigs sam skyon dang*/ gzhan don byed pa'i dge mtshan nam phan yon shes dgos gsungs pa red/ theg chen sems bskyed gal chen po de 'dra byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang red zer na/ rgyu mtshan mang po yod red/ sems bskyed kyi dmigs yul sems can rnams kyis da lta rang nyid 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i gnas skabs na rang gi ma la sogs pa byed pa'i sgo nas rang la phan chen po 'dogs shing / lam nyams su len pa'i skabs su'ang sems can la brten nas byams pa/

snying rje/ byang chub kyi sems/ pha rol du phyin pa drug dang bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi bcas de tsho yong gi yod red/ sangs rgyas thob dgos na sems can rnams dga' po dang mgu bo byas/ sems can gyi don ma byas par sangs rgyas thob thabs yod ma red/ bsod nams gsog pa'i yul sems can dang*/ sangs rgyas gnyis yod red/ sangs rgyas la brten nas dad pa dang*/ phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa'i bsod nams yong gi yod red/ des na sangs rgyas ni bsod nams kyi zhing gcig red/ sems can la brten nas byams pa/ snying rje/ byang chub kyi sems/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi sbyin pa dang tshul khrims sogs dang bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi bcas de tsho yong gi yod red/ der brten sems can rnams kyang bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing gcig red/ sems can rnams la bde ba med/ sdug bsngal yod/ bde ba 'dod cing sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa yin pas byams snying rje/ byang chub kyi sems sgom pa ni lam shin tu yag po red/ spyod 'jug nang rang don byed pa'i nyes dmigs dang*/ gzhan don byed pa'i phan yon mang po 'gran bsdur byas nas gsungs yod red/ de tsho'i nang nas kha shas zhu rgyu yin/ so so mi las mtho ba byed dgos bsam pa yin na ngan 'gror skye/ mtho ris thob pa yin na'ang dma' po chags kyi red gsungs pa red/ byang chub sems dpas dman sa zin dgos kyi yod red/ rang nyid lam kha gtsang ma byed mkhan gyi phyag brdar ba zhig yin dran dgos/ de'i don dag gang red zer na/ phyag brdar ba la de las mtho bo byed dgos bsam pa'i bsam blo med pa red/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpas rtag tu dman sa bzung ste nga'i 'og tu 'gro mkhan gang zag su yang med/ nga'i 'og tu 'gro mkhan chu ma gtogs med bsam dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ de 'dra byed dus rang las gzhan mtho 'dod byed pa red/ des rang nyid skye ba rjes mar mtho ris la skye dus go gnas mthon po yod mkhan chags kyi red gsungs pa red/

rang gi don dag la gzhan la gnod 'tshe byas na dmyal ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal yong ba dang / gzhan gyi don dag la rang la gnod pa byas na phun sum tshogs pa yong gi red gsungs pa red/ mi gzhan rang gis g.yog rgyugs bcug pa yin na skye ba rjes ma mang por rang g.yog po chags kyi red/ rang gis mi yi g.yog phar byed pa yin na rjes ma dpon po chags thub kyi red/ mdo gcig gi nang la gsungs kyi 'dug sems de yag po yong thabs ga 'dra byed dgos red zer na/ gzhan la gus zhabs byed cing rang khyad du gsod pa yang nas yang du goms dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ bdag cag ston pas khong sngon ma byang chub sems dpa' yin pa'i skabs la khong gi grogs po tsho la sems dma' po byas/ lus pos phyag 'tshal/ ngag gis bstod pa byed kyi yod/ des khong sangs rgyas pa'i skabs sems can tshang mas gus zhabs byed pa ma zad shing dang me tog sogs kyis kyang gus zhabs zhu gi yod ces gsungs pa red/ de bzhin du nga rgyal byas te gzhan la khyad gsod dper na 'dis chos shes kyi mi 'dug gang yang 'jon gyi mi 'dug lkugs pa red bsams te brnyas bcos byas na skye ba rjes ma rang lkugs par 'gyur gyi red/ de la rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu zer gyi red/ gzhan dag gzugs mdzes po mi 'dug nga gzugs mdzes po yin bsams na rjes ma gzugs sdug po chags kyi yod red/ gzhan dag mi yi g.yog po red/ gzhan gyi za ma za mkhan yin pas skyo po red/ nga phyug po yin/ dpon po yin bsam na rjes ma so so skyo por 'gyur gyi yod red/ de la sogs pa rang gces 'dzin gyi skyon dang gzhan gces par 'dzin pa'i dge mtshan rnams kyi don zhi ba lhas 'bor sdom gnang ste/ mdor na thub pas gzhan don byas pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis sangs rgyas song ba red/ so so skye bos rang don byed pa des 'khor bar 'khyam sdod pa red ces shugs chen po gsungs pa red/

/ phar phyin drug gi ngo bo dang phan yon mdor bstan pa/ da theg pa chen po'i lam ngo ma de pha rol tu phyin pa drug yin pas de'i skor bsdus bsdus byas nas zhu rgyu yin/ pha rol tu phyin pa zhes pa'i pha rol zer na srid pa dang zhi ba gnyis kyi pha rol rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la gsungs pa yin pa red/ de thob pa'i thabs yin stabs pha rol tu phyin pa zer ba red/ sbyin pa ni/ gzhan don du rang la yod pa gzhan la gtong dgos bsam pa'i sems pa la zer ba red/ bya ba la ltos nas bshad pa yin phyir pha rol tu phyin pa drug cha la sems pa gsungs kyi 'dug sbyin pa'i mi mthun phyogs ser sna red/ ser sna'i rgyu ni/ longs spyod la chags pa red/ ser sna zer mkhan de nyes pa chen po red/ de'i 'bras bur yi dwags la skye yi yod red la mtho ris la skyes na'ang dbul po chags kyi yod red/ longs spyod la zhen chags chen po byas na nyes dmigs chen po red/ chags zhen byas nas sdod pa'i rkyen gyis chos sgrub pa'i go skabs mi thob pas thar pa thob kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ spyir sbyin pa la ma dag pa dang dag pa'i dbye ba gnyis yod red/ ma dag pa'i sbyin pa zer dus dper na chang dang / sha dang dug dang / rab byung la phyi dro'i zhal lag phul ba lta bu de tsho red/ sbyin pa la mtho ris thob pa'i sbyin pa yang yod red la/ nyan thos kyi 'bras bu thob pa la sogs pa sna tshogs yod red/ de'i nang nas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zer mkhan de sangs rgyas thob pa'i sbyin pa la zhu gi yod red/ de la sbyor dngos mjug gsum tshang dgos gsungs 'dug sbyor ba la pha rol tu phyin pa'i dge ba thams cad kyi mgo la sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du sbyin pa la sogs pa'i bsgrub bya dge ba 'di dang 'di bya'o bsam pa'i sems bskyed byed dgos kyi yod red/

che chung gang gtong na'ang 'dra/ bar du ste dge ba de rnams dngos su byed pa'i ring la sbyin pa la sogs pa'i bya rgyu'i dge ba rnams stong pa nyid yin bsam pa stong nyid kyis rtsis zin pa zhig dgos kyi yod red/ mjug la'ang sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur bar shog bsam pa'i bsngo ba byed dgos kyi yod red/ de gsum tshang ba'i sgo nas sbyin sogs drug bsgrubs na theg pa chen po'i chos sam lam cha tshang zhig chags kyi yod red/ dbye ba byas na sbyin pa la gsum yod red/ de'i nang nas chos kyi sbyin pa gtong dus chos nyan mkhan rnams kyi ma rig pa la sogs pa'i nyon mongs dang bral na snyam pa dang de'i ched du chos 'chad snyam pa'i snying rje'i kun slong gi sgo nas/ 'chad rgyu'i chos kyang ma nor bar byas te 'chad pa la chos kyi sbyin pa zer gyi red/ dper na chos bshad pa'i sgo nas rang la rnyed pa thob mi yong ngam/ gus zhabs thob mi yong ngam/ der ma zad chos yag po bshad pa la brten nas mkhas pa 'dug zer mi yong ngam/ thugs rje che zer mi yong ngam bsam pa sogs de 'dra'i bsam blo byung na/ bsam blo'am kun slong de tsho rnyed bkur la chags pa yin zhing / de 'dra'i bsam blo'i sgo nas chos 'chad mkhan rnams ni/ tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min zer mkhan der 'gyur gyi yod red/ zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams ngag ni rang gi bya rgyu'i chos sam nyams len la zhus dag byed par ha cang phan po yod red/ theg chen gyi lam la slob pa'i chos pas rang gi chos gang byas kyang zhen pa bzhi dang bral ba zhig byung 'dug mi 'dug brtag dpyad byed dgos kyi yod red/ zang zing gi sbyin pa ni/ longs spyod ster ba la zer gyi yod red/ dang por sbyin pa gtong ba la gtong rgyu'i phyi nang gi dngos po la chags zhen gyi rtsa ba la brten pa'i ser sna la goms shugs chen po yod pa'i rkyen gyis sems pas nyan khag po byed kyi yod red/

sbyin pa gtong ma 'dod pa'i dbang du phyin te gtong ha cang khag po yod red/ yin na'ang sbyin pa gtong ba'i las ka bzang po la slob sbyong ngam sbyong brdar sprad dgos yin pa red/ dang po sbyin pa gtong dgos kyi 'dug sems pa'i bsam blo yong thabs byed dgos kyi yod red/ dper na slong mkhan gcig mthong byung na 'di nga la gnod skyel mkhan nam sems sun po bzo mkhan zhig red bsam pa gcig yong gi yod red/ 'on kyang bsam blo de'i dbang du ma song bar 'di gnod skyel mkhan ma red/ phan 'dogs mkhan red/ 'di bsod nams gsog bcug mkhan/ sangs rgyas mgyogs po thob bcug mkhan red/ der brten 'di phan thogs byed mkhan red bsams te sems ma 'khrugs par dga' po byed dgos kyi yod red/ bsam blo de 'dra rang gi sems la 'char ba la nam rgyun du sbyin pa gtong ba'i phan yon dang ser sna byed pa'i skyon mdo dang bstan bcos rnams las gsungs pa rnams yang nas yang du dran dgos/ rab byung rnams kyis zang zing gi sbyin pa gtong mi rung gsungs pas de la do khur byed dgos med pa 'dra/ dpal 'byor 'du 'god byed stangs skor bsam blo gtong dgos ma red/ de las kyang bsgrub bya gal che ba tshul khrims srung rgyu dang*/ thos bsam sgom gsum byed rgyu rnams yin gsungs pa red/ zang zing gi sbyin pa gtong bsdad na gal che ba'i thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba la bar chad byed kyi red gsungs pa red/ 'on kyang chos kyi sbyin pa gtong dgos kyi yod red/ spyir sbyin pa gtong thub pa la nam rgyun bsam blo gtong dus dran dgos pa 'di yin zhes mdo gcig gi nang gsungs pa red/ rgyu nor khyim na gsog 'jog byas te bzhag pa la so so'i skye bo rnams kyis bsngags brjod byed kyi yod red/ sbyin pa gtong ba la sangs rgyas kyis bsngags brjod byed kyi yod red ces bsam/

rgyu nor nang la bzhag bzhag pa de 'khor ba'i rgyu red/ sbyin pa gtong ba ni sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu red bsam/ nang la bzhag bzhag pa de rang rkyang pa'i yin pa'i nges pa yod ma red/ rkun ma la sogs pa'i thun mong bar gyur pa red/ sbyin pa btang bzhag na dge ba rkun mas 'phrog thub kyi med pas rang gi 'gyur gyi yod red bsam/ longs spyod zer mkhan de gsog mkhan so sos bsags pa red de bed spyod gzhan dag gis byed srid kyi red ces bsam pa la sogs pa mang po gsungs 'dug de nas dngos gzhi sbyin pa gtong ba'i las la dngos su sbyong brdar sprod pa'i skabs la dang po gtong rgyu'i dngos po la chung chung nas yar goms dgos kyi yod pa red/ dang po nas chen po gcig gtong thabs byas na rjes ma 'gyod pa skyes/ de nas mtshams bzhag 'gro gi yod red/ des na dang po dngos po chung chung*/ dper na chu rdza ma gang dang za ma kham gang lta bu/ dngul chung shos 'dra po/ dang po 'di 'dra byas te gtong*/ de nas rim gyis che ba gtong ba la bslabs te thams cad gtong dgos kyi yod red/ de bzhin du gtong sa'i yul la dang po chos phyogs dang 'brel ba bla ma dge bshes dge 'dun pa la gtong thub/ sems can dkyus ma nyams thag la sbyin mi thub pa yin na/ chos phyogs la snga ma las legs tsam gtong*/ de nas rim pas thams cad la gtong*ba la slobs/ de bzhin du dus tshod lta bu la cha mtshon na/ dang po tshes bzang dus bzang lta bu la sbyin pa gtong*/ de nas tshes bzang ma yin pa'i nyin ma de ring yang sbyin pa gtong bsam pa byas te dus tshod thams cad la sbyin pa gtong*ba la bslab dgos/ sbyin pa gtong yag nges par mgo 'dzugs byed dgos red/ 'di gal chen po red/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu drug gi dang po de red/ sbyin pa ma btang na skye ba phyi ma rnams su mi la skyes na'ang dbul po chag gi yod red/ longs spyod med na skyid po yod ma red/

de'i phyir sbyin pa gtong ba'i las bzang po de da lta nas mgo 'dzugs dgos red/ sbyin pa gtong dus slong mo ba la brnyas bcos byas te bka' bkyon btang nas sprad rgyu yod ma red/ brnyas bcos byas na nyes pa yong gi yod red/ sems kyi gting nas dga' po byas/ gdong par 'dzum yod pa byas te yag po byas nas gus zhabs byas te btang ba yin na de la phan yon gcig yong gi yod red/ so so la dus tshod yod na so so rang gi lag pas gtong dgos kyi yod red/ de la'ang dge mtshan gcig yod red/ de bzhin du sprad rgyu yod na rjes ma sprad zer rgyu yod ma red/ kha thug la sprad dgos kyi yod red/ ca lag skyo ba rnams bdams te sprad rgyu yod ma red/ yag shos de sprad dgos kyi yod red/ yin na'ang so sos nyams su len pa'i sbyin sogs drug po gang yin na'ang pha rol tu phyin par 'gyur ba la yon tan nam khyad chos bzhi tshang dgos kyi red ces byams pa mgon pos gsungs pa red/ dper na sbyin pa gsum las gang nyams su len pa yin na'ang de'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs ser sna bcom thub pa dang/ sbyin pa stong pa nyid yin bsam pa'i shes rab kyis rtsis zin pa dang / sems can gyi 'dod pa rdzogs par byed thub pa dang/ des gtong yul gyi blo mgu po byas te rim gyis theg pa gsum gang rung gi lam la bcug dgos kyi yod red/ de bzhin du rang gi sbyin pa de skyon bdun nam chags pa bdun dang bral ba'am med pa zhig yong thabs byed dgos kyi yod red/ de yang chags pa'i skyon bdun ni/ 1 longs spyod la chags pa dang / 2 rjes ma sprod kyi yin bsam pa phyi bshol la chags pa dang/ 3 tog tsam btang nas des chog par 'dzin pa dang/ 4 sbyin pa de'i lan tshe 'di la sprad yong bsam pa lan la re ba dang/ 5 tshe phyi ma la de'i 'bras bu bzang po thob yong bsam pa rnam smin la re ba ste de gnyis kyis skyon chen po byed kyi yod red/

lan dang rnam smin la re ba byed pa ni tshong pa'i las ka red gsungs pa red/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam ma red/ sbyin pa gtong dus sbyin pa de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i 'bras bu dang bcas pa khyed la sprad kyi yin bsam dgos kyi yod red/ de nas mi mthun phyogs la chags pa zer dus ser snas gtong ma 'dod pa/ bdun pa rnam smin la chags pa zer ba de la nyan thos kyi 'bras bu thob 'dod dang*/ sbyin pa'i 'khor gsum la sgyu ma lta bur ma bsams nas zhen 'dzin byed pa dang gnyis yod red/ der ma zad phar phyin re re la drug drug tshang ba'i nyams len byed pa la slob pa 'di yang gal chen po red/ de ma byas na skyon mang po chags yong gi yod red/ drug tshang ba dper na sbyin pa zhig gtong na de sbyin pa byas/ de la nyan thos kyi 'bras bu thob 'dod ma byas pa dang tshe 'di la zhen pa ma byas pa lta bu de tshul khrims red/ yang slong mkhan gyis tshig rtsub bshad na khong khro ma byas pa de bzod pa dang/ sbyin pa gtong ba la dga' po byed pa ni brtson 'grus dang / sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu yin bsam ste sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu la bsngo ba byed pa ni bsam gtan dang / sbyin pa stong pa nyid bsam pa de shes rab ste drug tshang ba red/ sbyin pa gsum yod pa'i nang nas gcig de gong du bshad mi 'dug de mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa zer gyi red/ mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa ni rgyal po'i chad pa las srung skyob byed pa lta bu/ me dang chu yi gnod pa las srung skyob byed pa dang/ phyi ma ngan song las srung skyob byed pa rnams yin gsungs kyi yod red/ phar phyin drug gi phan yon mnyam por bshad na/ mdo gcig nang gsungs 'dug de sdum bde po 'dug bsam byung*/ ser sna la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs 'joms pa dang gcig sangs rgyas thob par byed pa dang gnyis/ tshe 'di la rang dang gzhan la phan thogs yod pa dang gsum/

skye ba phyi ma phan chad la 'bras bu yag po yong ba dang bzhi yod pa de tsho sems la nyar rogs gnang / chos zhus pa de tshe 'di la ma zhen pa/ 'khor ba la ma zhen par sangs rgyas thob pa'i don du yin bsam pa gnang rogs gnang*/ jo nang kun dga' grol mchog gis bod nang grags pa'i khrid rnams tshur bsdus nas khrid brgya tham pa bzos pa red/ de la jo nang khrid brgya zer ba deng sang chos lugs bzhi kas 'chad nyan gnang gi yod red/ zhen pa bzhi bral de khong blo chos su 'gro bar phan thogs chen po byung ba de'i bka' drin rjes dran gyi ched du khrid thams cad kyi mgo la bzhag pa yin gsungs pa red/ 'dzin pa byung na lta ba min zhes pa'i don rgyas par bshad pa/ de ring pha rol tu phyin pa gzhan dag bzhag nas bsam gtan dang shes rab bam/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi skor dka' las khag po yin pas de tsho'i skor zhu rgyu yin/ dus tshod byung na gzhan dag kyang zhu bsam pa yin/ bsam gtan dang zhi gnas ma bsgoms pa'i skyon gang yod red zer na/ de yi mi mthun phyogs gnyis las rnam g.yengs kyis nyon mongs pa tshang ma'i sgo phye bzhag gi yod red/ dper na rang don du kha ton gang byas na'ang sems de rnam par g.yengs bsdad na phan thogs chen po med pa 'dra/ bsod nams brtan pa zhu rgyu'i lam 'bras kyi bla ma zhig yod red/ khong gis dus gsum du sems rnam par g.yengs pa'i lus ngag gi las la phan pa gang yang yod ma red/ dbu ma'i gzhung la thos bsam rgya chen po byas na lta ba go thub kyi yod red ces gsungs pa red/ 'di ha cang gnad 'gag chen po gsungs pa red/ gang yin zhe na/ lhag mthong sgom pa'i sngon du lta ba thob dgos kyi yod red/ lta ba ma rnyed na lhag mthong sgom pa med cing de ma bsgoms na gnas lugs dngos su rtogs thub kyi yod ma red/ de'i rkyen pas nyon mongs spong mi thub/ sdug bsngal yang spong thub kyi ma red/

zhi gnas sgom pa'i sgo nas bsam gtan gyi sems ma thob na mngon shes yong rgyu yod ma red/ mngon shes med na gzhan don tshad ldan byed rgyu de dkon po red/ sgom byas te rang gi sems kyi steng du zhi lhag gi lam grub na de nas thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa gang bsgrub dgos na'ang dka' las med pa'i thog nas sgrub thub kyi yod red/ bsam gtan gyi ngo bo ni/ sems dge ba'i dmigs pa gcig gi steng du yun ring du gnas pa la zer ba red/ de la dbye ba byas na gsum yod red gsungs pa red/ mthong chos bde gnas kyi bsam gtan zhes bsam gtan sgom dus lus dang sems la chags zhen med pa'i bde ba yod cing / tshe 'di la bde po byed kyi yod pas de la mthong chos bde gnas zer/ gnyis pa yon tan mngon par 'grub pa'i bsam gtan ni/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i ting nge 'dzin tshad med pa gcig byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yod cing / de dag la brten nas yon tan mang po thob pas na yon tan mngon par 'grub pa'i bsam gtan zer gyi yod red/ gsum pa gzhan don sgrub pa'i bsam gtan ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis nad la sogs pa zhi ba/ tshe ring po dang / dpal 'byor chen po la sogs pa gang dgos pa rnams ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis byed kyi yod red/ de la gzhan don byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin zer gyi yod/ ting nge 'dzin sgom pa la dang po zhi gnas kyi rgyu tshogs thabs shes byed dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ rgyu tshogs gra sgrig ma byas par lo stong phrag sgom na yang zhi gnas thob kyi ma red ces jo bo rjes gsungs pa red/ rgyu rkyen drug tshang dgos kyi red ces ka ma la shī la dang thogs med gnyis kas gsungs pa red/ dang po sgom rgyag sa'i sa cha yag po dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ sa cha der mthun rkyen 'grub las sla po/ dug sbrul gdug pa can la sogs pa de 'dras lus po la gnod pa mi byed sa/

nyin mo mi dang*/ mtshan mo sgra med sa/ gal che shos de chos kyi grogs po yag po lta ba dang spyod pa mthun pa yin pa/ yon tan yag po yod mkhan/ khyad par du chos byed mkhan/ de'i gam na bsdad na yon tan dang chos 'gos yong mkhan/ ting nge 'dzin sgom myong mkhan/ nyams yod mkhan/ de 'dra'i grogs po'am yang na bla ma 'tshol dgos kyi yod red/ gnyis pa ni 'dod pa chung chung dgos gsungs pa red/ 'dod pa chung chung zer na da lta'i 'tsho ba mthun rkyen gang yod pa 'di las legs pa dgos/ 'di las mang ba dgos mi bsam pa la zer gyi red/ gsum pa chog shes pa zer na 'di yis 'grigs kyi 'dug bsam pa de red/ bzhi pa 'jig rten gyi las mi byed cing/ dgon pa'i skor la sogs pa'i bsam blo med mkhan/ gsar 'gyur mi nyan/ gang ltar spros pa thams cad bzhag nas 'on pa dang long ba nang bzhin bsdad dgos kyi red/ lnga pa gal che shos de tshul khrims gtsang ma dgos pa yin/ sdom pa gang blangs yod na'ang de gtsang ma bsrungs*/ tshul khrims ni ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu thun mong ma yin pa red/ dper na phar phyin drug snga ma snga ma rgyu/ phyi ma phyi ma 'bras bu yin pa nang bzhin bslab pa gsum gyi dang po tshul khrims/ de nas ting nge 'dzin/ de nas shes rab rnams kyang snga ma snga ma rgyu dang phyi ma rnams 'bras bu red/ phar phyin drug gi nang nas phar phyin dang po bzhi po de bsam gtan gyi rgyu red/ lnga pa 'di'i skor zhi ba lhas spyod 'jug bsam gtan le'u'i nang du mang po gsungs 'dug zhi gnas sam bsam gtan bsgom pa la 'jig rten dang rnam rtog spong dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ 'jig rten zer na rang dang 'brel ba'i gnyen nye du dang bshes sam grogs po grogs mo yin pa'i sems can la 'dod chags dang*/ longs spyod la chags pa la zer/ rnam rtog zer na de gnyis min pa'i bsam blo mi dran dgu dran la zer ba red/

sa cha dben par bsdad na'ang nang gi rnam rtog de tsho ma spangs na jo bo 'khyags pa nang la sdod bsdad pa 'dra po skyon chen po byed kyi yod pas de tsho spong dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ bsam gtan las 'phros te dngos su bsgom la sbyor tshul bshad pa/ sgom la dngos su sbyor ba'i skor bshad kyi yin/ khang pa yag po gcig gi nang la gdan yag po gding*/ mdun du mchod pa bshams/ khyad par du spos ma spar na yag po yod kyi red/ de nas sngon ma zhen pa bzhi bral gyi mgo de tsho tshang ma dran dgos red/ ma gzhi 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang dal 'byor rnyed dka' la sogs pa de tsho dus rgyun du sems kyi thog tu dran/ byams snying rje la sogs pa'ang dran te/ kha ton 'don na nges par sems la 'gyur ba 'gro gi yod red/ yag po chags pa gtan 'khel ba red/ de nas skyabs 'gro dang mjug la gsol 'debs/ sems bskyed dang / yan lag bdun pa/ khyad par du gsol 'debs skabs zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gsol 'debs nang nas "'khrul snang dbyings su zhi bar byin gyis rlobs "zhes pa 'di mang ba 'don/ gsol 'debs 'di dmigs bsal zhig red/ de rnams byed dgos/ da lta nga tshos zhi lhag gi skor khrid rgyu de 'dzin pa byung na lta ba min zhes pa de'i don red/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gnyis kyi sgo nas khrid dgos kyi yod red/ zhi gnas sgom dus dmigs rten gra sgrig byed dgos kyi red/ dmigs rten la spyir mi 'dra ba mang po yod sa red/ kha phyir bltas sangs rgyas kyi sku/ zad par gyi skye mched sgom na sa chu 'dra po/ kha nang blta la lus po keng rus su sgom pa/ dbugs sam rlung la yid rten byed pa lta bu de 'dra dmigs rten mang po gsungs yod red/ de'i nang nas thun mong du sangs rgyas kyi sku la dmigs rten byas nas bsgoms na sangs rgyas la dad pa skye ba lta bu'i dge mtshan mang po yod red gsungs pa red/

des na sangs rgyas kyi sku bris bzhag pa'am blugs sku de 'dra mtho dman mtsham po gcig rang gi mdun du bzhag ste sgom dgos kyi yod red/ lam 'bras nang la me tog sngon po dmigs rten byed kyi yod red/ me tog sngon po che chung gor tshad in chi gsum tsam zhig sngon por mig la mi gnod pa'i yon tan yod red gsungs pa red/ yang na ras sngon po bzhag na 'grigs kyi yod red/ rang las gnya' shing gang tsam mam khru drug tsam gyi 'gyangs tshad la bzhag de'ang g.yo 'gul mi byed pa/ mkhas pa kha shas kyis sgom byed dus phyi log gi gzugs la mig gis blta ba de la dgag pa byed kyi yod red/ yin na'ang de khungs lung yod mkhan dang*phan thogs chen po yod mkhan gcig yin pa red/ stan yag po gcig gi steng du gzugs po'i sdod stangs yag po byed dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ rkang pa gnyis rnam par snang mdzad kyi skyil krung lta bu rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ yang na sems dpa'i skyil krung zer dus rdo rje'i skyil krung phyed pa rje btsun sgrol ma'i skyil krung lta bu la bsdad/ lus po drang por srang*/ g.yas g.yon gang du yang ma yo ba byas/ mdun du mi sgur/ rgyab la mi dgye/ de gal chen po yin pa red/ mgo yang mthon po min pa/ dma' po yang ma yin pa/ phrag pa gnyis po snyoms po byas/ mig gdangs drags na rgod pa dang*/ btsums drags na bying ba byed kyi red gsungs yod/ mig lpags pas phyed tsam bkab/ sna yi rtse mo la bltas/ so dang mchu tha mal par bzhag cing rbad de kha btsums ma bsdad pa byas/ lce de so'i drung du bzhag dgos gsungs pa red/ khyad par du gal che shos dbugs de red/ dbugs de sgom rgyag dus sems dang rlung gnyis mnyam du 'gro dgos kyi yod pas sems gang du gtad na'ang rlung der slebs kyi yod red/ sems gnas dgos kyi 'dug bsam ste sems gnon pa 'dra po byas na rlung de bkag 'gro yi yod red/

de'i rkyen pas na tsha byed kyi yod red/ des na rlung de zhib 'jug byed rgyu gal chen po red/ rlung phar 'gro ba dang*/ tshur yong pa dus rgyun gang byed kyi yod na'ang de la bzo bcos ma byas pa rang sor gzhag dgos kyi yod red/ sgom byed bzhin pa'i skabs la zhib 'jug byed dgos kyi yod red/ rlung de la skad yod mkhan dang*/ rlung ngar po de 'dra ma yin pa rlung lhod po dgos kyi yod red/ don du rlung phar 'gro tshur yong ha ma go ba de 'dra gcig dgos kyi red ces ka ma la shī las nan tan gsungs pa red/ spyir btang sgom byed dus sngon la gra sgrig byed dgos kyi yod red/ gzugs pos las ka mang po mi byed pa dang / ngag gi sgo nas kyang skad cha mang po mi bshad cing kha ton yang nyung du gtong*/ sems la las ka ma bskul ba byas/ de 'dra byas te yun ring po sdod dgos kyi yod pa 'dra/ mdo yi nang sgom rgyag dus gzugs po'am lus kyi 'dug stangs de 'dra byed pa la ting nge 'dzin mgyogs po skye ba dang*/ dka' ngal med pa dang*/ gzhan dag dad pa 'gro ba la sogs pa rgyu mtshan mang po gsungs kyi yod red/ lam 'bras kyi nang la lus gnad bdun po de tsho re re bzhin du ma byas pa'i skyon/ byas pa'i phan yon zhib cha gsungs kyi yod red/ sgom byed stangs la mdo dang byams pa'i gsung mdo sde rgyan lta bu'i nang la sems gnas pa'i thabs dgu gsungs pa red/ de'i nang nas dang po 'jog zer ba de red/ 'jog zer dus dmigs rten la sems gtad cing 'jog pa la gsungs/ de la lam 'bras nang khyad chos bzhi tshang dgos gsungs pa red/ dmigs rten la g.yo 'gul med pa/ so so'i gzugs po g.yo 'gul mi byed pa/ mig gis rdzi ma mi 'khrab pa/ mig mi 'gul ba ste mig la rnam rtog gi rtsa yod pas mig 'gul na sems la rnam rtog slong gi yod red/ gsar pa rnams la mig nas mchi ma thon pa la sogs pa khag po yong gi yod red de goms 'gro dus 'grigs 'gro gi yod red/

dmigs rten gyi rnam pa gsal po yong ba gcig byed dgos pa bcas khyad chos bzhi tshang dgos kyi yod red gsungs/ dmigs rten me tog lta bu/ me tog de'i thog la mig dang sems gnyis cha gtad de/ dmigs pa de sems kyi thog la gsal po 'char ba zhig byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin la dus rgyun bde ba dang*/ gsal ba/ mi rtog pa'i yon tan gsum tshang dgos gsungs pa red/ yin na'ang bde ba yod pa'i nges pa med pa 'dra/ bsam gtan gsum pa yan chad la bde ba yod ma red/ gsal ba dang mi rtog pa gnyis po nges par dgos kyi yod red/ des na yul de gsal po dgos kyi yod red/ de'i thog la mi rtog pa dgos kyi yod red/ dus rgyun 'grel pa de 'dra rgyag gi ma red/ sgom byed pa'i thabs mdo las gsungs pa red/ sgom rgyag pa nang bzhin yag po yong ba la sgom gyi nyes pa'am skyon lnga spong*dgos pa dang / de la gnyen po 'du byed brgyad bsten dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ 'du byed brgyad ni sems byung brgyad la zer/ de brgyad la las byed bcug dgos kyi yod red/ sgom gyi nyes pa'am skyon dang po ni le lo red/ de ni sgom byed mi 'dod pa la zer gyi yod red/ de'i gnyen po la 'du byed brgyad las bzhi yod red/ dang po ni dad pa red/ ting nge 'dzin nam sgom gyi las ka la phan yon chen po yod pa shes nas ting nge 'dzin sgom pa la sems dang ba ni dad pa red/ gnyis pa ni 'dun pa red/ de ni sgom byed pa la dang ba'i shugs kyis ting nge 'dzin sgom dgos kyi 'dug bsam pa'i sgom 'dod la zer gyi yod red/ dad pa dang 'dun pa'am 'dod pa gnyis yod na ting nge 'dzin dngos su sgom pa la 'jug pa'i spro ba 'byung gi yod red/ de la brtson 'grus zer gyi red/ de gsum pa red/ bzhi pa ni shin sbyangs red/ sgom gyi las ka spro po'i sgo nas thun bcad de mu 'thud sgom sdod dus sems la gnas cha yong gi red/

gnas cha byung ba'i rjes mu 'thud de yang yang sgom sdod dus shin sbyangs zer mkhan de skye yi yod red/ de med na sgom byed pa la sogs pa'i dge ba rnams tshad ldan yong khag po yod red/ shin sbyangs kyang gtso bo sems byung gcig la ngos 'dzin dgos red/ nyams len pa'i sems la shin sbyangs skyes dus dge ba ci tsam byas na'ang dka' las med pa byed thub pa'i sems byung gcig skye yi yod red/ de'i rkyen pas lus la'ang shin sbyangs thob cing / lus shin sbyangs zer ba ni lus la rlung yag po rgyugs te lus po la bde ba skyes shing lus las su rung bar gyur nas sngon ma dge ba byed mi thub mkhan/ lus kyis sgom byed mi thub mkhan/ lus kyi gnas ngan len zer ba de med pa chag nas sgom las sla por rgyag thub mkhan zhig chags gi yod red/ khyad par du yun ring po ga tshod sgom na'ang dka' las med mkhan gcig chag gi yod red/ de la lus kyi shin sbyangs zer gyi red/ shin sbyangs ni brtson 'grus kyi 'bras bu red/ shin sbyangs yod na brtson 'grus gong 'phel du gtong thub kyi yod pas de brtson 'grus kyi rgyu yang red/ nyes pa'am skyon gnyis pa ni brjed pa red/ de'i gnyen po ni sgom gyi dmigs pa gang yin pa de ma brjed pa'am/ yang na dran pa zer ba de red/ brjed pa dang dran pa zer ba de dag dus rgyun bshad pa dang cung zad 'dra yi med pa 'dra/ da lta 'dir brjed pa zer rgyu de dper na me tog la dmigs rten byas te sems la ting nge 'dzin bzo dus me tog de ga rang dran dgos rgyu yin pa la dmigs pa shor nas me tog mi dran pa de la zer gyi yod red/ sgom zer mkhan de dran pa rang yin pa 'dra/ me tog kho rang gang 'dra sgom gyi yod pa de rtag par ma shor ba byed dgos kyi yod red/ rtag par dran pa de sgom gyi dngos gzhi ngo ma de red/ sgom gyi skyon nam nyes pa gsum pa ni bying rgod red/

de yang sgom dngos su rgyag dus sgom gyi dngos gzhi'i skyon che shos ni bying rgod gnyis red/ bying rgod gnyis sems byung tha dad red de/ de gnyis 'dir gcig tu rtsis pa red/ bying ba ni/ dmigs pa mi gsal ba rmugs pa la zer gyi yod red/ rmugs pa zer na sems las su mi rung bar byed pa'i dmigs pa gsal po med pa la bying ba zer gyi yod red/ de gnyis ming gi rnam grangs red/ rgod pa ni/ spyir rgod pa dang rnam g.yeng zhes pa gnyis gsung gi yod pa gnyis ka nyon mongs pa red de/ sems dge ba'i dmigs pa gang yin pa de'i thog la ma bsdad par gzhan dag cig gi thog tu 'gro ba'am 'phro ba'i cha la rnam g.yeng zer gyi yod red/ da lan rgod pa zer rgyu de rnam g.yeng la ma rtsis pa red/ 'di'i rgod pa ni sems sgom gyi dmigs pa las phyi log tu 'phro ba tsam ma yin pa 'dod yon gyi thog tu 'phro ba zhig la gsungs pa red/ de yang sgom mam kha 'don lta bu byed sdod pa'i ring la sngon ma 'dod pa'i yon tan de 'dra zhig la longs spyad pa yin/ ma 'ongs par 'di dang 'di lta bu la longs spyod kyi yin bsam pa 'dod yon gyi thog tu sems 'phro ba 'dod chags kyi cha shas red/ bying rgod gnyis kyi gnyen po la shes bzhin zer ba'i sems byung gcig yod red pa de bsten dgos/ shes bzhin ni sgom byed pa'i skabs su sgom gyi skyon rnams sel stangs dang gnyen po rnams lag tu len stangs 'di 'dra dang 'di 'dra red ces shes pa'i shes rab la zer ba red/ shes stangs gang 'dra byed dgos red zer na/ sgom byas nas tog tsam red tshar dus sgom ma shor ba byas te/ so so rang gi sems dmigs pa'i thog tu bsdad 'dug dang mi 'dug gzhan dag gcig gi thog tu phyin 'dug gam mi 'dug ces brtag dpyad btang nas sems kyi gnas stangs shes dgos kyi yod red/ nyes pa bzhi pa ni gnyen po 'du mi byed pa zhes pa /

sgom rgyag dus bying rgod gang rung byung na'ang tshod mi byed pa sems de ga rang gi thog tu gnas bcug pa'am de gnyis sel ba'i gnyen po la 'du mi byed pa'am 'bad brtson mi byed pa la zer gyi red/ de'i gnyen po ni 'du byed dam sems pa zhes pa de yang sems byung gcig red/ spyir sems pa ni gtso sems yul la 'khrid cing de la las bskul mkhan zhig red/ dper na rgyal po chen po gling khar 'khrid mkhan gyi mi 'dra po'i sems byung de la sems pa zer gyi yod red/ der brten bying ba dang rgod pa byung na de'i gnyen po la sems byung sems pa des rtsol ba byed dgos kyi yod red/ de yang bying rgod chung chung byung ba lta bu yin na/ bying na sgrims/ phyi log tu rgod yod na sems de gzhan la phyin yod pa dran nas bying rmugs med pa'i thog la bzhag da byung ma song dran rgyu med pa 'dra/ da rtsa ba nas byung ma song dran na des skyon byed kyi yod red/ sems phyi log la song na'ang tshur bkug ste dmigs pa'i thog tu bzhag bying rgod chen po byung na gnyen po mang po bsten dgos kyi yod red/ de yang sems bying na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar chen po rnams la sems shing des bying ba bsal ba dang mu 'thud de sgom la spro bo byed/ sems rgod song ba yin na 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i skor sems pa'i sgo nas sems la skyo ba skye bcug ste rgod pa sel nas slar mu 'thud de bsgom pa la brtson dgos pa yin/ nyes pa lnga pa ni sems kyis gnyen po 'du byed drags pa'am rtsol ba byed drags pa la zer ba red/ de yang bying rgod byung ba la gnyen po bsten pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rang gi sems la bying rgod med cing dmigs pa'i thog tu yag po bsdad song na gong gi bying rgod sel ba'i gnyen po rnams mu 'thud bsten dgos ma red/ gal te mu 'thud 'du byed bsdad na rnam rtog langs 'gro gi yod red/

des na nyes pa lnga pa la 'du byed drags pa zer gyi red/ de'i gnyen po ni 'du byed btang snyoms red/ spyir btang snyoms la kha shas yod red/ de'i nang nas 'du byed btang snyoms zer ba de yang sems byung gcig red/ sems byung de yi bya ba ni sems lhod po byas te 'jog mkhan yin pas sems dmigs pa'i steng la bying rgod med par sdod bcug gi yod pas de la 'du byed btang snyoms zer gyi yod red/ dus rgyun sgom rgyag pa'i skabs su gal che ba'i gdams ngag dang por sgrims/ bar du glod/ tha mar sgrims glod ran po byas te rang sor 'jog dgos kyi yod red gsungs pa red/ dang por sems ma sgrims na rnam rtog mang po 'char ba rnams bkag thub kyi yod ma red/ sgrims nas sgom gyi dmigs pa dang ma 'brel ba'i rnam rtog gam bsam blo gzhan pa med par yul kho rang gi steng du sdod pa zhig byung na sems tog tsam glod pa ni/ bar du glod zer ba'i don red/ yang glod drags pas sems bying zhing rmugs pa la 'gro na de dus yang sgrims/ yang glod pa ste de 'dra res mos byas te mthar rang gi sems dmigs pa'i steng du bying rgod gnyis gang yang med pa gsal la mi rtog par bsdad na de ga rang gi thog tu rang sor 'jog dgos gsungs pa red/ sems gnas thabs phyi ma rnams bshad kyi yin/ kha shas kyis sems gnas kyi rim pa res mos gsungs kyi 'dug gnyis pa rgyun du 'jog ces pa ni/ rang sems dmigs pa'i thog tu 'jog pa tsam ma yin par dus ring du 'jog pa la zer/ gsum pa glan te 'jog zer dus sems rang gi dmigs pa las phyi logs gam gzhan du 'gro gi yod na dmigs pa'i steng du tshur khur yong ste sngon ma de'i steng du 'jog dgos pa'o/ bzhi pa nye bar 'jog zhes pa ni/ mang po yengs song na yang bskyar dmigs pa'i steng du 'jog lnga pa dul bar byed ces pa'i don ni/

sgom rgyag dus lus sems dub ste dka' las khag nas sgom snying mi 'dod pa byung na/ ting nge 'dzin sgom na yon tan chen po yod red bsams te sgom mu 'thud de byed mi 'dod pa de dul zhing zhi nas yang bskyar sgom pa dang/ drug pa zhi bar byed ces pa ni/ dper na rnam rtog dang nyon mongs pa mang po skyes nas sgom khag po byung na rnam g.yengs kyi nyes pa bsams nas yang bskyar ting nge 'dzin sgom pa la gsungs pa dang/ bdun pa nye bar zhi bar byed zer ba ni bying rgod gang rung gi rnam rtog rgyun chung chung byung na de'i skyon mthong nas yang bskyar sgom pa/ sems dmigs pa'i steng du gnas pa'i thabs dgu las dang po bzhi po rnams kyis dmigs pa'i thog tu 'jog stangs gsungs pa dang/ de nas gsum gyis de ltar rang gi sems dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu gnas thabs byed skabs 'gal rkyen byung ba sel stangs gsungs pa dang/ sems gnas thabs brgyad pa dang dgu pa gnyis po ting nge 'dzin nam sgom byed pa'i grub 'bras red/ de yang brgyad pa rtse gcig tu byed zer ba ni/ sgrims na dus yun ji tsam sgom na'ang rang sems dmigs pa'i steng du rtse gcig tu gnas pa dang / dgu pa mngon par 'jog par byed ces pa ni/ de ltar du goms pas nam zhig za ma zos pa dang*/ 'gro ba dang*/ 'dug pa sogs ga re byed kyang rtsol ba ma byas na'ang sems gnas pa de la zer ba red/ spyir sems la 'dod khams dang / gzugs khams dang*/ gzugs med khams kyi sems te gsum du dbye rgyu yod red/ gong gi gnas thabs dgu pa'i sems kyi gnas cha de ni 'dod sems rtse gcig pa zer ba de red/ de ni bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi ting nge 'dzin nam sgom mtshan nyid pa ma red gsungs pa red/ da dung sgom sdod dus phan thogs chen po yod red/ shin sbyangs zer ba de skye yi yod red/ shin sbyangs skyes yong dus zhi gnas mtshan nyid pa chags pa red/

de gzugs khams kyis bsdus pa'i sems red/ kun mkhyen gyis 'dod sems rtse gcig pa de la yang shin sbyangs yod dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ yin na'ang 'dod khams kyi sems de la zhi gnas chen po yod ma red/ shin sbyangs chen po thob na zhi gnas yin zer mdo las gsungs pa red/ de nas zhi gnas de'i thog tu lhag mthong sgom dgos kyi yod red/ zhi gnas ni hin dhu la yang yod red/ der brten nang pa dang thun mong ba'i nyams len red/ zhi gnas de'i thog tu 'jig rten pa'i lam du bshad pa'i shes rab zhi rags kyi rnam pa can zer mkhan gcig yod/ de la sa dgu yod red/ gzugs khams la bzhi/ gzugs med khams la bzhi/ 'dod khams la gcig des zhi gnas kyi rten la gong ma thams cad legs pa yin/ 'og ma thams cad sdug pa yin bsams te sgom pas srid rtse ma gtogs pa'i khams gsum gyi nyon mongs rags pa rnams spong thub par gsung gi yod red/ zhi gnas sgom pa'i skabs su yid byed drug zer mkhan gcig sgom gyi yod red/ de sgom dus 'og ma 'og ma'i nyon mongs pa spong*zhing gong ma gong ma'i dngos gzhi de tsho thob yong gi yod red/ zhi gnas kyi thog tu bdag med rtogs pa'i lhag mthong bsgoms pa yin na theg pa gsum ka'i 'bras bu dgra bcom pa dang sangs rgyas thob yong gi yod red/ bsam gtan sgom dus dang po dus tshod thung thung bsgom dgos kyi yod red/ ring drags te sgom yag po ma byung na sgom la 'khon zhugs pa'am zhe 'gras te sgom rgyag 'dod med mkhan 'gyur 'gro gi yod red/ des na dang po phal cher skar ma lnga tsam bsgom rgyu yin pa red/ thun thung thung byas te thun grangs mang tsam bsgoms/ rim pas ring du gtong dgos rgyu yin pa red/ snang gsum gyi nang du rang gi sems la zhi gnas bzo ba'am sgom sdod dus nyams lnga 'char gyi red gsungs pa red/ sgom 'dug dus dang po rnam rtog ngos bzung gi nyams zhes pa sgom dus rnam rtog mang po skye yi yod pa mthong gi yod red/

de yang sgom gyi nyams gcig red/ sngon ma sgom ma brgyabs pa'i skabs su'ang skye yi yod red de da lta bzhin du ma rtogs pa red/ gnyis pa rnam rtog skyes na'ang sems shugs ma chags par mu 'thud de sgom 'dug dus mtshams rer sems dmigs pa'i thog tu cung tsam gnas/ yang rnam rtog 'phro 'gro yi yod red/ de la sgom gyi nyams gnyis pa rnam rtog ngal gso'i nyams zer gyi red gsungs pa red/ gsum pa da dung yang mu 'thud de thun bcad de sgom sdod pas rang gi sems snga ma las dmigs pa'i steng du yun ring tsam gnas shing yang rnam rtog skye ba'i gnas skabs de la rnam rtog thang chad kyi nyams zer gyi yod pa red/ bzhi pa rnam rtog 'du byed pa'am rlabs bcas kyi nyams ni rtsol ba byas na skabs res rnam rtog re tsam byung yang de ma thag zhi nas sems dmigs pa'i steng du rgyun ring du gnas pa la zer/ lnga pa rnam rtog zhi ba'i nyams zhes pa slar yang sngar gyi rgyun de nyid la sems bzhag pas nam zhig rnam rtog gi 'phro 'du thams cad zhi nas 'bad rtsol mi byed kyang sems dmigs pa'i steng du gsal ler gnas pa la zer/ 'di kha sang sems gnas thabs dgu bshad pa'i skabs kyi brgyad pa dang dgu pa gnyis dang gcig pa yin pa red/ phar phyin drug gi nang gi shes rab kyi skor zhu rgyu yin/ shes rab kyi ngo bo ni gnas lugs rtogs pa'i blo red gsungs pa red/ sems bskyed la sogs pas zin par byas nas theg chen sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i shes rab chags pa yin na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhu gi yod pa red/ shes rab kyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs ni nga rang tsho'i sems kyi chos kyi gnas lugs mi shes pa'i ma rig pa'am rmongs pa red/ shes rab med pa'i nyes pa'am skyon ni/ nga rang tsho'i mi'i 'jig rten na shes rab med na skyon mthong zhing yod na dge mtshan nam phan yon chen po yod pa mthong*ste/

slob sbyong rgyun ring po byed kyi yod pa red/ mi tshe'i nang gi dus tshod brgya cha gang 'tshams shig slob sbyong la gtong gi yod red/ slob sbyong med na mi tshe'i ring gi bde ba sgrub pa dang sdug bsngal sel ba'i las don rnams byed shes kyi ma red/ las ka byed stangs ma shes na grub 'bras 'thon rgyu yod ma red/ de snga chos kyi nyams len la goms cha rtsa ba nas med pa yin dus chos la slob sbyong ma byas na shes thabs yod ma red/ khyad par du shes rab kyi gtso bo bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab red/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab med na bdag 'dzin dang nyon mongs pa rnams rtsa ba nas spong ba'i gnyen po gzhan dag yod ma red/ de'i phyir 'khor ba spong thub kyi yod ma red la/ thar pa'ang thob mi thub/ sangs rgyas yang mi thob/ thar pa thob pa'i lam ni tshul khrims dang thos bsam sgom gsum gyi las ka rnams rim pa byas te 'gro dgos kyi yod red/ des na chos la nges par slob sbyong byed dgos kyi yod red/ slob sbyong byed dgos zer ba de/ rgya chen po slob sbyong ma byas na'ang 'grigs kyi red/ rgya che drags na'ang skyon byed kyi red ces slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas gsungs pa red/ thos pa nyung na'ang skyon byed kyi 'dug mang na'ang skyon byed kyi 'dug gsungs pa red/ sangs rgyas ni spangs rtogs phun sum tshogs pa red/ skyon spong ba de shes rab kyis byed kyi yod red/ yon tan de tsho sbyin pa la sogs pa thabs kyis bsgrub dgos kyi yod red/ shes rab la yang grogs po'am rogs pa thabs rnams dgos kyi yod red/ thabs de tsho la'ang shes rab grogs su dgos kyi yod red/ khyad par du pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de phyi ma phyi ma yag ga yod red/ pha rol tu phyin pa snga rjes kyi khyad par rgya mtsho chen po'i chu dang*/ ba glang gi rmig rjes kyi chu lta bu'i khyad par yod gsungs pa red/

shes rab ni rjes ma yin pas phar phyin drug gi nang nas legs shos red/ yin na'ang sangs rgyas thob pa la shes rab rkyang pas 'grigs kyi ma red/ thabs dang bcas pa gnyis ka mtha' gcig tu dgos kyi yod red/ zhi ba lhas pha rol tu phyin pa dang po lnga char lhag mthong gi rgyu dang / khyad par du bsam gtan red/ lhag mthong gi dmigs bsal gyi rgyu ni mang du thos pa yin gsungs pas thos pa mang po byed dgos kyi yod red/ lhag mthong sgom stangs la gang zag gi bdag med dang*/ chos kyi bdag med sgom pa ste gnyis yod red gsungs pa red/ yin na'ang 'di pa'i lugs la mnyam bzhag la snang ba sems su sgrub/ sems sgyu mar sgrub/ sgyu ma rang bzhin med par sgrub pa sogs kyi sgo nas sgom gyi yod red/ rjes thob tu sgyu ma lta bu sgom gyi yod red gsungs/ bdag med dam stong pa nyid ni go khag po/ sgom dus gol sa dang nor sa mang po yod mkhan gcig red/ yi ge'i thog nas kyang gsal po shes thub kyi yod ma red/ gang ltar stong nyid skor mang po bshad kyi min gsungs pa red/ 'phral du phan thogs pa gcig la dper na dge ba sgrub dus nga dge ba sgrub mkhan yin/ ngas byed pa'i bya ba 'di dge ba red bsam pa'i bden zhen med pa/ mi bden pa sgyu ma lta bu yin bsam pa gcig byas na phan thogs yod red gsungs pa red/ stong pa nyid bshad pa la nyen kha yod red/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ mi gsar pa gcig la stong pa nyid red zer lab pa yin na/ tshang ma yod yod pa la med zer ba smyon pa'i skad cha red bsams te stong nyid la mos pa ma byas nas nyes pa chen po gsog gi yod red la/ des mi tshe chos la mos pa med mkhan/ chos byed mi thub mkhan zhig chags pa'i nyen kha yod red/ yang kha shas la stong pa nyid red zer dus/ las rgyu 'bras med bsams te chad lta dang*/ log lta skye ba'i nyen kha yang yod red/ bshad mkhan gyis kyang dang po las rgyu 'bras lta bu gang 'tshams sngon la bshad dgos kyi yod red/

de 'dra ma byas par thad kar stong pa nyid bshad pa yin na byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i rtsa ltung red/ sdom pa nyams nas dmyal ba la skye 'gro gi red gsungs pa red/ / bdag med gnyis bsgom tshul mdor bstan pa/ bdag med dam stong nyid sgom tshul gnyis yod red gsungs pa red/ gnyis pa de dpe cha sbyangs ma myong ba gcig la brda sprod byed pa red/ 'dir sgom tshul gnyis ka bsdus te zhu rgyu yin/ spyir bdag med sgom tshul la/ bdag med gnyis cig car du bsgom pa dang*/ rim gyis bsgom pa ste gnyis yod/ rim gyis sgom pa la yang snang ba sems su bsgrubs pa'am byas nas sgom tshul dang*/ ma byas nas sgom tshul sogs mang po yod sa red/ de'i nang nas snang ba sems su ma byas nas sgom tshul zhu rgyu yin/ de la bden pa gnyis kyi don dag shes dgos pa gal chen po red/ bden pa gnyis zer dus gcig brdzun pa dang gcig bden pa red zer gyi yod red/ kun rdzob ni nged tsho'i blo'i yul du gyur pa tshang ma red/ don dam ni nged tsho'i blo yi yul las brgal song ba/ rigs pas dpyad na ha lam shes thub mkhan/ dngos su mthong mkhan ni 'phags pa yin pas/ 'phags pa rnams kyi gzigs bya la don dam pa'i bden pa zer gyi red/ sher phyin gyi mdo rnams su chos thams cad stong pa nyid ces gsungs pa ni gnas skabs thams cad du gsungs kyi yod ma red/ don dam pa na stong pa nyid yin pas chos rnams med gsungs kyi yod red/ der brten kun rdzob tu thams cad yod/ don dam pa na med gsungs rgyu red/ / bdag med gnyis bsgom tshul rgyas par bstan pa/ gang zag gi bdag med ces pa'i tshig zur gyi gang zag ni sems can la zer gyi yod red/ dper na nga*/ khyod/ kho zer ba de tsho red/ chos kyi bdag med ces pa'i chos ni phyi'i 'khor yug gi ri dang mtsho dang / khang pa lta bu/ za ma lta bu/ gos lta bu de tsho dang*/

sems can gyi mig dang rna ba la sogs pa la'ang zer gyi yod red/ gang zag gi bdag zer na sems can bden pa dang / chos kyi bdag zer na chos bden pa la zer gyi yod red/ gang zag gi bdag med zer na gang zag bden pa med pa dang / gang zag gi bdag gis stong pa'i stong pa nyid la zer/ chos kyi bdag med zer na chos bden pa med pa'am chos kyi bdag gis stong pa'i stong pa nyid la zer gyi yod red/ gang zag ni khams drug la brten nas nga zhes sems kyis 'dzin gyi yod red/ khams drug ni dper na sems can gyi lus po'i sha dang/ rus pa lta bu de tsho la sa'i khams zer gyi yod red/ khrag dang chu ser gcin pa lta bu de tsho la chu yi khams dang / drod la me yi khams dang/ dbugs la rlung gi khams dang/ sna bug lta bu'i khong stong de tsho la nam mkha'i khams dang/ sems la rnam par shes pa'i khams gsungs kyi yod red/ de tsho ngo 'phrod nas nga dang bdag ces nga tshos 'dzin pa nang bzhin khams drug gi steng la yod med 'tshol dgos kyi yod red/ khams drug gi nang gi so bdag red dam ma red ces 'tshol dgos kyi yod red/ de 'dra byas te btsal na so dang bdag gnyis mthun pa'am 'grigs kyi mi 'dug bdag ces 'dzin dus nga rang gcig pu yin bsam gyi yod pas gcig yin dgos kyi yod red/ rtag par sdod nges pa yin bsam gyi yod pas rtag pa zhig yin dgos pa dang / bdag zer mkhan de so so'i lus po la sogs pa la dbang bsgyur byed mkhan zhig yin bsam gyi yod pas rang dbang can zhig yin dgos pas so dang rtsa ba nas mthun gyi yod ma red/ gang yin zhe na/ so la mang po yod pas bdag gi mtshan nyid gcig ces pa de yod ma red/ so re re la bdag re re yod na sems can gcig la bdag mang po chags 'gro gi yod red/ skra ni de las mang ba yod red/ rnam shes la sogs pa'i khams gzhan dag kyang de dang gcig mtshungs du ma dang mi rtag pa la sogs pa red/

des na bdag dang rtsa ba nas mthun pa'am 'grigs kyi yod ma red/ de 'dra byas te bsam blo btang rjes bdag med pa red 'dug bsam pa de yi thog sgom dgos kyi yod red/ sgom tshul ni gong du zhi gnas sgom tshul bshad pa dang gcig pa zhi gnas kyi dmigs pa me tog gi thog tu sems bzhag ste de nyid lhag mthong gi'ang dmigs par byed/ de'i thog tu rnam pa bdag med pa yin bsam pa de'i thog la bzhag ste sgom dgos kyi yod red/ bdag med pa de zhi gnas kyi steng du sgom dus zhi lhag zung sbrel zer gyi yod red/ dper na lhag mthong gis gnas lugs rtogs pa yin dus mar me 'dra po/ zhi gnas kyis sems brtan po byed kyi yod pas mar me'i rlung yol 'dra po red/ rlung med pa'i mar me 'dra po gcig byung na de la zhi lhag zung sbrel zer gyi yod red/ kha shas kyis zhi gnas ni mi g.yo ba dmigs pa gcig gi thog tu sdod pa'i cha dang / lhag mthong ni gang zag gi bdag med lta bu sgom dus gang zag de bden pa med stangs kyi rgyu mtshan rnams la bsam blo gtong zhing dpyad pa byed pa'i cha la zer gyi red gsungs pa red/ dpyad pa mang po byas te bdag med pa lta bu'i steng du sems bzhag yong na sems 'jog pa'i cha de zhi gnas red ma gtogs de ni lhag mthong ma red gsungs pa red/ gzhan dag gis gsungs na de 'dra ma red/ lhag mthong la yang mdo yi nang so sor rtog pa'i lhag mthong dang*/ mi g.yo ba'i lhag mthong ste gnyis yod gsungs/ des na lhag mthong la dpyad pa byed mi byed gnyis dgos gsungs pa red/ dpyad pa byed mkhan de lhag mthong gi sbyor ba dang*/ yang na rjes thob red/ stong pa nyid kyi steng du mi rtog pa byas te mi g.yo bar 'jog pa ni lhag mthong gi dngos gzhi dang mnyam bzhag red gsungs pa red/ yang gang zag gi bdag med sgom stangs gcig la phung po lnga shes dgos kyi yod red/

nga rang tsho la gzugs kyi phung po la sogs pa phung po lnga yod red/ gzugs kyi phung po zer na nga tsho'i mig rna ba/ sna/ lce dang lus bcas yul can lnga dang/ gzugs/ sgra/ dri/ ro/ reg bya bcas yul lnga*/ de ma yin pa gcig dang bcu gcig yod gsungs pa red/ mig dang rna ba zhes pa de tsho nga tsho'i mig gis phar mthong rgyu'i khra ril ril de tsho la zer gyi yod ma red/ de yul gyi cha red/ de'i nang log la rnam shes skye ba'i nus pa yod pa la zer ba red/ de la dbang po'ang zer gyi yod red/ tshor ba'i phung po ni/ nged tshos myong ba'i bde ba dang sdug bsngal la sogs pa de tsho red/ 'du shes kyi phung po ni/ chos rnams thams cad la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos re yod pa 'dzin mkhan gyi sems byung gcig la zer gyi yod red/ 'du byed kyi phung po la mtshungs ldan 'du byed zer mkhan gcig yod red/ de ni nga rang tsho'i sems la skye ba'i 'dod chags dang dad pa la sogs pa'i sems byung bzhi bcu zhe dgu'am lnga bcu nga gcig la zer gyi yod red/ ldan min 'du byed ni/ dper na ming tshig dang / dus 'das ma 'ongs lta bu la gsungs pa red/ rnam shes kyi phung po zer na sems la gsungs pa red/ so so'i phung po lnga la brten nas bdag tu 'dzin gyi yod red/ yin na'ang nga tshos 'dzin pa nang bzhin so so'i phung po dang bdag 'dzin gyi yul gyi bdag gnyis po de dag yang na gcig yin dgos kyi yod red/ yang na tha dad yin dgos kyi yod red/ de 'dra byas nas dpyad pa btang nas bltas na dang po de gnyis kyi mtshan nyid 'grigs kyi yod ma red/ gang yin zhe na/ phung po mang po dang mi rtag pa la sogs red/ bdag ni gcig ma gtogs yong shes kyi ma red/ phung po dang bdag gnyis tha dad yin zer na yang 'grigs kyi ma red/ rang gi phung po de la nga yin bsam gyi yod red ma gtogs phyi log gi khang pa dang / shing la sogs pa rnams la nga yin bsam gyi yod ma red/

des na rigs pas dpyad na bdag zer mkhan de rnyed rgyu yod ma red/ der brten don dam du bdag med zer gyi yod red/ tha snyad du byas na dper na sgo dang sge'u khung la sogs pa la brten nas khang pa zhes zer gyi yod pa nang bzhin so so'i phung po la brten nas bdag zer mkhan gcig nged tsho'i rtog pas bzos bzhag pa'am btags pa gcig yod red/ chos kyi bdag med zhu rgyu yin/ rigs pa des chos kyi bdag med kyang gtan la dbab thub kyi yod red/ yin na'ang rigs pa gzhan dag kyang mang po yod red/ dper na dngos po thams cad rgyu rkyen las skye yi yod red/ rgyu rkyen las ma skyes pa'i dngos po yod ma red/ yin na'ang 'bras bu skye dus de'i skye ba nga rang tshos 'dzin pa bzhin du bden par grub pa 'dug gam mi 'dug ces rgyu'i phyogs nas dpyad pa gtong ba rgyu la dpyod pa rdo rje gzegs ma'i rigs pas brtag dpyad byed dus/ skye ba rnyed kyi ma red/ de yang 'bras bu de kho rang dang ngo bo gcig yin pa'i rgyu las skye yi 'dug gam/ 'bras bu dang ngo bo gzhan yin pa'i rgyu las skye yi 'dug gam/ bdag dang gzhan gnyis ka las sam rgyu med las skye yi 'dug ces bsam blo gtong dus/ dang po ltar du ngo bo gcig yin pa'i rgyu las skyes na 'bras bu kho rang gis kho rang skye dgos red/ kho rang las kho rang skye ba yin na kho med na ni gzhan gyis rgyu byed thub kyi ma red/ kho yod na ni skye dgos don yod ma red/ gnyis pa ltar du 'bras bu kho rang las gzhan yin pa'i rgyu las skye dgos kyi yod na/ glang chen las kyang seng ge'i phru gu skye bar 'gyur pa la sogs pa'i skyon chags kyi yod red/ gsum pa ltar du bdag gzhan gnyis ka las skye zer na ni 'gal ba red/ bzhi pa ltar du rgyu med las skye zer na ni grub mtha' ha cang skyo po red/ gang yin zhe na/

'jig rten pas kyang 'bras bu ni rgyu rkyen rnams las skye yi yod pa rtogs nas rgyu rkyen la 'bad rtsol chen po byed kyi yod pa mthong gsal red/ de 'dra byas te rigs pa gtong bas rgyu las 'bras bu skye ba rnyed kyi ma red/ yang 'bras bu'i cha nas dpyad pa gtong*ba 'bras bu la dpyod pa yod med skye 'gog gi rigs pas brtag dpyad byed dus/ rgyu las 'bras bu skye yi yod na/ rgyu yi dus na yod pa'i 'bras bu zhig skye yi yod red dam/ yang na rgyu'i dus na med pa'i 'bras bu zhig skye yi yod red ces brtag dang po ltar na yod pa ni skye dgos don yod ma red la/ gnyis pa ltar na'ang med pa ni sus kyang yod par byed thub kyi ma red/ yang rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dngos po rnams kyi ngo bo la dpyod pa gcig du bral gyi rigs pas 'jig rten gyi blos chos rnams la gcig tu 'dzin pa nang bzhin gyi gcig de grub bam ma grub dpyad na rtsa ba nas ma grub pa red/ de yang dper na phyi don smra ba bye mdo gnyis lta bus rdul phran gzugs chung shos de cha shas phye rgyu med pa'i gcig yin zhes 'dod kyi yod red/ 'on kyang grub mtha' gong mas de yang gcig ma red/ cha shas mang po yod red ces gsungs pa red/ dper na rdul phran de dbus su bzhag rdul phran gzhan bcu yis phyogs bcu nas bskor ba yin na dbus kyi rdul phran de la cha shas bcu yod dgos kyi yod red/ der brten cha med du 'dod pa'i rdul phran de ni mang por 'gyur 'gro gi yod red/ des na gcig zhes pa rtsa ba nas sgrub thub kyi ma red/ gcig med na gcig mang po bsags pa las du ma zer ba yin dus mang po yang yod ma red/ gcig dang du ma med na chos thams cad med par 'gyur ba dang / yang gong du bshad pa'i rigs pa de dag tu ma zad dngos dngos med thams cad la dpyod pa rten 'brel gyi rigs pas kyang 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad rgyu rkyen tshogs pa'i rten 'brel las byung ba yin dus don la skye ba yod ma red/

dper na me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ni byad bzhin dang me long sogs rgyu rkyen tshang na ma gtogs med pa dang gcig pa red/ rgyu mtshan de'i thog nas kyang bden pa med pa red ces gsungs/ rigs pa de tsho'i thog nas chos rnams skye ba med pa stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba thob kyi yod red/ stong pa nyid rtogs nas nges shes yag po byung na chos thams cad stong pa nyid yin pa de'i thog tu 'jog rgyu red/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs na so so'i sems rgyud kyi bdag 'dzin dang nyon mongs pa gzhan rnams kyang spong thub kyi yod red la/ des nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu'ang thob thub kyi yod red/ byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang thabs kyi cha'i lam rnams nyams su len pa la brten nas rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa zhe sdang sogs mgo gnon byed thub kyang nyon mongs pa de rnams kyi sa bon med pa byed thub kyi yod ma red/ sa bon med pa byed dgos na bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab dgos kyi yod red/ 'o na gong du bshad pa'i bdag med dang skye med de tsho chos kyi gnas lugs red dam zhes dris na/ chos kyi gnas lugs ma red/ gnas lugs zer ba de don dam pa'i bden pa yin dgos kyi yod red/ de dag ni rtog pas bzos bzhag pa'i kun rdzob kyi bden pa red/ dper na ring po dang thung ngu zer ba de dag phan tshun ltos nas rnam rtog gis bzos bzhag pa red/ rgyu mtshan gang yin zhes dris na/ ring po med na thung thung yod ma red/ pha ri med na tshur ri yod ma red/ bzang po med na ngan pa yod ma red/ de tsho'i gras rnam rtog gis bzos bzhag pa red/ stong pa nyid zer ba de dang*/ bdag med zer ba de dang*/ skye med zer ba de tsho'ang mi stong pa dang bdag dang skye ba la sogs pa la ltos nas bzhag pa red/ dgag bya bdag med cing skye ba'ang med na de dag bkag pa'i bdag med dang skye med zer ba de tsho'ang grub kyi ma red/

des na rigs pa des bdag dang skye ba la sogs pa ma zad bdag med dang skye ba med pa la sogs pa'ang 'gog dgos kyi yod red/ de ni rim pa gnyis pa yin/ de nas 'o na skye ba yod pa dang med pa gnyis ka yin pa zhig yod red dam zer na/ gnyis ka yin pa zhig yong thabs yod ma red/ de rim pa gsum pas 'gog gi yod red/ 'o na skye ba yod med gnyis ka ma yin pa zhig gnas lugs red dam zer na/ de yang ma red/ de yang gnyis ka yin pa la ltos nas rtog pas spros bzhag pa red/ gnas lugs ni mtha' bzhi dang bral ba/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba/ rnam rtog gi yul min pa/ sgras brjod rgyu med pa/ mdzub mo 'dzugs sa gcig kyang med pa la tha snyad du gnas lugs zhes ming 'dogs pa red/ de 'dra byas te dang po dpyad nas nges pa rnyed par byas te/ de nas sgom dgos kyi yod red/ 'o na da ji ltar byas te bsgom dgos red zer na/ gnas lugs ni spros pa'i mtha' bzhi char dang bral ba yin pa shes par byas te de rjes g.yengs pa med pa'i thog sems kyis bzo bcos rtsa ba nas mi byed pa'am/ dgag sgrub mi byed pa'i ngang du sdod rgyu red/ / zhen pa bzhi bral lugs kyi lhag mthong sgom tshul bshad pa/ da 'di pa zhen pa bzhi bral gyi lugs kyi lhag mthong sgom stangs gcig zhu rgyu yin/ lhag mthong sgom stangs sngon du bshad pa de dag nang don rig pa'i gzhung sbyangs ma myong mkhan la dka' las khag po red/ da 'di pa'i lugs kyi man ngag gi sgom stangs la gang zag gi bdag med sgom stangs zur du gsungs yod ma red de chos kyi bdag med dang sgom stangs gcig pa red/ bdag med gnyis cha dpe yi thog nas bsgom gyi yod red/ dper na rmi lam du so so yang mthong gi yod red/ sems can gzhan yang ston gyi yod red/ de bzhin du glog brnyan gyi nang du sems can 'dra min mthong gi yod red/ sgyu ma mkhan gyis sprul pa'i sems can mi sogs kyi rnam pa yin pa'i sgyu ma yang mthong rgyu yod red/

de tsho tshang ma snang yang mthong ba nang bzhin gyi bden pa med pa de bzhin du/ nga tshor so sos gtsos pa'i sems can rnams snang gi yod kyang bden pa med pa tshang ma gcig pa yin bsam sgom dgos kyi yod red/ 'di'i nang snang ba sems sgrub gsung gi 'dug nged tsho'i da lta'i shes pa rnams la snang ba'i snang ba gzugs sgra la sogs pa tshang ma sems su dpe yi sgo nas sgrub kyi yod red/ de la dpe brgyad gsungs pa red/ de'i nang nas gcig rmi lam gyi dpe red/ rmi lam du rang dang rang gi nye 'brel sogs sems can 'dra min snang gi yod red de/ snang ba nang bzhin gyi bden pa yod ma red/ gang yin zhe na/ gnyid sad dus yod ma red/ de dang nga rang tshor da lta nyin mo gnyid ma khug pa'i skabs sems can 'dra min snang ba gnyis gcig pa red/ snang gi yod red de ma rig pa'i gnyid sad dus yod ma red ces bsams te re re bzhin du bsgoms/ 'di man ngag gi sgo nas gang zag gi bdag med bsgom stangs red/ de nas yul gyi snang ba gzugs sgra la sogs pa'ang rmi lam du snang ba'i gzugs sgra la sogs pa dang mthun par sbyar nas rang gi sems kyi snang ba'am sems yin bsams te thag bcad/ yang de'i thog tu sgom dgos/ 'dis gzung ba'am yul rnams man ngag gis bden med sgom stangs bshad pa red/ 'o na phugs su snang ba sna tshogs pa rnams sems su bden pa red dam zer na/ de yang ma red/ de nas sems de yang bden par ma grub pa dpe yi sgo nas bshad pa red/ spyir sems bden med du sgrub pa'i dpe la brgyad gsungs yod red/ de'i nang nas sgyu ma ni gcig red/ sgyu ma mkhan gyis thabs shes kyi thog nas sems can dang*/ khang pa sogs 'dra min ston yong gi yod red/ de tsho snang gi yod red de snang ba nang bzhin bden pa ma red/ de dang gcig pa red bsams nas bsgoms/ 'dis yul can 'dzin pa'am sems bden med du sgrub pa red/

da ga re lhag yod red zer na/ sems gsal tsam zhig lhag yod red/ 'di la theg chen pas kun gzhi rnam shes zer gyi red/ mu stegs pa yis bdag yin zer ba lta bu grub mtha' mang pos mi 'dra ba bshad kyi yod red/ de yang rim pa gsum pa ltar rang bzhin med par shes pa'i sgo nas bden med du bsgrub dgos red gsungs pa red/ rang bzhin med pa la rten 'brel dang brjod bral gnyis gsungs kyi yod red/ de gnyis las rten 'brel ni kun rdzob kyi cha nas gsungs pas kun rdzob tu sems ni rten 'brel yin/ don dam pa na sems ni brjod bral yin gsungs pa red/ gsal tsam gyi sems de rten 'brel yin pa dpe yi thog nas bshad kyi yod red/ de la dpe brgyad gsungs yod red/ de'i nang nas kha ton gyi dpe yis bshad na/ dper na slob dpon gyis na mo budhaya zhes zhal nas gsung dus slob mas kyang na mo budhaya zhes zer gyi yod red/ yin na'ang slob dpon gyi gsung pa'i tshig de ga rang slob ma'i steng la 'phos song ba ma red/ slob dpon gyi brjod pa de la brten nas slob ma'i tshig de byung ba red/ der brten de rten 'brel red/ rten 'brel yin pas skye ba med pa red/ brjod bral ni yul spros bral snga ma bshad pa de ga rang red/ da lta yul can gyi cha nas bshad kyi yod red/ nyams myong gi thog nas/ 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams kyis spros bral dngos su gzigs kyi yod red de/ de 'di red ces gsal po zhig brjod thub kyi yod ma red/ yin na'ang de dpe yi sgo nas bshad pa red/ dper na gzhon nu dgod pa ji bzhin te/ phrug gu chung chung kha grags mi shes mkhan dgod pa'i skabs la kho la rgyu mtshan gcig yod red de/ de lab thub kyi yod ma red/ 'o de 'dra yin gsungs pa red/ kha shas kyis dpe yis stong nyid rtogs thub kyi ma red/ rigs pa rkyang pas rtogs dgos kyi red/

thabs shes gzhan yod ma red ces nan tan gsungs kyi yod red/ yin na'ang dpe yi thog nas stong nyid rtogs thub kyi red/ der ma zad sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' la brten nas kyang stong nyid rtogs dgos kyi yod red ces kun mkhyen rong ston chen pos zhib cha gsungs 'dug lta ba bsgoms tshar dus bsngo ba smon lam byed/ de nas yar langs te phyi log la 'gro ba'i skabs sems can sogs ga re mthong na'ang de tsho med bzhin du snang ba sgyu ma lta bu yin bsam dgos kyi yod red/ gsung chos dngos gzhi 'dir grub pa yin no/ / chos zhu bshad grwa ba rnams la bstsal ba'i dmigs bsal bka' slob/ nga tshos slob grwa'i thog nas nyin bcu yi chos 'chad nyan yod ces khyab bsgrags byas pa red/ de la brten nas phyi log nas mi mang po phebs nas 'dir nyin ma bcu yi ring slob sbyong yag po gnang ba de la dga' po byung*/ thugs rje che/ skad sgyur rnam pa dang slob grwa 'di'i las byed rnam pas gra sgrig gnang ba la'ang thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ rgya gar du yod pa'i bshad grwa khag nas dang*/ bod nas kyang slob phrug mang po 'dir phebs 'dug khyed tsho la'ang thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ ngas bshad grwa ba rnam la tshig kha shas zhu rgyu yin/ bshad grwa ba'i mkhan po rnam pa dang*/ dge rgan rnam pa/ slob phrug rnam pas rgyun ring por chos 'chad nyan gnang ba de bstan pa'i bya ba red/ skyes bu dam pa'i spyod pa red/ de la rjes su yi rangs yod/ bstod bsngags kyang yod/ thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ chos 'chad nyan gnang rgyu'i las ka de ha cang khag po yod red/ dper na mkhan po rnam pa dang*/ slob phrug rnam pas slob sbyong byed dgos pa de las sla po yod ma red/ nyi ma re re bzhin du gra sgrig chu tshod mang po gnang dgos kyi yod red/ dka' las khag po red/ gzugs pos las ka byas pa dang 'dra yi ma red/

dka' ngal de 'dra rgyab nas chos gsungs dgos kyi yod red/ de yang lo nas lor bstud de chos gsungs kyi yod pas dka' las khag po yod red/ de la thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ slob phrug rnam pas kyang tshe 'di'i bya ba bzhag ste ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i rjes su zhugs nas rab tu byung*/ tshul khrims bsrungs/ gzhung chen po de tsho la thos bsam gnang ba de dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad gshegs pa'i lam de ga rang du phebs kyi yod pa yin stabs de shin tu ngo mtshar chen po red/ rjes su yi rangs zhu rgyu yin/ de nas slob sbyong byed rgyu'i rim pa la/ dper na mkhan pos phyag dpe 'khrid rgyu dang*/ slob phrug so sos nang sbyong byed rgyu/ rtsod pa byed rgyu de tshos dpe cha shes yong gi yod red/ de tsam ma yin pa da dung de'i steng du thabs shes mang po byed kyi yod red/ dper na so sos dbang zhus pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma de tsho la bstod pa yag po zhu dgos red/ bla ma dang mnyam du sdod pa'i skabs su bla ma'i mdzad spyod la brtag dpyad btang bsdad na 'grigs kyi yod ma red/ bla ma de sangs rgyas yin bsam pa de goms dgos kyi yod red/ de 'dra byas pa yin na chos shes rgyur phan thogs chen po byed kyi red/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas grags pa rgyal mtshan sku mdun nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhus nas bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gzigs pa dang*/ nang du yang dag pa'i rtogs pa cung zad skyes/ shes bya thams cad la mkhas par gyur ba red/ mi thams cad kyis brtsi bkur byed dgos pa zhig byung ba red/ gzhan dag gis kyang de 'dra byas na de 'dra rang yong ba 'dug gsungs pa red/ der brten bla mar mos gus byed rgyu des chos shes pa la phan gyi yod red/ de bzhin du rang la chos 'chad mkhan dang dge rgan de tsho la yang sangs rgyas dang mnyam pa gus zhabs byed dgos kyi yod gsungs/

gus zhabs ga tshod thub thub byed dgos red/ ma mtha' la dge rgan gyi thugs ma 'khrugs pa byed dgos/ de bzhin du chos grogs rnam pa dang*/ chos la yang gus zhabs byed dgos/ des kyang slob sbyong la phan thogs kyi yod red/ kha shas kyis slob sbyong byed dus dpe cha shes kyi mi 'dug mtshams lo kha shas bsdad nas dpe cha sbyangs na dpe cha yag po shes kyi 'dug zer mkhan de 'dra yod/ de bden pa red/ bshags sbyong byas na dpe cha yag po shes kyi yod red/ bshad grwa la slob sbyong byed dus mtshams bsdad rgyu de 'dra ma byung na'ang yan lag bdun pa yag po mkhyen pa byas te nyi ma re la tshar gsum re tsam 'don thub na/ de bshags sbyong spel gsum gyi gnad bsdus bzhag pa'i lam yag po red/ des dpe cha shes pa la phan thogs yag po yong gi yod red/ 'o de 'dra gnang rogs gnang*/ yang zhu dgos pa gcig la/ kun slong bcos rgyu de gnad 'gag chen po red 'dug dper na nga rang sngon ma slob sbyong byas pa'i skabs su da lta kun slong bcos pa dang nyams len byed pa'i dus tshod ma red bsam ltos med byas te bsdad pa red/ bla ma rnams kyis rtag par sems bskyed gsal 'debs gnang gi yod red/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu la sbyor ba'i don du dang po chos nyan/ de rjes nyams len byed dgos bsam/ de tsho la do lhod byas bzhag 'dug de nor 'khrul chen po red/ des na chos bshad mkhan dang nyan mkhan gnyis kas kun slong yag po bcos bzhag pa yin na chos thun re re la'ang bsod nams tshad med pa yod gsungs pa red/ de nyams len yang red la dge ba yang rlabs chen po red/ de'i phyir slob sbyong byed pa'i skabs su kun slong bcos rgyu de ha cang gal chen po red 'dug de nas dper na rtsod pa byed pa'i skabs la'ang*/ bu ston chen pos gsungs pa nang bzhin so so khe 'dod/ pha rol po dma' 'bebs 'dod byas na mi dge bar 'gyur gyi red/

bdag cag gi ston pa dang*/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs gnyis gcig gis chos thams cad yod ces dam bca' byas/ gcig gis med ces dam bca' bzhag nas rtsod pa yun ring po zhig byas dus mthar rnam smin sdug po gcig byung gsungs pa red/ des na rtsod pa byed rgyu de slob sbyong red de de yang chos su 'gro ba zhig byed rgyu gal chen po red/ de nas dper na slob sbyong byed dus mkhas 'dod byas/ mkhas par 'gyur dgos kyi 'dug tshang ma bshad rgyu yod pa gcig byed dgos kyi 'dug bsam na/ chos kyi byin rlabs 'jug gi ma red gsungs pa red/ chos nyams len byed pa'i don du slob sbyong byed kyi yod bsam na chos kyi byin rlabs 'jug yag po shes kyi yod sa red/ 'o de 'dra gnang rogs gnang zhu rgyu yin/ de nas zhu rgyu gzhan zhig la/ nga tsho dpe cha ba de tsho la nyes pa 'di yong ba'i nyen kha yod red/ rgya gar ba dang bod kyi grub mtha' de tsho rang phyogs dang gzhan phyogs byas nas gzhan phyogs de tsho mi shes mkhan zhig yin bsam/ ma 'dod pa byas na nyes pa chen po bsag gi yod sa red/ dper na ngas dbu ma dang po sbyangs dus theg pa dman pa'i mdo sde'i nang bdag med pa bstan na theg chen bstan pa don med 'gyur ro gsungs na yag po ma red gsungs mkhan gcig yod zer/ de gsungs mkhan legs ldan 'byed red gsungs pa red/ da legs ldan 'byed zer mkhan de sdug cag gcig yin sa red bsam dran myong*/ des tshogs ngan chen po bsags pa red/ de tsho byang chub sems dpa' chen po sha stag yin pa red/ byang chub sems dpa' ni yul gnyan po red/ des na gzab gzab byed dgos kyi yod pa 'dra/ de nas phyogs ris zer mkhan de dpe cha ba rkyang pa ma red/ sus byas kyang nyes pa chen po yin zer stag tsang lo tsā bas chos la phyogs ris byas pa de nyes pa du ma'i 'byung gnas yin gsungs yod/ chos la phyogs ris byed dus chos lugs kyi thog la phrag dog

'gran sems la sogs pa'i don med pa'i nyes pa dang*/ sdig pa mang po bsags kyi yod red/ de nas dam pa'i chos spong ba zer ba de yang 'byung nye bo red/ chos la phyogs ris byas na dge rtsa rnams nyams 'gro yi yod red gsungs pa red/ dad pa phyogs rer phyin pa red/ dad pa phyogs thams cad la khyab ma thub pa red/ mdor na bsam blo gtong dus sangs rgyas kyi chos gcig la rang phyogs gzhan phyogs gnyis byas/ phrag dog 'gran sems gyi sgo nas las ngan bsags pa de don dag med pa'i bya ba tshabs chen zhig red/ des na de spong dgos kyi 'dug bsam sems pa'i gting nas thag gcod cig byed dgos red/ 'o na de ji ltar bya dgos red zer na/ sde gzhung mchog sprul rin po ches gsungs kyi 'dug so so'i chos lugs de so sos nyams len byas/ gzhan gyi chos thams cad la dad pa dang dag snang byed dgos kyi red gsungs 'dug de sems kyi gting nas thag chod pa gcig byed dgos gsungs/ dge rgan tshos bsam blo gtong phyogs kyi khyad par chen po byed kyi red/ dper na slob phrug tsho bshad grwa nas thon tshar dus de tsho la phan thogs pa gcig byung na bsam pa gcig byed dgos red/ khong tsho don med ma gyur pa zhig dang khong tsho la phan thogs pa gcig byed dgos bsam sems shugs chen po byed dgos/ sems shugs byas na slob sbyong byed stangs dang*/ slob tshan bzhag stangs la khyad chen po 'gro yi red/ khyad par du des slob ma rnams slob sbyong shes ma shes khyad par rgyugs 'gro yi yod red/ der brten de'i thog la sems 'khur chen po byed dgos rgyu yin pa red/ de nas dge rgan yin na'ang 'dra/ slob phrug che ba rnying pa tsho yin na'ang 'dra/ de tshos slob phrug chung ba de tsho'i skyid sdug gang 'dra 'dug der blta rtogs byas na yag po 'dug rogs pa byed dgos pa 'dra yin na rogs pa byed/

de nas spyod lam legs bcos yag po byed bcug de tsho gal chen po red 'dug dmigs bsal du spyod lam yag po byed rgyu de gal chen po red/ dper na spyi'i las ka yin na'ang red/ mi gzhan dag la rogs pa byed dgos na*/ dang po rogs pa byed dgos sam mi dgos bltas/ rogs pa byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan mthong na rogs pa byas na yag po 'dug de ma gtogs rang dgar bsdad na don yod ma red/ gang byed thub tshad kyi rogs pa yag po byed dgos/ spyi pa'i las ka yin na dang len byas/ mi yis mngags mi dgos pa zhig byed dgos/ 'o de 'dra yang gnang rogs gnang*/ yang gcig zhu dran pa la/ slob sbyong yag po byed tshar dus lag len yag po gnang dgos zer slob grwa ba tshang ma la zhu rgyu yin/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis lag len bya rgyu gnyis yod gsungs pa red/ mkhas par gyur na yang na bshad dgos kyi red/ yang na nyams len byed dgos kyi red/ bshad rgyu'i rim pa la dang po slob sbyong byed/ de nas mkhas par gyur pa yin na rim pa ma nor ba byas na dang po nyams len byed dgos kyi red/ bshad na 'grigs kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ nyams len byas tshar dus bshad dgos kyi yod pa red/ nyams len ma byas par bshad na mi rung ba ma red de go rim 'khrugs pa red/ gang ltar mjug ma nyams len byed rgyu de gal chen po red/ deng sang mtshams bsdad zer mkhan de khag po red/ khyad par du bsgom byed rgyu'i srol de nyam chag 'gro yi yod red/ rdzong sar ga'u ri khrod nang grwa pa nyis brgya lhag tsam gyis lam 'bras bsgoms kyi yod red/ skad cha de dpe mi srid pa'i snyan po red/ de 'dra rang dgos kyi yod red/ des na da lta nas sems gcun bsdad na sems de gnon thub kyi red/ mdo don slob sbyong byas pa de chud zos med pa zhig byed dgos red/ chud zos med pa byed stangs ni nyams len byed rgyu de ga rang yin pas nyams len ma byas thabs med bsam dam bca' gnang dgos/

de'adra'i rgyu mtshan la brten sgom byed rgyu de gal chen po red 'dug don du thos bsam sgom pa gsum cha yag po yong ba zhig thugs la bzhag rogs gnang*/ da res 'dir khyed rnam pa mang po gcig gsung chos zhu sar phebs 'dug bzhugs gdan de tsho gra sgrig byed mkhan nga rang yin/ dge 'dun pa kha shas bzhugs sa med pa 'dra po chags bsdad 'dug skyo bo byung song*/ dgongs dag zhu rgyu yin/ chos 'chad nyan byed pa la dge ba yod red/ de tsho bsngo ba byed rgyu gal chen po red/ byas tsang nga tshos dge ba bsags pa rnams sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'gro ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur ba'i bsngo ba thun mong du gsung bar zhu/ / bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ / thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byed cing / / skye rga na 'chi'i rba rlabs 'khrugs pa yi/ / srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 106 mkhan chen dam pa a pad rin po che/ blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral gyi 'grel pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 105
